r-safety-last-1923.plot: A small-town go-getter moves to the big city and pretends to his sweetheart that he is a rising executive while really working as a department-store clerk. To win a promotion bonus he arranges a publicity stunt climbing the store's facade, and ends up making the death-defying ascent himself.

r-paper-moon-1973.plot: During the Great Depression, a smooth-talking con man selling Bibles to widows reluctantly agrees to drive an orphaned girl to her relatives. She proves a sharper swindler than he is, and as they scam their way across the Midwest, an unlikely bond forms.

won: Actress in a Supporting Role — Tatum O'Neal
nominated: Actress in a Supporting Role — Madeline Kahn

r-the-400-blows-1959.plot: Antoine Doinel, a neglected Paris schoolboy, faces strict teachers and indifferent parents. His small acts of rebellion and petty crime escalate until he is sent to a reform school.

r-the-purple-rose-of-cairo-1985.plot: A downtrodden waitress in Depression-era New Jersey escapes her miserable marriage at the movies. One night the dashing hero of her favorite film steps off the screen to court her, causing chaos in Hollywood.

r-steamboat-bill-jr-1928.plot: A burly riverboat captain is dismayed when his long-absent son arrives from college as a dainty, ukulele-strumming dandy. Worse, the boy is in love with the daughter of his father's wealthy rival, and their clash comes to a head as a cyclone tears the river town apart.

setting.place: River Junction, a Mississippi river town

r-the-navigator-1924.plot: A spoiled rich young man and the heiress who rejected him end up alone aboard an empty ocean liner set adrift by foreign spies. Helpless at even the simplest chores, the pair must learn to survive on the giant ship as it floats toward a cannibal-inhabited island.

setting.place: An ocean liner adrift in the Pacific

r-the-freshman-1925.plot: An eager college freshman, desperate to be the most popular man on campus, imitates a movie hero and becomes the student body's unknowing laughingstock. Determined to prove himself, he begs his way onto the football team as a water boy, hoping for one chance to play in the big game.

r-our-hospitality-1923.plot: A young New Yorker travels south to claim his family estate, unaware he is walking into a decades-old blood feud. Falling for a girl on the train, he discovers she belongs to the very clan sworn to kill him, and that Southern manners forbid them from shooting a guest under their roof.

r-the-great-locomotive-chase-1956.plot: In 1862, Union spy James Andrews leads volunteers deep into Georgia to steal a Confederate train and wreck the rail line behind them. A determined conductor pursues them on foot, by handcar and by locomotive.

r-sunrise-a-song-of-two-humans-1927.plot: A farmer seduced by a vacationing city woman is urged to drown his wife and run away with her. Unable to go through with it, he follows his terrified wife into the city, where over one day the couple rediscover their love, before a storm on the way home tests it.

setting.place: A lakeside village and a big city

r-the-big-parade-1925.plot: An idle rich man's son enlists when America enters the First World War and befriends two working-class soldiers. Billeted in a French village he falls for a local farm girl, before the regiment is marched to the front and he experiences the full horror of trench combat.

r-the-crowd-1928.plot: A young man born on the Fourth of July comes to New York convinced he is destined for greatness. Instead he becomes one more anonymous clerk, marrying, raising a family and struggling through setbacks and tragedy while the indifferent city swallows his dreams.

r-things-to-come-1936.plot: Over a century in an English city called Everytown, a long world war destroys civilization and leaves petty warlords in charge. A group of scientists and engineers rebuild society, until an ambitious plan to reach space faces fierce opposition.
r-things-to-come-1936.source: The Shape of Things to Come

r-the-cabinet-of-dr-caligari-1920.plot: A young man recounts how a strange showman and his sleepwalking servant arrived at a village fair, just as a wave of murders began. His suspicions lead him into a maze of madness, told through jagged, painted sets that made the film a landmark of German Expressionism.

r-brazil-1985.plot: In a dystopian, bureaucracy-choked society, a meek clerk who dreams of being a winged hero spots the woman from his dreams. Chasing her pulls him into conflict with the very system he serves.

r-underworld-1927.plot: A powerful, boisterous gangster takes in a down-and-out drunken lawyer and makes him his right-hand man. When the lawyer and the gangster's girlfriend fall for each other, loyalty and jealousy collide, coming to a head after the mob boss is jailed for murder.

r-little-caesar-1931.plot: A small-time hood heads to the big city determined to become somebody and ruthlessly climbs the ranks of a gang. As his power and vanity grow, his friend tries to leave crime for a dancing career, and Rico's rise sets up an equally swift fall.

r-the-public-enemy-1931.plot: Two boys from a Chicago slum graduate from petty theft to bootlegging as Prohibition opens the door to easy money. One becomes a swaggering, violent enforcer whose rise strains his family and leads to an all-out gang war.

r-hell-s-angels-1930.plot: Two very different English brothers, one a principled idealist and the other a womanizer, join the Royal Flying Corps in the First World War. They become entangled with the same glamorous woman and volunteer for a dangerous bombing mission behind German lines, amid enormous aerial battle scenes.

r-the-dawn-patrol-1930.plot: At a British fighter squadron in France, inexperienced replacement pilots are sent up daily to near-certain death. A hotheaded flight leader who resents his commander for issuing those orders finds the burden falls on him when he is promoted to command.

r-the-bat-whispers-1930.plot: A wealthy woman rents a gloomy country mansion just as a masked master criminal known as The Bat is terrorizing the area. Rumors of stolen money hidden in the house bring a crowd of suspicious visitors, and a long, stormy night of secret passages and murder follows.

setting.place: A country mansion near New York

r-king-of-jazz-1930.plot: A lavish early-Technicolor revue built around bandleader Paul Whiteman, mixing big musical production numbers, comedy sketches and a short cartoon. Highlights include a staging of Rhapsody in Blue and an early screen appearance by Bing Crosby with the Rhythm Boys.

r-gold-diggers-of-1933-1933.plot: Out-of-work showgirls in Depression-era New York land a new show when a young songwriter secretly bankrolls it with family money. When his snobbish brother tries to break up his romance with a chorus girl, her roommates turn the tables on the rich men.

r-footlight-parade-1933.plot: As talking pictures kill off stage musicals, a Broadway producer reinvents himself by staging live prologues to be shown before movies. Under huge pressure, and surrounded by cheating partners and spies, he must stage three elaborate numbers in one night.

r-the-virginian-1929.plot: A laconic ranch foreman in Wyoming courts the new schoolteacher from the East while clashing with a sly rustler. When his best friend falls in with the cattle thieves, frontier justice forces him into painful choices and a final showdown.

r-the-big-trail-1930.plot: A young trapper guides a huge wagon train of settlers along the Oregon Trail while secretly hunting the men who murdered his friend. The journey brings river crossings, attacks, storms and a hesitant romance with a well-bred young woman who dislikes him at first.

r-the-mark-of-zorro-1940.plot: Summoned home from Spain to Spanish California, a young nobleman finds his father ousted and the people crushed by a corrupt governor. Posing as a lazy fop by day, he becomes the masked swordsman Zorro by night, fighting tyranny and courting the governor's niece.

r-applause-1929.plot: A fading burlesque queen sends her daughter to be raised in a convent, far from the seedy world of the stage. Years later the innocent girl returns to New York and sees her mother's life up close, while the mother's brutish lover sets his sights on her.

r-ordet-1955.plot: On a farm in rural Jutland, a devout patriarch's family is divided by faith: one son has lost his belief, another believes he is Christ, and the youngest loves the daughter of a rival sect's leader. A crisis puts their faith to an extraordinary test.

r-day-of-wrath-1943.plot: In a 17th-century Danish village, the young second wife of an elderly pastor learns her mother was spared from a witchcraft accusation by his intervention. As she falls in love with his son, guilt, superstition and suspicion close in around her.

r-the-trial-of-joan-of-arc-1962.plot: A spare, austere reconstruction of the final trial of Joan of Arc, drawing on historical transcripts. Imprisoned by the English and interrogated by church judges, the young woman answers their traps with calm conviction as the proceedings move toward her execution.

r-the-scarlet-empress-1934.plot: A naive German princess is brought to Russia to marry the mad heir to the throne. Trapped in a grotesque, scheming court, she learns to use her charm and ambition to take power, becoming Catherine the Great.

r-ivan-the-terrible-part-i-1944.plot: Crowned the first Tsar of all Russia, young Ivan IV sets out to unify the country and break the power of the scheming boyar nobles. Facing war, betrayal and the loss of his wife, he grows ever more ruthless in his pursuit of absolute power.

r-rasputin-and-the-empress-1932.plot: In the last years of Tsarist Russia, a scheming mystic gains power over the imperial family by seeming to ease the young heir's hemophilia. A loyal prince grows convinced the holy man is ruining the country and resolves to stop him.

r-westfront-1918-1930.plot: Four German infantrymen endure the last months of the First World War in the trenches of France. Shelling, futile attacks, hunger and a bitter visit home strip away any glory, in one of the earliest and starkest anti-war films of the sound era.

r-gallipoli-1981.plot: Two young Australian sprinters, one idealistic and one cynical, enlist in the First World War and become friends on the way to the front. Their journey from the outback to Egypt ends in the doomed Allied assault at Gallipoli.

r-victoria-the-great-1937.plot: The life and reign of Queen Victoria, from her accession at eighteen through her marriage to Prince Albert and their partnership, to her Diamond Jubilee. The final reel bursts into color.

r-mrs-brown-1997.plot: Years after Prince Albert's death, a grieving Queen Victoria has withdrawn from public life. A blunt Scottish servant, John Brown, is brought in to coax her outdoors, and their unusually close bond unsettles the court and the government.

nominated: Actress in a Leading Role — Judi Dench

r-young-mr-lincoln-1939.plot: The young Abraham Lincoln begins practicing law in Springfield, Illinois. He takes up the defense of two brothers accused of murder and must stop a lynch mob and win in court.

r-20-000-years-in-sing-sing-1932.plot: A cocky gangster arrives at Sing Sing sure his connections will get him out quickly, but a reform-minded warden tries to straighten him out. When his girlfriend is hurt, the warden lets him leave on his word of honor, with fateful results.
r-20-000-years-in-sing-sing-1932.source: 20,000 Years in Sing Sing (memoir by Lewis E. Lawes)

r-brute-force-1947.plot: Inmates at an overcrowded penitentiary suffer under a sadistic, power-hungry guard captain. One determined prisoner plans a violent escape, while flashbacks reveal the women and circumstances that put his cellmates behind bars.

r-escape-from-alcatraz-1979.plot: A coolly intelligent bank robber with a history of breaking out is sent to the island prison considered escape-proof. Studying its routines and recruiting a few fellow inmates, he patiently builds a plan to get out under a hostile warden's nose.

r-a-free-soul-1931.plot: A brilliant but alcoholic San Francisco defense attorney raises his daughter to be utterly independent. She throws over her respectable fiancé for a charismatic gangster her father once got acquitted, setting off a crisis that ends in a courtroom.

won: Actor in a Leading Role — Lionel Barrymore
nominated: Actress in a Leading Role — Norma Shearer

r-the-women-1939.plot: A happily married Manhattan socialite learns from her gossiping friends that her husband is having an affair with a perfume-counter girl. She goes to Reno for a divorce, then reconsiders, in a comedy with an all-female cast.

r-baby-face-1933.plot: A young woman, exploited since girlhood in her father's speakeasy, heads to New York and uses her charm to climb a bank's corporate ladder floor by floor. Her trail of discarded lovers leads to scandal and an unexpected test of what she values.
writers: Darryl F. Zanuck (story, as Mark Canfield)

r-love-me-tonight-1932.plot: A Parisian tailor travels to a chateau to collect a debt from an aristocrat and is passed off as a baron. He falls for a lonely princess, in an inventive musical where songs flow from scene to scene.

r-maytime-1937.plot: An elderly woman recounts her youth to a heartbroken young singer: as a rising opera star in Second Empire Paris, she was promised to her controlling teacher but fell for a poor American singer. Their love was brief but defined her life.

nominated: Music (Original Song Score Or Adaptation Score)

r-rose-marie-1936.plot: A famous opera singer travels into the Canadian wilderness to help her brother, an escaped convict. On the way she meets a Royal Canadian Mounted Policeman who is hunting the very same man, and the two fall in love.

r-cimarron-1960.plot: A restless lawyer and his bride join the 1889 Oklahoma Land Rush and found a newspaper in a boom town. Across decades, his idealism and wanderlust repeatedly pull him away, while she builds their family and the paper.

r-red-river-1948.plot: A tough rancher and his adopted son drive thousands of cattle from Texas north to market after the Civil War. As the rancher's tyranny grows along the grueling trail, the son challenges him for control of the drive, leading to a bitter rift.

r-stella-dallas-1937.plot: A working-class woman marries a man above her station, but they soon drift apart. Devoted to their daughter, she sees her own manners hurting the girl's chances in high society, and decides on a painful sacrifice.

nominated: Actress in a Leading Role — Barbara Stanwyck
Actress in a Supporting Role — Anne Shirley

r-madame-x-1929.plot: A woman cast out by her stern husband for an indiscretion is barred from ever seeing her young son again. Over the years she sinks into poverty and despair abroad, until a crime brings her before a court where her defense lawyer is the son who never knew her.

nominated: Actress in a Leading Role — Ruth Chatterton

r-back-street-1932.plot: A lively Cincinnati woman misses a chance to marry the man she loves, who weds another for social standing. Years later she becomes his secret mistress, living a hidden life in the shadows of his marriage for decades.

r-sooky-1931.plot: Sequel to Skippy, following the doctor's son Skippy and his poor friend Sooky through boyhood adventures, rivalries and schemes in their town. Their friendship is tested as Sooky's family faces hardship.

r-treasure-island-1934.plot: A boy at a seaside inn comes into possession of a pirate's treasure map and sails with a crew in search of the hoard. He befriends the charming one-legged cook Long John Silver, who has his own plans for the gold.

r-the-adventures-of-tom-sawyer-1938.plot: A mischievous boy in a Mississippi river town plays hooky, falls for a new girl and fakes his own death with his friends. After witnessing a graveyard murder, he and Huck Finn must decide whether to speak up.

r-his-girl-friday-1940.plot: A scheming newspaper editor learns that his ex-wife, his best reporter, is about to remarry and leave the business. To keep her, he lures her into covering one last big story about a condemned man, and the rapid-fire chaos that follows tests her resolve.

setting.place: A big-city newsroom and criminal courts building

r-the-front-page-1974.plot: A star Chicago reporter is set to quit and marry, but his scheming editor will do anything to keep him. When a condemned man escapes on the eve of his execution, the two are drawn into a frantic scoop in the courthouse press room.

r-ace-in-the-hole-1951.plot: A disgraced big-city reporter stuck at a small New Mexico paper stumbles on a man trapped in a cliffside cave. Seeing his ticket back to the top, he deliberately stretches out the rescue to build a national media circus.

r-tarzan-the-ape-man-1932.plot: An English trader and his daughter join an African expedition in search of a legendary elephant graveyard. The daughter is carried off by a wild man raised by apes, and an unlikely romance grows between them.

r-the-african-queen-1951.plot: When World War I reaches German East Africa, a prim missionary's sister and a gin-soaked riverboat captain flee downriver together. Squabbling at first, they grow close while braving rapids, leeches and swamps on a reckless plan to strike a German gunboat.

won: Actor in a Leading Role — Humphrey Bogart
nominated: Actress in a Leading Role — Katharine Hepburn

r-mogambo-1953.plot: A big-game hunter in Kenya juggles two women: a sassy American showgirl stranded at his camp and the refined wife of a visiting anthropologist. A gorilla-filming safari becomes a tense love triangle.

nominated: Actress in a Leading Role — Ava Gardner
Actress in a Supporting Role — Grace Kelly

r-dr-ehrlich-s-magic-bullet-1940.plot: German doctor Paul Ehrlich pursues a cure for syphilis despite the scandal and opposition from colleagues. Through hundreds of experiments he develops Salvarsan, one of the first modern drugs.

r-men-in-white-1934.plot: A devoted young doctor at a big-city hospital is torn between his work and his rich fiancée, who wants him to take an easier path. A moment of weakness with a nurse leads to a crisis that tests his commitment to medicine.

r-yellow-jack-1938.plot: In Cuba after the Spanish-American War, Army doctor Walter Reed's commission tries to find what spreads yellow fever. They seek soldier volunteers for dangerous mosquito experiments.

r-man-s-castle-1933.plot: During the Depression a free-spirited drifter takes in a starving young woman and brings her to his shack in a New York shantytown. She falls deeply in love, but his restlessness and a criminal scheme threaten the fragile home they build.

setting.place: A shantytown in New York City

r-street-scene-1931.plot: Over one sweltering summer day and night, the residents of a New York tenement gossip, quarrel and dream on their front stoop. A neighbor's affair, a young woman's hopes of escape and simmering prejudices build toward sudden violence.

r-nights-of-cabiria-1957.plot: Cabiria, a spirited Roman prostitute, keeps hoping for true love despite repeated betrayals. From an encounter with a movie star to a religious pilgrimage and a hopeful romance, her resilience is tested again and again.

r-sweet-smell-of-success-1957.plot: A desperate Manhattan press agent will do anything to please a powerful, vindictive gossip columnist. Ordered to break up the columnist's sister's romance with a jazz musician, he resorts to increasingly dirty tactics.

r-nightcrawler-2014.plot: A driven, amoral drifter discovers the world of freelance crime journalism in Los Angeles, filming accidents and violent crimes to sell to a local news station. As his ambition grows, he becomes willing to manipulate the events he records.

r-dinner-at-eight-1933.plot: A New York socialite plans a fancy dinner party, unaware that each of her guests, from a failing shipping magnate to a faded matinee idol and a crass tycoon with his brassy wife, is facing a private crisis. Their stories converge as the evening approaches.

r-queen-christina-1933.plot: The independent 17th-century Queen of Sweden, raised to rule like a man, is pressured to marry for the state. Traveling in disguise she falls for the Spanish envoy, and must weigh her heart against her duty to the crown.

r-camille-1936.plot: In 19th-century Paris, a celebrated courtesan who lives on the favors of rich men falls for an earnest young admirer. Their love is threatened by her past, his father's opposition and her failing health.

nominated: Actress in a Leading Role — Greta Garbo

r-fury-1936.plot: An ordinary man on his way to marry is wrongly arrested as a kidnapping suspect in a small town. Rumor whips the townspeople into a lynch mob that burns the jail, and the survivor's thirst for revenge threatens to destroy him.

r-peeping-tom-1960.plot: A shy London camera assistant, scarred by his father's cruel psychological experiments, secretly films women as he kills them. A kind young neighbor befriends him, unaware of his obsession.

r-the-night-of-the-hunter-1955.plot: A sinister preacher with LOVE and HATE tattooed on his knuckles marries a widow to find the money her executed husband hid. Her two children, who alone know where it is, flee downriver with him in relentless pursuit.

r-midnight-1939.plot: A broke American showgirl arrives in Paris and is hired by a millionaire to pose as a countess and lure away his wife's lover. A taxi driver who has fallen for her complicates the masquerade.

r-bringing-up-baby-1938.plot: A shy paleontologist trying to secure a large museum donation keeps running into a free-spirited heiress. Before long he is in Connecticut chasing a tame leopard named Baby, and his life turns to chaos.

r-morocco-1930.plot: A world-weary cabaret singer arrives in Morocco and draws the attention of both a rich, patient European admirer and a cocky French Foreign Legionnaire. Torn between comfort and passion, she must decide how much she is willing to give up for the soldier.

nominated: Actress in a Leading Role — Marlene Dietrich

r-the-lady-vanishes-1938.plot: On a train across Europe, a young Englishwoman befriends an elderly governess who then disappears. The other passengers deny she ever existed, and with the help of a musicologist she uncovers a spy plot.

setting.place: Bandrika (fictional country); a train across Europe

r-the-champ-1979.plot: A former boxing champion, now a gambling, drinking horse trainer at a Florida racetrack, is raising his adoring young son alone. When the boy's mother reappears, wealthy and remarried, the father tries a dangerous comeback to give his son a better life.

r-body-and-soul-1947.plot: A young man from New York's Lower East Side becomes a champion boxer, but success pulls him into the grip of a crooked promoter. Facing a demand to throw his last fight, he must decide whether to sell out or reclaim his integrity.

nominated: Actor in a Leading Role — John Garfield

r-fat-city-1972.plot: A washed-up boxer in Stockton, California, drinking and working in the fields, spots promise in a young fighter and steers him to a trainer. As the youngster starts his career, the veteran attempts a comeback, both men stuck in a cycle of small hopes.

nominated: Actress in a Supporting Role — Susan Tyrrell

r-le-million-1931.plot: A broke Parisian painter learns he holds a winning lottery ticket, only to realize it was in a jacket that has since been given away. A frantic chase across Paris follows, ending backstage at the opera, told with playful song and rhythm.

r-the-guardsman-1931.plot: A celebrated actor, jealous of his restless actress wife, tests her fidelity by disguising himself as a dashing Russian guardsman and wooing her. The more she seems to respond, the more tangled his game becomes in this witty marital comedy.

nominated: Actor in a Leading Role — Alfred Lunt
Actress in a Leading Role — Lynn Fontanne

r-dames-1934.plot: An eccentric, puritanical millionaire threatens to cut off relatives who associate with show people. His cousin's daughter falls for a songwriter staging a Broadway show, and a blackmail scheme helps get it onstage, with lavish Busby Berkeley numbers.

r-waterloo-bridge-1940.plot: As World War II begins, an army officer stands on London's Waterloo Bridge recalling the ballet dancer he met there during an air raid in the First World War. Their whirlwind romance was upended by war, false news and poverty, with tragic consequences.

r-a-farewell-to-arms-1957.plot: An American ambulance driver serving with the Italian army in World War I falls in love with an English nurse. Their affair survives a disastrous retreat and his desertion, but the war leaves them little peace.

nominated: Actor in a Supporting Role — Vittorio De Sica

r-this-happy-breed-1944.plot: A working-class family moves into a London suburb in 1919 and lives there for the next twenty years. Through marriages, deaths, quarrels and the General Strike, their everyday joys and sorrows reflect the changing nation as war approaches again.

r-the-life-and-death-of-colonel-blimp-19.plot: A blustering old British general recalls forty years of life and service, from a youthful duel in Berlin to the Boer War, the First World War and the Second. Along the way, a lifelong friendship with a German officer and a series of women shape him.

r-a-night-to-remember-1958.plot: A sober, almost documentary account of the Titanic's maiden voyage and sinking in April 1912. Following officers, crew and passengers of every class, it shows the hours of disbelief, heroism and panic as the ship goes down.

r-cool-hand-luke-1967.plot: A war veteran arrested for drunkenly cutting the heads off parking meters is sentenced to a Southern prison chain gang. His quiet defiance and refusal to be broken win the admiration of his fellow convicts and the growing hostility of the guards, who are determined to make him conform.

won: Actor in a Supporting Role — George Kennedy
nominated: Actor in a Leading Role — Paul Newman

r-my-man-godfrey-1936.plot: During the Depression, a scatterbrained heiress finds a homeless man at a city dump during a scavenger hunt and hires him as her family's butler. The eccentric rich household is changed by his calm dignity, and he has a past of his own.

nominated: Actor in a Leading Role — William Powell
Actor in a Supporting Role — Mischa Auer
Actress in a Leading Role — Carole Lombard
Actress in a Supporting Role — Alice Brady

r-guys-and-dolls-1955.plot: A New York gambler needing a venue for his floating crap game bets a smooth high roller that he cannot take a prim mission worker to Havana. The wager gets complicated when real feelings develop.

nominated: Music (Original Song Score Or Adaptation Score)

r-little-miss-marker-1934.plot: A stingy Broadway bookie accepts a little girl as a marker for her father's unpaid bet. When the father never returns, the gamblers and the nightclub singer around him end up raising her, and her sweetness slowly softens them.

r-little-women-1994.plot: The four March sisters grow up in Massachusetts during and after the Civil War while their father is away. Spirited Jo dreams of becoming a writer as the sisters face love, loss and adulthood.

nominated: Actress in a Leading Role — Winona Ryder

r-pride-and-prejudice-1940.plot: Mrs. Bennet is determined to marry off her five daughters, and the arrival of wealthy bachelors sets the neighborhood buzzing. Sharp-witted Elizabeth clashes with the proud Mr. Darcy, and both must overcome first impressions and wounded pride in this lively Hollywood take on Austen.

r-little-women-1949.plot: With their father away in the Civil War, the four March sisters grow up in Concord, Massachusetts, with their warm, steady mother. Spirited Jo dreams of becoming a writer as the sisters face love, loss and the challenges of growing up.

r-i-m-no-angel-1933.plot: A carnival performer famous for putting her head in a lion's mouth makes her way to New York high society. She sets her sights on a wealthy man, and when he backs out she takes him to court in a breach-of-promise suit full of wisecracks.

r-my-little-chickadee-1940.plot: Run out of town for consorting with a masked bandit, a worldly saloon singer agrees to a sham marriage with a bumbling, blustering con man to regain respectability. In the frontier town of Greasewood City, the mismatched pair trade insults while she tries to unmask her mysterious outlaw.

r-klondike-annie-1936.plot: A San Francisco nightclub singer kills her possessive lover in self-defense and flees on a ship bound for Alaska. On board she swaps identities with a missionary, and ends up running a settlement house in the Klondike.

r-the-ghost-and-mrs-muir-1947.plot: A young widow rents a seaside cottage in England despite rumors it is haunted. The gruff ghost of a sea captain does try to scare her away, but instead they form an unlikely bond and collaborate on a book of his salty memoirs.

r-portrait-of-jennie-1948.plot: A struggling painter in Depression-era New York meets a mysterious young girl in Central Park. Each time they meet she seems to have aged years, and as he paints her portrait, he falls in love with someone who may belong to another time.

r-peter-ibbetson-1935.plot: Two childhood sweethearts in Paris are separated and meet again years later in England, where she has married a duke. When tragedy separates them for good, they find each other in a shared dream world, in a haunting romantic fantasy.

nominated: Music (Original Song Score Or Adaptation Score)

r-state-fair-1945.plot: An Iowa farm family heads to the state fair: Dad hopes his prize hog wins a blue ribbon, Mom enters her mincemeat, and both grown children are restless. Over a few days, each child finds an unexpected romance amid the rides and music.

nominated: Music (Original Song Score Or Adaptation Score)

r-meet-me-in-st-louis-1944.plot: Across four seasons leading up to the 1904 World's Fair, the Smith family of St. Louis navigates crushes on the boy next door, Halloween mischief and the shock of a planned move to New York. The family's warm everyday life unfolds in song.

nominated: Music (Original Song Score Or Adaptation Score)

r-ah-wilderness-1935.plot: In a small Connecticut town around the Fourth of July, a teenage boy drunk on radical books and first love clashes with his wise, patient father. A gentle, nostalgic look at family life and growing up.

r-rembrandt-1936.plot: After the death of his beloved wife, the great Dutch painter Rembrandt van Rijn falls out of favor with Amsterdam society. He sinks into debt and poverty, but keeps painting and finds love again.

r-young-bess-1953.plot: The young Princess Elizabeth grows up amid the dangerous politics of Henry VIII's court and the reign of her brother Edward. She falls for the dashing Admiral Thomas Seymour, whose ambitions entangle her in treason.

r-fire-over-england-1937.plot: In the years before the Spanish Armada, a young English naval officer whose father was burned by the Inquisition becomes a spy for Queen Elizabeth I. He infiltrates the Spanish court to uncover a plot against the queen and the invasion plans.

r-the-sign-of-the-cross-1932.plot: In Nero's Rome after the great fire, Christians are hunted and fed to the arena. A powerful Roman prefect falls for a devout young Christian woman, while the empress schemes to win him for herself.

r-caesar-and-cleopatra-1945.plot: Julius Caesar arrives in Egypt and finds a timid young Cleopatra hiding among the statues. As he tutors her in the art of ruling, she grows into a formidable queen, while Caesar's forces struggle against rebellion in Alexandria.

r-spartacus-1960.plot: A Thracian slave trained as a gladiator leads a revolt that grows into an army threatening the Roman Republic. As he fights for freedom, the ruthless general Crassus maneuvers in Roman politics to crush him.

won: Actor in a Supporting Role — Peter Ustinov

r-shipmates-forever-1935.plot: The son of a Navy admiral would rather be a crooner than follow family tradition. He reluctantly enters the Naval Academy at Annapolis, where his attitude makes him unpopular, until he finds his sense of duty.

r-the-long-gray-line-1955.plot: An Irish immigrant arrives at West Point as a waiter and stays for 50 years as an enlisted athletic instructor. Over the decades he and his wife become surrogate family to generations of cadets heading off to war.

r-follow-the-fleet-1936.plot: A sailor on shore leave in San Francisco runs into his former dance partner, who is now singing in a dance hall. While they rekindle their romance, his shipmate courts her sister, and the gang plans a show to save a ship.

r-devil-dogs-of-the-air-1935.plot: A cocky stunt flyer joins the Marine Corps aviation corps, where his showing off clashes with his straight-laced friend, an instructor. The two compete for the same girl while training in dangerous air exercises.

r-ceiling-zero-1936.plot: A reckless, charming airmail pilot joins an old friend who runs an airline station. His carelessness about safety and his romantic adventures lead to tragedy, and he must make amends in a dangerous test flight.

r-the-fighting-69th-1940.plot: A brash, boastful recruit joins New York's Irish-American 69th Infantry Regiment as it ships out to the Western Front in World War I. When his cowardice under fire endangers his comrades, the regiment's chaplain, Father Duffy, refuses to give up on him.

r-imitation-of-life-1959.plot: An aspiring actress and a Black widow raise their daughters together in one household. As the actress pursues stardom, the light-skinned daughter of her friend tries to pass as white, breaking her mother's heart.

nominated: Actress in a Supporting Role — Susan Kohner
Actress in a Supporting Role — Juanita Moore

r-pinky-1949.plot: A light-skinned Black woman who has passed as white while training as a nurse in the North returns home to the South. Caring for a dying white aristocrat at her grandmother's urging, she confronts racism, a disputed inheritance and her own identity.

setting.place: A small town in the American South

nominated: Actress in a Leading Role — Jeanne Crain
Actress in a Supporting Role — Ethel Barrymore
Actress in a Supporting Role — Ethel Waters

r-the-lady-eve-1941.plot: A card-sharp and her father target a shy, wealthy snake expert on an ocean liner, but she falls for him for real. When he learns the truth and dumps her, she returns posing as an aristocratic Englishwoman to get her revenge.

r-love-me-forever-1935.plot: A gambler who runs a nightclub falls for a young singer and devotes himself to making her an opera star, even at the cost of his own ruin. She rises toward the Metropolitan Opera while another man wins her heart.

r-the-great-caruso-1951.plot: A romanticized life of tenor Enrico Caruso, from humble beginnings in Naples to triumphs at the world's great opera houses. Along the way he courts a society woman whose father disapproves, while illness shadows his late career.

nominated: Music (Original Song Score Or Adaptation Score)

r-bright-star-2009.plot: In Hampstead, the poet John Keats and his spirited neighbor Fanny Brawne, a fashion-loving seamstress, fall into a tender romance. Poverty, disapproval from his friend and Keats's failing health stand in the way of their love.

r-jane-eyre-1943.plot: An orphan survives a cruel aunt and a harsh charity school, then becomes a governess at the gloomy Thornfield Hall. She falls in love with its brooding master, Mr. Rochester, but a dark secret within the house threatens their happiness.

r-swing-time-1936.plot: A dancer and gambler must earn money in New York to prove himself to his fiancée's father. He falls in love with a dance instructor and becomes her partner, while trying to avoid winning too much and going home.

r-shall-we-dance-1937.plot: An American ballet dancer performing under a Russian name in Paris falls for a famous tap dancer. A publicity rumor that they are secretly married follows them across the Atlantic, and they decide the only way out is to marry and divorce.

r-flying-down-to-rio-1933.plot: A bandleader and aviator falls for a Brazilian beauty and flies his orchestra to Rio de Janeiro to follow her, where a rival suitor and the opening of a new hotel complicate things. Best remembered for the first screen pairing of Fred Astaire and Ginger Rogers and dancers on airplane wings.

r-voltaire-1933.plot: The French philosopher and writer Voltaire uses his wit and influence at the court of Louis XV to fight injustice. He takes on the case of a Protestant family wrongly persecuted, while uncovering a plot against the king.

r-cardinal-richelieu-1935.plot: The shrewd Cardinal Richelieu, chief minister to the weak King Louis XIII, fights to unite France against scheming nobles and the queen mother. He also protects his young ward and her romance amid the court intrigue.

r-juarez-1939.plot: In the 1860s Napoleon III installs the Austrian archduke Maximilian as Emperor of Mexico. The idealistic Maximilian and his wife clash with the President Benito Juárez, who leads the fight for Mexican independence.

nominated: Actor in a Supporting Role — Brian Aherne

r-after-the-thin-man-1936.plot: Nick and Nora Charles come back to San Francisco for New Year's and are drawn into a murder involving Nora's snobbish family. Her cousin's husband has disappeared, and the couple trade cocktails and wisecracks while solving the case.

r-knives-out-2019.plot: When a wealthy crime novelist is found dead after his 85th birthday party, eccentric detective Benoit Blanc is hired to investigate. Every member of the novelist's squabbling family has a motive, and his nurse holds a crucial secret.

r-vigil-in-the-night-1940.plot: A dedicated nurse in an English hospital takes the blame when her younger sister's carelessness causes a child's death. Moving to a struggling industrial-town hospital, she works alongside an idealistic doctor fighting for better facilities, until an epidemic tests everyone.

r-the-lady-with-a-lamp-1951.plot: Florence Nightingale defies family expectations and Victorian prejudice to pursue nursing. Sent to the Crimean War, she battles army bureaucracy to clean up filthy military hospitals, becoming a national heroine and reformer.

r-viva-zapata-1952.plot: Emiliano Zapata, a peasant from Morelos, rises to lead an uprising for land reform during the Mexican Revolution. Victory brings power he distrusts, and his refusal to compromise makes him a target for former allies.

won: Actor in a Supporting Role — Anthony Quinn
nominated: Actor in a Leading Role — Marlon Brando

r-the-wild-bunch-1969.plot: In 1913, an aging gang of outlaws sees the frontier vanishing and plans one last robbery. After an ambush by railroad bounty hunters, led by a former member of the gang, they flee into revolutionary Mexico and take a dangerous job for a brutal general.
writers: Walon Green and Roy N. Sickner (story)

r-much-ado-about-nothing-1993.plot: Returning soldiers visit a sunny Italian estate, where a young couple's romance is threatened by a malicious plot, while their friends conspire to trick two sharp-tongued sparring partners into falling in love.

r-a-midsummer-night-s-dream-1999.plot: Shakespeare's comedy moved to late-19th-century Tuscany. Four young lovers flee into an enchanted forest, where quarreling fairy royals and a mischievous sprite meddle with their hearts, while amateur actors rehearse a play for a duke's wedding.

r-the-thief-of-bagdad-1940.plot: Betrayed by his scheming Grand Vizier, the young king of Bagdad is cast out and befriends a cheeky street thief. Together they set out to win back a captive princess and the throne, encountering a giant genie, a flying horse and a magical all-seeing eye.

r-holiday-1938.plot: A self-made young man engaged to a rich woman wants to take time off to enjoy life before working. Her stuffy family disapproves, but her free-thinking sister understands him.

r-morning-glory-1933.plot: A naive, chatty young actress from Vermont arrives in New York determined to become a great star. A producer and a playwright take an interest in her, and she gets her chance when a temperamental leading lady walks out.

won: Actress in a Leading Role — Katharine Hepburn

r-broadway-melody-of-1940-1940.plot: Two vaudeville dancers compete for a part in a Broadway show. A mix-up means the wrong partner gets the lead role, and both fall for the star.

r-born-to-dance-1936.plot: A sailor on shore leave falls for an aspiring dancer working at a lonely hearts club. A publicity stunt involving a famous Broadway star sets up a mix-up that may cost the dancer her chance, in a musical with Cole Porter songs.

r-the-sea-hawk-1940.plot: An English privateer raids Spanish ships with the quiet blessing of Queen Elizabeth I while Spain secretly assembles its Armada. A daring mission to Panama ends in betrayal and enslavement in the galleys, and he must escape to warn his queen of the threat.

nominated: Music (Original Song Score Or Adaptation Score)

r-the-black-swan-1942.plot: Reformed pirate Henry Morgan, now governor of Jamaica, enlists his old shipmate to help rid the Caribbean of former comrades still raiding. The swashbuckler kidnaps the haughty daughter of the previous governor, and their stormy romance unfolds amid sea battles and treachery.

r-the-crimson-pirate-1952.plot: A swashbuckling, acrobatic pirate captain schemes to profit by selling guns to island rebels and then betraying them to the Spanish. Falling for a rebel leader's daughter changes his plans, leading to a flamboyant battle with inventive gadgets.

r-oliver-twist-1948.plot: An orphan born in a workhouse is sold into apprenticeship, runs away to London and falls in with a gang of child pickpockets run by the crafty Fagin. A kindly gentleman offers him hope, but the brutal Bill Sikes and secrets about his birth endanger him.

setting.place: London and an English workhouse town

r-nicholas-nickleby-2002.plot: After his father's death, young Nicholas Nickleby seeks help from his cold, rich uncle, who sends him to teach at a brutal Yorkshire boarding school. Nicholas rebels, befriends an abused boy, and fights to protect his mother and sister.

r-the-personal-history-of-david-copperfi.plot: David Copperfield tells his own life story, from a cruel childhood and work in a bottle factory to a string of eccentric guardians and friends. Through poverty and fortune, he finds his voice as a writer.

r-les-miserables-1998.plot: Released after nineteen years in prison, Jean Valjean reinvents himself as a respected mayor and adoptive father. A relentless police inspector who knew him as a convict pursues him for years, up to the turmoil of Paris in 1832.

r-the-count-of-monte-cristo-1934.plot: A young sailor is betrayed by jealous rivals and imprisoned without trial in a grim island fortress. After years in prison, a fellow inmate reveals a hidden treasure, and the escaped prisoner returns to Paris as a mysterious count to take revenge.

r-the-hunchback-of-notre-dame-1939.plot: In medieval Paris, the deformed bell-ringer of Notre Dame is loved by no one until he meets a kind gypsy dancer. She is pursued by his master, a lustful judge, and when she is accused of murder he tries to save her.

nominated: Music (Original Song Score Or Adaptation Score)

r-the-bounty-1984.plot: A retelling of the mutiny on HMS Bounty, framed by Captain Bligh's court-martial: the voyage to Tahiti, the crew's seduction by island life, and the growing rift between Bligh and Fletcher Christian.

r-the-sea-wolf-1941.plot: After a ferry wreck in San Francisco Bay, a writer and a fugitive woman are pulled aboard a sealing ship ruled by a brilliant, brutal captain. Trapped among a mutinous crew, they and a rebellious young sailor plot to escape the captain's tyranny.

setting.place: San Francisco Bay; the Pacific on a sealing schooner

r-billy-budd-1962.plot: In 1797, a good-hearted, innocent young sailor is pressed into service aboard a British warship. His popularity with the crew draws the hatred of the ship's sadistic master-at-arms, and a sudden act of violence forces the captain to weigh the law against justice.
writers: Louis O. Coxe and Robert H. Chapman (play)

nominated: Actor in a Supporting Role — Terence Stamp

r-the-firefly-1937.plot: During Napoleon's occupation of Spain, a café singer works as a spy for the Spanish king. She is pursued across the country by a charming man who may be a spy for the other side.

r-destry-rides-again-1939.plot: In a lawless Western town run by a crooked saloon owner, the son of a famous lawman arrives as deputy, refusing to carry guns. His mild manner makes him a joke, until he wins over the saloon's singer and brings order his own way.

r-make-way-for-tomorrow-1937.plot: When an elderly couple lose their home in the Depression, none of their grown children can or will take both of them in. Forced to split up, they are shuttled between relatives, until a last day together in New York.

r-odd-man-out-1947.plot: A wounded Irish nationalist leader is left behind after a botched robbery in a Northern Irish city. Over one long night he stumbles through the streets as police, his comrades, the woman who loves him and various strangers each decide what to do about him.

r-the-wind-that-shakes-the-barley-2006.plot: In 1920 County Cork, a young doctor abandons his plans to work in London and joins his brother in the IRA fighting British forces. After a treaty divides the independence movement, the brothers find themselves on opposite sides of a civil war.

r-michael-collins-1996.plot: The life of Irish revolutionary leader Michael Collins, from the failed 1916 Easter Rising through his guerrilla campaign against British rule to the treaty that divided Ireland and plunged it into civil war.

r-gunga-din-1939.plot: Three British sergeants on India's northwest frontier fight a murderous cult. Aided by a water-carrier who dreams of becoming a soldier, they get into scrapes as one sergeant tries to leave the army to marry.

r-the-four-feathers-1939.plot: A young British officer resigns his commission on the eve of a campaign in Sudan and receives white feathers from his friends and fiancée as a sign of cowardice. To redeem himself he goes alone, disguised as a native, to the desert war.

r-the-charge-of-the-light-brigade-1936.plot: A British officer in India survives a massacre and swears vengeance on the local ruler responsible. The quest leads to the Crimean War, where he engineers the doomed cavalry charge at Balaclava, while competing with his brother for the same woman.
r-the-charge-of-the-light-brigade-1936.source: The Charge of the Light Brigade (Tennyson poem, inspiration)

nominated: Music (Original Song Score Or Adaptation Score)

r-the-band-wagon-1953.plot: A fading Hollywood song-and-dance star heads to Broadway for a comeback, but a pretentious director turns the light show into a pompous Faust adaptation. Clashing with his ballerina co-star, he must rescue the production and find his footing.

nominated: Music (Original Song Score Or Adaptation Score)

r-a-tale-of-two-cities-1958.plot: A dissolute English lawyer loves a woman married to a French aristocrat who renounced his heritage. When the French Revolution draws her husband back to Paris and toward the guillotine, the lawyer finds a chance at redemption.

r-the-scarlet-pimpernel-1934.plot: During the Reign of Terror, a mysterious Englishman known as the Scarlet Pimpernel rescues French aristocrats from the guillotine. In London he hides behind the persona of a foppish baronet, fooling even his wife, while a French agent hunts for him.

r-marie-antoinette-1938.plot: An Austrian archduchess marries the awkward heir to the French throne. As queen she lives a lavish life at Versailles and falls for a Swedish count, but revolution sweeps away the monarchy.
r-marie-antoinette-1938.source: Marie Antoinette: The Portrait of an Average Woman

nominated: Actor in a Supporting Role — Robert Morley
Actress in a Leading Role — Norma Shearer

r-the-prisoner-of-zenda-1937.plot: An English gentleman vacationing in a small European kingdom discovers he looks exactly like its king. When the king is drugged and kidnapped on the eve of his coronation, the visitor takes his place, and falls in love with the princess to be married to the king.

nominated: Music (Original Song Score Or Adaptation Score)

r-forever-amber-1947.plot: An ambitious country girl follows a dashing cavalier to Restoration London and uses her beauty and cunning to climb from debtors' prison to the court of Charles II. Through plague, fire and many lovers, she never stops longing for the one man she truly loves.

r-brief-encounter-1945.plot: A respectable suburban housewife meets a kind, married doctor in a railway station refreshment room. Their weekly meetings grow into a deep but unconsummated love affair, forcing them to weigh their passion against duty to their families.

setting.place: Milford, a fictional English town and its railway station

nominated: Actress in a Leading Role — Celia Johnson

r-voyage-to-italy-1954.plot: A cold English couple travels to Naples to sell an inherited villa. Separately exploring ruins, museums and catacombs, they confront the emptiness of their marriage and drift toward divorce.

r-nothing-sacred-1937.plot: A disgraced New York reporter learns of a Vermont woman supposedly dying of radium poisoning and brings her to the city as a sensational human-interest story. She is actually healthy, and both she and the reporter have reasons to keep the lie going.

r-a-nous-la-liberte-1931.plot: Two convicts plan an escape, but only one gets away; he rises to become a wealthy phonograph tycoon. When his old cellmate turns up as a worker on his assembly line, their renewed friendship pokes fun at mechanized modern life.

r-playtime-1967.plot: The bumbling Monsieur Hulot tries to keep an appointment in a Paris made of glass and steel, while a group of American tourists wanders through the same maze of offices and showrooms. Their paths cross at the chaotic opening night of a new restaurant, where the modern city finally loosens up.

r-sullivan-s-travels-1941.plot: A successful Hollywood director of light comedies wants to make a serious film about human suffering. Disguised as a hobo, he sets out to experience poverty firsthand, accompanied by a struggling young actress, but his journey takes a far harsher turn than planned.

r-being-there-1979.plot: A simple-minded gardener who knows the world only through television is turned out after his wealthy employer dies. Taken in by a powerful businessman, his plain remarks about gardening are mistaken for profound wisdom, and he rises to the heights of Washington influence.

won: Actor in a Supporting Role — Melvyn Douglas
nominated: Actor in a Leading Role — Peter Sellers

r-the-hudsucker-proxy-1994.plot: After a company founder's sudden death, scheming board members install a naive mailroom clerk as president to drive down the stock price. His odd invention and a fast-talking reporter complicate their plan.

r-romeo-juliet-1996.plot: Shakespeare's tale of two young lovers from feuding families is reimagined in a modern, gun-toting Verona Beach, keeping the original verse while rival gangs clash in the streets.

r-romeo-and-juliet-1954.plot: Shakespeare's young lovers from feuding Veronese families marry in secret, with tragic consequences, in a version shot on real Italian locations. The production emphasizes Renaissance painting-like visuals and authentic settings.

r-the-hurricane-1937.plot: A Polynesian sailor on a French-ruled South Seas island is jailed for striking a white man, and a rigid governor keeps lengthening his sentence. His repeated escapes to return to his wife coincide with a massive hurricane that threatens everyone on the island.

nominated: Actor in a Supporting Role — Thomas Mitchell
Music (Original Song Score Or Adaptation Score)

r-boom-town-1940.plot: Two wildcatters become friends and partners in the oil fields of Texas. When one marries the woman the other loved, their friendship becomes rivalry over the years, as they get rich and go broke.

r-earthquake-1974.plot: A massive earthquake devastates Los Angeles, collapsing buildings and threatening a dam above the city. An engineer caught between his wife and his lover, a suspended police sergeant and other survivors struggle through the wreckage.

r-ziegfeld-girl-1941.plot: Three young women are picked to join the glamorous Ziegfeld Follies: an elevator operator, a vaudeville singer and the wife of a struggling violinist. Fame changes each of them differently as they navigate romance, money and the pressures of Broadway stardom.

r-ziegfeld-follies-1945.plot: In heaven, the late showman Florenz Ziegfeld imagines one last spectacular revue. The film presents his dream as a series of musical numbers and comedy sketches featuring many of MGM's biggest stars.

r-the-jolson-story-1946.plot: The son of a Washington cantor runs off to join vaudeville and rises to become the most famous entertainer in America. His success on Broadway and in talking pictures comes at the cost of strains on his marriage to a dancer.

won: Music (Original Song Score Or Adaptation Score)
nominated: Actor in a Leading Role — Larry Parks
Actor in a Supporting Role — William Demarest

r-edison-the-man-1940.plot: A young Thomas Edison arrives in New York with little money but endless ideas. Setting up his workshop at Menlo Park with a loyal crew, he battles skeptics, financiers and repeated failures in his quest to build a practical electric light and power a city.

setting.place: New York City; Menlo Park, New Jersey

r-three-smart-girls-grow-up-1939.plot: The youngest of three sisters, Penny, sees her older sister engaged to the wrong man. She tries to fix the romances and keep the family happy.

r-the-parent-trap-1961.plot: Two girls who meet at summer camp start out as rivals before discovering they are identical twins, separated as babies when their parents divorced. They secretly switch places, each going home to the parent she has never known, and scheme to bring their mother and father back together.

r-mad-about-music-1938.plot: A girl at a Swiss boarding school, whose glamorous film-star mother keeps her a secret, invents a heroic absent father to impress her classmates. When challenged, she enlists a visiting English composer to pretend to be him.

nominated: Music (Original Song Score Or Adaptation Score)

r-a-star-is-born-1954.plot: A hard-drinking movie star discovers a gifted band singer and helps launch her to Hollywood stardom. They marry, but as her fame soars his career collapses, and his alcoholism threatens everything they share.

nominated: Actor in a Leading Role — James Mason
Actress in a Leading Role — Judy Garland
Music (Original Song Score Or Adaptation Score)

r-what-price-hollywood-1932.plot: A waitress is discovered by an alcoholic director and turned into a movie star. As her career rises and his falls into drink, her marriage to a polo-playing millionaire suffers, in a forerunner of A Star Is Born.

r-the-bad-and-the-beautiful-1952.plot: A director, a movie star and a writer each refuse to help a ruined Hollywood producer stage a comeback. In flashbacks, each recalls how the ruthless producer built them up while using and betraying them on his rise to power.

won: Actress in a Supporting Role — Gloria Grahame
nominated: Actor in a Leading Role — Kirk Douglas

r-the-old-man-and-the-sea-1958.plot: An aging Cuban fisherman, mocked for his long streak without a catch, sails far out and hooks a giant marlin. Their days-long struggle tests his endurance, and his triumph faces a brutal journey home.
r-the-old-man-and-the-sea-1958.source: The Old Man and the Sea

nominated: Actor in a Leading Role — Spencer Tracy

r-moby-dick-1956.plot: Young Ishmael signs aboard the whaler Pequod, only to learn that Captain Ahab cares for nothing but revenge on the white whale that took his leg. Ahab drives his crew across the oceans toward a fateful confrontation.

r-angels-with-dirty-faces-1938.plot: Two boyhood friends from a New York slum take different paths: one becomes a notorious gangster and the other a priest. When the gangster returns, the street kids idolize him, and the priest fights to keep them from following.

nominated: Actor in a Leading Role — James Cagney

r-the-petrified-forest-1936.plot: A drifting, disillusioned writer stops at a lonely diner in the Arizona desert, where a young waitress dreams of studying art in France. When a notorious gangster and his crew take the diner hostage, the writer makes a strange bargain.

r-jesse-james-1939.plot: When railroad agents drive Missouri farmers off their land and kill their mother, brothers Jesse and Frank James turn to robbing trains. Jesse becomes a folk hero, but his life as an outlaw strains his marriage.

r-black-narcissus-1947.plot: A group of Anglican nuns sets up a school and hospital in a remote former palace high in the Himalayas. The isolation, the wind, the beauty of the place and the presence of a cynical British agent unsettle them, awakening long-buried desires.

r-the-man-who-would-be-king-1975.plot: Two roguish former British soldiers in India set out for remote Kafiristan to make themselves kings. Through luck and nerve they conquer the tribes, and one is taken for a god, but his growing belief in his own divinity puts everything at risk.
r-the-man-who-would-be-king-1975.source: The Man Who Would Be King

r-brigadoon-1954.plot: Two American hunters lost in the Scottish Highlands stumble on a village that appears for only one day every hundred years. One falls in love with a local woman and must decide whether to leave the modern world behind forever.

r-first-love-1939.plot: An orphaned girl lives with her wealthy uncle's snobbish family, who treat her like a servant. When she sneaks into a society ball, she meets a handsome young man in this modern Cinderella story.

nominated: Music (Original Song Score Or Adaptation Score)

r-fantasia-1940.plot: Leopold Stokowski and the Philadelphia Orchestra perform eight classical pieces, each paired with a different burst of Disney animation: abstract shapes, dancing mushrooms, dinosaurs at the dawn of life, frolicking mythological creatures, and Mickey Mouse as a sorcerer's apprentice whose magic spirals out of control.

r-to-live-1994.plot: A wealthy young gambler loses his family's fortune and must start over with his wife. Across decades of civil war, the Great Leap Forward and the Cultural Revolution, the family struggles to survive repeated hardships.

r-red-sorghum-1987.plot: A young woman sent to marry an elderly winery owner in rural China finds love with a bold sedan bearer. After her husband's death, she runs the sorghum winery until the Japanese invasion brings brutality to their village.

r-dragon-seed-1944.plot: When the Japanese invade China in 1937, a peaceful farming family in a village near Nanking is torn apart. An outspoken young wife urges resistance while her father-in-law clings to neutrality, and the family must decide how to survive occupation.

nominated: Actress in a Supporting Role — Aline MacMahon

r-an-officer-and-a-spy-2019.plot: After Alfred Dreyfus is convicted of treason, officer Georges Picquart takes over French army intelligence and finds evidence pointing to a different traitor. Pursuing the truth puts his career and life at risk.

r-i-accuse-1958.plot: Jewish army officer Alfred Dreyfus is wrongly convicted of treason in 1890s France and sent to Devil's Island. As evidence points to another officer, writers and officials battle a military cover-up and widespread antisemitism to clear his name.
r-i-accuse-1958.source: Captain Dreyfus: The Story of a Mass Hysteria

r-there-s-no-business-like-show-business.plot: A vaudeville couple raise their three children as part of the family act. As the kids grow up, a son's romance with a nightclub singer and another son's crisis of calling strain the family over the years, all set to Irving Berlin songs.

nominated: Music (Original Song Score Or Adaptation Score)

r-holiday-inn-1942.plot: A singer leaves show business to run a Connecticut farm and turns it into an inn open only on holidays, with a show for each one. When his smooth-dancing former partner shows up and sets his sights on the inn's new star, a rivalry begins.

nominated: Music (Original Song Score Or Adaptation Score)

r-blue-skies-1946.plot: A dancer turned radio host recounts how his friendship with a restless nightclub singer was strained when both fell for the same chorus girl. Told in flashback across decades, the story unfolds through a parade of Irving Berlin songs.

nominated: Music (Original Song Score Or Adaptation Score)

r-men-of-boys-town-1941.plot: Father Flanagan's home for troubled boys faces money trouble while he tries to reach a hardened youth scarred by a brutal reform school. Whitey and the other boys rally to help, and Flanagan sets out to expose the abuses of the institution.

r-daughters-courageous-1939.plot: A mother of four daughters is about to remarry when her long-absent husband, a charming wanderer, returns home. At the same time one daughter falls for a cynical young drifter much like her father.

r-four-wives-1939.plot: The Lemp sisters return in this sequel to Four Daughters: one widowed sister discovers she is pregnant just as a new man enters her life. Meanwhile the other sisters face their own marriages and secrets.

r-the-rules-of-the-game-1939.plot: Wealthy French aristocrats and their servants gather for a weekend hunting party at a country château. Love affairs, flirtations and jealousies cross class lines, leading to tragedy.

r-stalag-17-1953.plot: In a German POW camp in 1944, a failed escape convinces American airmen there is an informer among them. Suspicion falls on a cynical sergeant who trades with the guards, and he must unmask the real spy to save himself.

won: Actor in a Leading Role — William Holden
nominated: Actor in a Supporting Role — Robert Strauss

r-a-man-escaped-1956.plot: In 1943, a captured French Resistance officer is held in a Gestapo-run prison in Lyon awaiting execution. With patience and improvised tools, he methodically prepares an escape, unsure whom he can trust.
r-a-man-escaped-1956.source: Un condamné à mort s'est échappé (André Devigny)

r-now-voyager-1942.plot: A repressed Boston spinster, crushed by her domineering mother, recovers under a kind psychiatrist's care. On a cruise she blossoms into a confident woman and falls in love with an unhappily married man, then must decide what kind of life she wants.

setting.place: Boston; a cruise to Rio de Janeiro

nominated: Actress in a Leading Role — Bette Davis
Actress in a Supporting Role — Gladys Cooper

r-the-old-maid-1939.plot: In Civil War-era Philadelphia, a woman has an illegitimate child with a soldier who is killed. Her cousin, who once loved the same man, takes the child to raise as her own, and the two women live in tension for years.

r-the-age-of-innocence-1993.plot: In 1870s New York high society, a well-connected lawyer engaged to a proper young woman falls in love with her unconventional cousin, a countess separated from her husband, and is torn between desire and duty.

nominated: Actress in a Supporting Role — Winona Ryder

r-educating-rita-1983.plot: A working-class Liverpool hairdresser enrolls in an Open University literature course and is tutored by a disillusioned, hard-drinking professor. As her mind opens, both of their lives change in unexpected ways.

nominated: Actor in a Leading Role — Michael Caine
Actress in a Leading Role — Julie Walters

r-the-importance-of-being-earnest-1952.plot: Two young Victorian gentlemen each invent an alter ego named Ernest to escape their obligations and court the women they love. Their deceptions tangle when both women insist on marrying someone called Ernest, and a formidable aunt demands answers.
