r-you-can-count-on-me-2000.plot: A single mother working at a small-town bank in upstate New York receives a visit from her drifter younger brother, orphaned with her as children. His stay stirs up old wounds, and both siblings face choices about their lives.

nominated: Actress in a Leading Role — Laura Linney

r-the-savages-2007.plot: Two adult siblings who have long kept their distance from their difficult father must care for him when dementia leaves him unable to live alone. Moving him into a nursing home forces them to confront each other and their own stalled lives.

nominated: Actress in a Leading Role — Laura Linney

r-the-long-walk-home-1990.plot: During the Montgomery bus boycott, a Black maid walks miles to work rather than ride segregated buses. Her white employer begins secretly driving her, a choice that puts her at odds with her husband and community.

r-me-before-you-2016.plot: A quirky small-town young woman takes a job as caregiver to a wealthy, embittered man paralyzed after an accident. As she tries to show him life is still worth living, the two grow close.

r-c-est-la-vie-2017.plot: A veteran wedding planner on the verge of retirement manages a lavish ceremony at a 17th-century French château. Over one long day and night, his chaotic team of staff threatens to derail everything.

r-mirror-1975.plot: A dying man's recollections drift between his childhood in the countryside before and during World War II, his mother, his own failed marriage and newsreel images of twentieth-century Soviet history, woven into a non-linear, dreamlike self-portrait.

r-the-fountain-2006.plot: Three interwoven stories span a thousand years: a Spanish conquistador seeking the Tree of Life, a modern scientist racing to cure his dying wife's cancer, and a lone traveler drifting through space toward a dying star. Each is driven by love and the fear of death.

setting.place: Spain and New Spain; United States; deep space

r-black-beauty-1994.plot: A handsome black horse narrates his own life, from a happy youth on an English estate through a series of owners kind and cruel, as he is sold from one hard job to another.

r-the-black-stallion-1979.plot: A boy shipwrecked off the coast of North Africa is stranded on a desert island with a wild Arabian horse, and the two form a deep bond. Rescued and back home, he trains the stallion with an old jockey to race against the fastest horses in America.

setting.place: Mediterranean sea and desert island; United States

nominated: Actor in a Supporting Role — Mickey Rooney

r-joyeux-noel-2005.plot: On Christmas Eve 1914, French, Scottish and German soldiers facing each other in the trenches lay down their arms for an unofficial truce. They share songs, food and football, then must face the consequences from their commanders.

r-miracle-2004.plot: Coach Herb Brooks assembles a team of young amateur college players to represent the United States in ice hockey at the 1980 Winter Olympics. Through grueling training, he forges them into a unit capable of challenging the seemingly unbeatable Soviet squad.

r-away-from-her-2006.plot: After decades of marriage, a retired professor's wife begins losing her memory to Alzheimer's and chooses to enter a care facility. When she forms a close bond with another resident and seems to forget her husband, he must confront their shared past and what love asks of him.
r-away-from-her-2006.source: The Bear Came Over the Mountain

nominated: Actress in a Leading Role — Julie Christie

r-cache-2005.plot: A Parisian television host and his wife start receiving anonymous videotapes showing long surveillance of their home, accompanied by disturbing drawings. The tapes stir up his guilt over a childhood incident linked to France's colonial past.

r-45-years-2015.plot: A week before their 45th wedding anniversary, a retired English couple receives news that the body of the husband's former lover has been found frozen in a Swiss glacier. The revelation quietly unsettles the wife's sense of their entire marriage.

nominated: Actress in a Leading Role — Charlotte Rampling

r-where-the-wild-things-are-2009.plot: After a fight with his mother, lonely, imaginative young Max runs away and sails to an island inhabited by huge, wild creatures. They crown him their king, but he soon finds that ruling and caring for them is harder than he imagined.

setting.place: American suburb; island of the Wild Things

r-sweeney-todd-the-demon-barber-of-fleet.plot: Returning to London after years of unjust exile, barber Benjamin Barker, now called Sweeney Todd, seeks revenge on the judge who stole his wife and daughter. Teaming with a pie-shop owner downstairs, his vengeance turns into a grisly business.
r-sweeney-todd-the-demon-barber-of-fleet.source: Sweeney Todd: The Demon Barber of Fleet Street

nominated: Actor in a Leading Role — Johnny Depp

r-the-phantom-of-the-opera-2004.plot: A disfigured musical genius lurking beneath the Paris Opera House secretly tutors a young chorus singer and becomes obsessed with her. When she falls for a childhood sweetheart, the Phantom's jealousy turns dangerous.
r-the-phantom-of-the-opera-2004.source: The Phantom of the Opera (Andrew Lloyd Webber musical)

r-all-is-lost-2013.plot: Alone on a sailing voyage in the Indian Ocean, an unnamed man wakes to find his yacht holed by a drifting shipping container. With his radio dead and storms coming, he uses every skill he has to survive.

r-amistad-1997.plot: After African captives seize control of the Spanish slave ship Amistad, they are taken into custody in the United States. A legal battle over their freedom follows, reaching the Supreme Court.

nominated: Actor in a Supporting Role — Anthony Hopkins

r-punch-drunk-love-2002.plot: A lonely, anxious small-business owner prone to sudden rages tries to cope with seven overbearing sisters and a scam that spirals into extortion. Then a gentle woman enters his life, and an unlikely romance gives him the courage to stand up for himself.

setting.place: San Fernando Valley, Los Angeles; Hawaii

r-garden-state-2004.plot: A numb, heavily medicated young actor returns to his New Jersey hometown for his mother's funeral after years away. Reconnecting with old friends and meeting a quirky, compulsive liar, he begins to feel again and confront his strained relationship with his father.

r-the-big-sick-2017.plot: Pakistani-American comedian Kumail falls for Emily, a grad student, while hiding the romance from his traditional family. When she suddenly falls into a medically induced coma, he finds himself bonding with her parents at the hospital.

r-skyfall-2012.plot: After a botched mission leaves James Bond presumed dead, MI6 comes under attack and M's past returns to haunt her. Bond resurfaces to track a former agent with a personal vendetta, a hunt that leads back to Bond's own childhood home.

r-another-round-2020.plot: Four burned-out high school teachers in Copenhagen test a theory that keeping a small amount of alcohol in the blood makes life better. The experiment lifts their work and spirits at first, then escalates with mixed results.

r-doubt-2008.plot: At a Catholic school in the Bronx, a rigid nun-principal grows suspicious that the charismatic parish priest has an improper relationship with the school's first Black student. With no proof, she wages a battle of wills against him, drawing in a naive young teacher.

nominated: Actor in a Supporting Role — Philip Seymour Hoffman
Actress in a Leading Role — Meryl Streep
Actress in a Supporting Role — Amy Adams
Actress in a Supporting Role — Viola Davis

r-body-of-lies-2008.plot: A CIA operative working in the field across the Middle East hunts an elusive terrorist leader, while his boss directs him by phone from suburban America. Building an alliance with Jordan's intelligence chief, he devises a risky deception that puts lives in danger.

r-harriet-2019.plot: Escaping slavery in Maryland, Araminta Ross reaches freedom in Philadelphia and takes the name Harriet Tubman. She repeatedly returns south at great risk to lead others to freedom along the Underground Railroad.

nominated: Actress in a Leading Role — Cynthia Erivo

r-united-93-2006.plot: Unfolding in near real time on September 11, 2001, the film follows air traffic controllers and military officials struggling to grasp the attacks. Aboard United Flight 93, passengers and crew realize their plane has been hijacked and decide to fight back.

setting.place: United Airlines Flight 93; US air traffic control centers

r-a-hijacking-2012.plot: Somali pirates seize a Danish cargo ship in the Indian Ocean and hold its crew for ransom. While the ship's cook endures captivity on board, the company's CEO negotiates the price of their lives from an office in Copenhagen.

r-moon-2009.plot: Near the end of a solitary three-year contract on a lunar mining base, astronaut Sam Bell has only a computer for company. After an accident, he encounters something that makes him question his own identity and his employer's intentions.

r-the-magdalene-sisters-2002.plot: Three young Irish women are sent to a Catholic-run Magdalene laundry for perceived moral failings, such as being sexually assaulted or bearing a child out of wedlock. Inside, they endure years of forced labor and cruelty from the nuns while searching for any way out.

r-the-lady-in-the-van-2015.plot: Playwright Alan Bennett lets an eccentric, homeless woman park her dilapidated van in his London driveway for what he assumes will be a short stay. She remains for fifteen years, and he gradually uncovers the secrets of her past.
r-the-lady-in-the-van-2015.source: The Lady in the Van (Alan Bennett)

r-days-of-thunder-1990.plot: A hot-headed young racer with raw talent joins the NASCAR circuit under a veteran crew chief. After a serious crash, he must overcome fear and rivalry to compete again, with a neurosurgeon at his side.

r-grand-prix-1966.plot: Over a single Formula One season, four drivers from different countries compete on Europe's most dangerous circuits. An American blamed for a crash, a veteran French champion, a reckless Briton and an Italian playboy chase the title while their relationships strain under the constant risk of death.

setting.place: Formula One circuits in Europe (Monaco to Monza)

r-boiler-room-2000.plot: A college dropout running an illegal casino from his apartment joins a Long Island brokerage that promises quick riches. He becomes a star at high-pressure cold-call selling, then begins to suspect the firm is a massive fraud.

r-wall-street-1987.plot: An ambitious young stockbroker gets close to a ruthless corporate raider by feeding him insider tips. Seduced by wealth, he is forced to choose when his mentor targets the airline where his father works.

won: Actor in a Leading Role — Michael Douglas

r-lone-survivor-2013.plot: A four-man Navy SEAL team is sent into the Afghan mountains to locate a Taliban leader. After a fateful decision about shepherds who stumble upon them, they are ambushed by a much larger force and fight desperately to survive.

r-synecdoche-new-york-2008.plot: A hypochondriac theater director, abandoned by his wife and convinced he is dying, receives a grant and sets out to create a work of brutal honesty. Inside a vast warehouse he builds a life-size replica of New York, and the project consumes decades.

r-eighth-grade-2018.plot: Painfully shy thirteen-year-old Kayla posts upbeat advice videos online while barely speaking at school. In her last week of eighth grade, she awkwardly tries to connect with classmates and her devoted single father.

r-ad-astra-2019.plot: An emotionally detached astronaut travels to the edge of the solar system to find his father, who vanished on a deep-space mission decades earlier. Mysterious power surges threatening Earth may be linked to him.

r-the-butler-2013.plot: Cecil Gaines leaves the cotton fields of Georgia and rises to become a butler at the White House, serving presidents across decades. While he quietly serves, his elder son joins the civil rights movement, straining their relationship.
r-the-butler-2013.source: A Butler Well Served by This Election

r-enigma-2001.plot: In 1943, a brilliant codebreaker recovering from a breakdown returns to Bletchley Park when the Germans change their naval codes. He also searches for his former lover, who has vanished, uncovering a possible spy among his colleagues.

r-operation-mincemeat-2021.plot: In 1943, two British intelligence officers devise a daring deception: planting fake invasion plans on a corpse and letting it wash ashore in Spain. They hope to fool Hitler into misjudging where the Allies will strike.

r-still-alice-2014.plot: A renowned linguistics professor at Columbia is diagnosed with early-onset Alzheimer's disease shortly after turning fifty. As her memory and sense of self slip away, she and her family struggle to adapt.

won: Actress in a Leading Role — Julianne Moore

r-bird-1988.plot: A portrait of jazz saxophonist Charlie Parker, tracing his musical genius, his marriage to Chan, and the heroin addiction and health problems that cut his life short.

r-drumline-2002.plot: A gifted but cocky street drummer from Harlem earns a scholarship to an Atlanta university famous for its marching band. His talent clashes with the band's discipline, a demanding director and a rival section leader as a big competition approaches.

r-falling-down-1993.plot: An unemployed defense worker abandons his car in a Los Angeles traffic jam and sets out on foot to get home. His frustrations at everyday indignities escalate into a violent rampage while a retiring cop tracks him.

r-the-spy-who-came-in-from-the-cold-1965.plot: A weary British intelligence agent, whose East German network has been destroyed, agrees to one last mission: to pose as a disgraced defector in order to discredit a ruthless enemy spymaster. The operation turns out to be far more cynical than he was told.
r-the-spy-who-came-in-from-the-cold-1965.source: The Spy Who Came in from the Cold

nominated: Actor in a Leading Role — Richard Burton

r-far-and-away-1992.plot: A poor tenant farmer and his landlord's headstrong daughter flee Ireland together for America. Scraping by in Boston, they dream of claiming free land in the Oklahoma Land Run.

r-soul-2020.plot: A middle school music teacher finally lands his dream jazz gig, then falls into a manhole and ends up in the afterlife. Desperate to return, he teams with a cynical unborn soul who sees no point in living.

setting.place: New York City; the Great Before

r-inside-out-2-2024.plot: As Riley turns thirteen, new emotions led by Anxiety move into Headquarters and push Joy and the others aside. At a hockey camp, Riley's sense of self is reshaped while the original emotions try to get back.

r-turning-red-2022.plot: Thirteen-year-old Mei Lee, torn between being her mother's dutiful daughter and a boy-band-obsessed teen, discovers that strong emotions turn her into a giant red panda. She must learn to manage the family curse.

r-mad-max-2-the-road-warrior-1981.plot: In a fuel-starved wasteland, the drifter Max reluctantly helps a fortified community of settlers protect their oil refinery from a savage gang of marauders, culminating in a desperate tanker run across the desert.

r-furiosa-a-mad-max-saga-2024.plot: Snatched from her home as a child, young Furiosa falls into the hands of a warlord's biker horde in a post-apocalyptic wasteland. Over many years she survives, hardens and plans her way back home and her revenge.

r-short-term-12-2013.plot: Grace, a dedicated young supervisor at a foster-care facility for at-risk teenagers, balances her demanding job with a relationship with a coworker. When a troubled new girl arrives, her story stirs up painful memories Grace has long buried.

r-she-said-2022.plot: New York Times reporters Jodi Kantor and Megan Twohey investigate long-rumored sexual misconduct by Harvey Weinstein. Persuading survivors to speak on the record, they break a story that helps spark the #MeToo movement.

r-trading-places-1983.plot: Two wealthy commodities brokers make a bet over nature versus nurture, swapping the lives of their snobbish managing director and a streetwise hustler. When the pair learn they were pawns, they plot revenge.

nominated: Music (Original Song Score Or Adaptation Score)

r-dumb-money-2023.plot: During the pandemic, a modest financial analyst posting online videos sparks a frenzy of small investors buying GameStop stock. Their rally squeezes powerful hedge funds that had bet against the company.

r-the-grey-2011.plot: A plane carrying oil workers crashes in the frozen Alaskan wilderness. Led by a hunter hired to protect the company from wolves, the few survivors try to trek to safety while a pack of wolves stalks them through the snow.

r-man-in-the-wilderness-1971.plot: During a fur-trapping expedition on the American frontier, a guide is mauled by a grizzly bear and left for dead by his companions. Alone and badly wounded, he crawls back to life and sets out after the party that abandoned him.

r-liz-and-the-blue-bird-2018.plot: Two close friends in a high school concert band, an oboist and a flutist, rehearse a duet based on a fairy tale about a girl and a bird. As graduation nears, the story mirrors the unspoken tension in their own relationship.

r-i-want-to-eat-your-pancreas-2018.plot: A withdrawn high school boy discovers that a cheerful, popular classmate is secretly dying of a pancreatic illness. As the only one who knows, he becomes her companion for the time she has left, slowly opening up to the world.
r-i-want-to-eat-your-pancreas-2018.source: I Want to Eat Your Pancreas

r-chak-de-india-2007.plot: Disgraced after a loss that led to accusations of treachery, a former Indian hockey captain returns years later to coach the neglected national women's team. He must overcome the players' regional rivalries and egos to forge a team that can compete at the World Cup.

r-lagaan-2001.plot: In 1893, villagers in drought-stricken central India cannot pay the crushing land tax imposed by British officers. A defiant young farmer accepts a wager: if the villagers beat the British at cricket, the tax will be waived for three years.

r-bhaag-milkha-bhaag-2013.plot: Milkha Singh survives the horrors of Partition as a boy and later finds his calling as a runner in the Indian Army. Driven by trauma and discipline, he becomes one of India's greatest athletes, chasing Olympic glory.

r-ma-rainey-s-black-bottom-2020.plot: During a sweltering recording session in 1927 Chicago, blues singer Ma Rainey battles white producers for control of her music. Meanwhile her ambitious young trumpeter clashes with the band over his own plans.

nominated: Actor in a Leading Role — Chadwick Boseman
Actress in a Leading Role — Viola Davis

r-the-piano-lesson-2024.plot: In 1936 Pittsburgh, a brother and sister clash over their family's heirloom piano, carved with images of enslaved ancestors. He wants to sell it to buy land; she refuses, and a ghostly presence haunts the house.

r-unbroken-2014.plot: Olympic runner Louis Zamperini survives a WWII bomber crash in the Pacific and drifts for weeks on a raft. Captured by the Japanese navy, he endures years in brutal prison camps, singled out by a sadistic guard.

r-thunderbolt-and-lightfoot-1974.plot: A veteran bank robber posing as a preacher escapes his old partners with help from a cocky young drifter. Teaming up with the hostile former gang, they plan to repeat a past heist on a Montana armory vault.

nominated: Actor in a Supporting Role — Jeff Bridges

r-the-umbrellas-of-cherbourg-1964.plot: In the seaside town of Cherbourg, a young woman who works in her mother's umbrella shop falls in love with a garage mechanic. When he is drafted to fight in Algeria, she finds herself pregnant and pressured toward a different future, in a story told entirely through song.

nominated: Music (Original Song Score Or Adaptation Score)

r-new-york-new-york-1977.plot: On V-J Day, a cocky saxophonist meets a talented singer, and they fall into a stormy romance while touring with a big band. As her career takes off and his jazz ambitions stall, his temper and jealousy strain their marriage.

r-the-pursuit-of-happyness-2006.plot: In early-1980s San Francisco, a struggling salesman of bone-density scanners takes an unpaid stockbroker internship. Evicted and raising his young son alone, he juggles homelessness and fierce competition while chasing a better life.

nominated: Actor in a Leading Role — Will Smith

r-the-kite-runner-2007.plot: A boy from a wealthy Kabul family betrays his loyal friend, the son of his father's servant, and carries the guilt to a new life in California. Decades later, a phone call draws him back to Taliban-ruled Afghanistan for a chance at redemption.

r-three-colors-blue-1993.plot: After her husband, a famous composer, and their daughter die in a car crash, a woman tries to cut herself off from her past and all attachments in Paris. Fragments of his unfinished music keep pulling her back.

r-if-beale-street-could-talk-2018.plot: In 1970s Harlem, a pregnant young woman and her family race to clear her fiancé, a sculptor jailed for a crime he did not commit. Their tender love story unfolds alongside the injustice that separates them.

won: Actress in a Supporting Role — Regina King

r-happy-together-1997.plot: Two Hong Kong men on a trip to Argentina break up and reunite over and over in Buenos Aires. Stranded and broke, one takes odd jobs and dreams of going home, while their volatile, tender relationship pulls them together and apart.

r-pariah-2011.plot: Alike, a 17-year-old Brooklyn girl, is quietly coming to terms with being a lesbian while hiding it from her religious mother. Torn between her family and her emerging identity, she navigates first love, friendship and growing tension at home.

r-weathering-with-you-2019.plot: A teenage runaway in a perpetually rainy Tokyo meets a girl who can make the sun shine by praying. They turn her gift into a small business, but her power comes with a cost tied to the weather itself.

r-suzume-2022.plot: A high school girl in Kyushu accidentally releases a supernatural force through a mysterious door in some ruins. Teaming with a young man cursed into a child's chair, she travels across Japan closing doors that unleash earthquakes.

r-the-girl-who-leapt-through-time-2006.plot: A carefree Tokyo high school girl discovers she can leap back in time and uses the power for trivial fixes, from acing tests to replaying karaoke sessions. Her meddling starts to have consequences for her two closest friends, forcing her to face her feelings.
r-the-girl-who-leapt-through-time-2006.source: The Girl Who Leapt Through Time

r-i-am-love-2009.plot: A Russian-born woman married into a wealthy Milanese industrial dynasty lives a polished but stifling life. When she falls for a talented chef who is her son's friend, her passion threatens to upend the family's order.

r-the-book-of-life-2014.plot: In a Mexican town, two childhood friends compete for the love of the same woman, while two gods wager on the outcome. On the Day of the Dead, one of them journeys through the vibrant Land of the Remembered to win her heart and save his town.

r-encanto-2021.plot: In the mountains of Colombia, the Madrigal family lives in a magical house that gives each child a special gift, except Mirabel. When the magic begins to fade, the ordinary girl may be the family's only hope.

r-their-finest-2016.plot: During the London Blitz, a young woman is hired to write the female dialogue for a British propaganda film about the Dunkirk evacuation. Working alongside a cynical screenwriter and a vain veteran actor, she finds her own voice.
r-their-finest-2016.source: Their Finest Hour and a Half

r-tenet-2020.plot: A CIA operative known only as the Protagonist is recruited into a shadowy mission involving objects whose flow of time runs backwards. Armed with one word, he races to stop a Russian oligarch from triggering a global catastrophe.

setting.place: Kyiv, Mumbai, Tallinn, Oslo, Amalfi Coast

r-us-2019.plot: A family's beach vacation in Santa Cruz turns into a nightmare when menacing doppelgängers of themselves appear outside their house at night. The mother, haunted by a childhood experience, must fight to protect her family.

r-nope-2022.plot: Siblings who run a struggling horse ranch for Hollywood productions notice something strange hiding in the clouds above their California valley. They set out to capture proof of it on camera, with dangerous results.

r-the-road-2009.plot: Years after an unexplained catastrophe has killed most life on Earth, a father and his young son walk south through a gray, ash-covered America. Scavenging for food and hiding from cannibal gangs, the father struggles to keep his boy alive and decent.

r-the-duke-of-burgundy-2014.plot: In a secluded European village, an entomologist and her younger lover enact an elaborate ritual of domination and submission. As their games repeat, the strain between what each truly wants threatens their relationship.

r-the-handmaiden-2016.plot: In 1930s Japanese-occupied Korea, a con man recruits a pickpocket to pose as a handmaiden to a reclusive heiress, as part of a plan to marry her and seize her fortune. But the women's growing intimacy upends everyone's scheme.

r-kill-the-messenger-2014.plot: Journalist Gary Webb uncovers evidence linking the CIA to Contra fundraising through cocaine sales in American cities. After his explosive series is published, he becomes the target of a campaign to discredit him that threatens his career and family.
r-kill-the-messenger-2014.source: Kill the Messenger (Nick Schou) and Dark Alliance (Gary Webb)

r-creature-from-the-black-lagoon-1954.plot: A scientific expedition in the Amazon goes looking for fossils of a prehistoric amphibian man and finds a living one. The gill-man becomes fixated on the lone woman aboard, and the team becomes trapped in its lagoon.

r-crimson-peak-2015.plot: An aspiring author who can see ghosts marries a charming English baronet and moves into his crumbling mansion with his cold sister. The house, built on blood-red clay, holds secrets and spirits that warn her of danger.

r-edward-scissorhands-1990.plot: An artificial man left unfinished, with scissor blades for hands, is taken in by a kindly Avon lady from a pastel suburb. His topiary and haircuts make him a local sensation, until suspicion turns the neighbors against him.

r-calvary-2014.plot: During confession, a good-hearted priest in a small Irish village is told by an unseen parishioner that he will be killed in a week, as revenge for abuse committed by another priest. He spends the following days ministering to his troubled, cynical flock.

r-premam-2015.plot: Told in three chapters across his life, a young man from Kerala experiences love three times: a teenage crush, a college romance with a lecturer, and an adult love found later on. Each relationship shapes who he becomes.

r-the-lunchbox-2013.plot: A misdelivered lunchbox in Mumbai's famous tiffin system connects a lonely young housewife with a widowed office worker nearing retirement. Through notes tucked into the meals, the two strangers begin an intimate correspondence that makes each reconsider the course of their life.

r-captain-america-the-winter-soldier-201.plot: Steve Rogers, adjusting to modern life while working for S.H.I.E.L.D., uncovers a conspiracy that rots the agency from within. Hunted by his own side, he teams up with Black Widow and a new ally while facing a lethal masked assassin with a link to his past.

r-the-avengers-2012.plot: When the exiled god Loki steals a powerful energy source and plans to bring an alien army to Earth, Nick Fury assembles a team of superheroes. Iron Man, Captain America, Thor, the Hulk, Black Widow and Hawkeye must learn to work together.

r-sorry-to-bother-you-2018.plot: A struggling Oakland telemarketer discovers that using a 'white voice' makes him a sales star. His rise into an elite sales tier pits him against striking coworkers and exposes a bizarre corporate scheme.

r-thor-ragnarok-2017.plot: Imprisoned on a garbage planet ruled by an eccentric despot, Thor is forced into gladiator combat against an old ally. He must escape and race home to stop his long-lost sister, the goddess of death, from conquering Asgard.

r-shang-chi-and-the-legend-of-the-ten-ri.plot: San Francisco valet Shaun is forced to confront his past when assassins sent by his father attack him. He is Shang-Chi, son of the ancient leader of the Ten Rings, and must stop his father's dangerous quest.

r-rocketman-2019.plot: Told as a fantasy musical, the story follows shy piano prodigy Reginald Dwight as he becomes flamboyant superstar Elton John. His meteoric rise, partnership with Bernie Taupin and struggles with addiction unfold through his songs.

r-straight-outta-compton-2015.plot: In mid-1980s Compton, five young men form the rap group N.W.A, whose raw lyrics about life on the streets make them stars and lightning rods. Fame brings money disputes, a manipulative manager and fractures that break the group apart.

r-y-tu-mama-tambien-2001.plot: Two teenage best friends from Mexico City, one rich and one middle-class, invite an older Spanish woman on a road trip to a beach that may not exist. Along the way, desire, rivalry and secrets reshape their friendship.

r-los-olvidados-1950.plot: In the slums on the outskirts of Mexico City, a teenage delinquent escapes reform school and drags a younger boy into his violent world. The younger boy longs for his mother's affection and a decent life but can't escape the cycle of poverty and crime.

r-teenage-mutant-ninja-turtles-mutant-ma.plot: Four teenage turtle brothers, raised in New York's sewers by their rat father, long to be accepted by the world above. With the help of a high school journalist, they take on a mysterious crime syndicate and an army of mutants.

r-puss-in-boots-the-last-wish-2022.plot: Having burned through eight of his nine lives, Puss in Boots is suddenly afraid of death. He sets out to find a mythical Wishing Star to restore them, racing rival fortune-seekers and a relentless bounty hunter.

r-the-lobster-2015.plot: In a dystopian society where single people must find a partner within 45 days or be turned into an animal, a newly single man checks into a strange hotel. He escapes to the woods and joins a group of loners with their own strict rules.

setting.place: Hotel and woods in Ireland; a city

r-marie-antoinette-2006.plot: Sent from Austria as a teenager to marry the future Louis XVI, Marie Antoinette struggles with the rigid etiquette and isolation of Versailles. She seeks escape in lavish parties, fashion and friendships as revolution builds outside the palace gates.

r-captain-america-civil-war-2016.plot: After a mission causes civilian casualties, the world's governments demand that the Avengers submit to oversight. The heroes split into opposing factions led by Captain America and Iron Man, with Bucky Barnes's past at the center of the conflict.

setting.place: Lagos; Vienna; Berlin; Siberia; New York

r-guardians-of-the-galaxy-vol-3-2023.plot: When Rocket is gravely wounded, the Guardians race across the galaxy to save him. Their mission forces them to confront Rocket's painful origins and the cruel scientist who created him.

r-ferrari-2023.plot: In the summer of 1957, Enzo Ferrari's company faces bankruptcy and his marriage is strained by grief and a secret second family. He stakes everything on winning the dangerous Mille Miglia road race across Italy.
r-ferrari-2023.source: Enzo Ferrari: The Man, the Cars, the Races

r-le-mans-1971.plot: An American driver returns to the 24 Hours of Le Mans a year after a crash that killed a rival. Over one grueling day and night of racing, he battles a German competitor and his own memories, shot largely as real on-track footage with little dialogue.

r-hunt-for-the-wilderpeople-2016.plot: A defiant foster kid finds a home with a warm aunt and her gruff husband on a remote New Zealand farm. After a sudden change, the boy and his reluctant uncle end up on the run in the bush, becoming the targets of a national manhunt.

r-arthur-christmas-2011.plot: Santa's operation has become a high-tech military-style machine run by his efficient elder son. When one child's present is accidentally left undelivered, Santa's clumsy, kindhearted younger son Arthur sets off with his grandfather on a frantic night mission to deliver it.

r-the-nightmare-before-christmas-1993.plot: Jack Skellington, the Pumpkin King of Halloween Town, grows bored with frights and stumbles into Christmas Town. Enchanted, he decides to take over the holiday himself, with disastrous results.

r-scenes-from-a-marriage-1974.plot: A seemingly happy professional couple in Sweden is shaken when the husband announces he has fallen for another woman. Across a decade of separation, reconciliations and new partners, they keep returning to each other in long, raw conversations.

r-blue-valentine-2010.plot: A working-class couple's marriage is shown at two moments: the giddy early days of their romance and its painful collapse years later. Scenes alternate between past and present to trace how love curdled into resentment.

nominated: Actress in a Leading Role — Michelle Williams

r-burning-2018.plot: An aspiring writer in rural South Korea reconnects with a childhood acquaintance, who returns from Africa with a wealthy, enigmatic new friend. When she suddenly disappears, his obsession with the stranger's odd hobby deepens into suspicion.

r-hoffa-1992.plot: The life of the Teamsters union leader Jimmy Hoffa, told through the eyes of a loyal friend. It follows his rise from labor organizer to powerful and corrupt boss, and his clashes with the government.

r-1776-1972.plot: In the sweltering summer of 1776, John Adams pushes a reluctant Continental Congress toward declaring independence from Britain. With Benjamin Franklin and Thomas Jefferson, he bargains, argues and sings through the debates leading to the Declaration.

r-fruitvale-station-2013.plot: A 22-year-old in Oakland tries to turn his life around on the last day of 2008, spending time with his girlfriend, daughter and mother. Following him through that ordinary day, the film builds to his fatal encounter with transit police in the early hours of New Year's.

r-ed-wood-1994.plot: An affectionate portrait of the cheerfully untalented 1950s filmmaker Ed Wood, his ragtag crew of collaborators, and his friendship with the aging, forgotten horror star Bela Lugosi.

won: Actor in a Supporting Role — Martin Landau

r-the-farewell-2019.plot: When her beloved grandmother is diagnosed with terminal cancer, a Chinese-American writer travels to China with her family. Following tradition, they hide the diagnosis from her, staging a hasty wedding as an excuse to say goodbye.

r-the-joy-luck-club-1993.plot: Four Chinese immigrant women who meet to play mahjong share their painful pasts in China, while their American-born daughters navigate their own lives. The stories reveal the bonds and misunderstandings between the generations.

r-the-rider-2017.plot: After a severe head injury ends his rodeo career, a young Lakota cowboy in South Dakota searches for a new identity and purpose. Played by non-professional actors drawn from real life, the story closely mirrors their own experiences.

r-saltburn-2023.plot: An outsider student at Oxford befriends a charismatic, aristocratic classmate. Invited to spend the summer at his friend's eccentric family estate, Saltburn, he becomes increasingly entwined in their privileged world.

r-hard-candy-2005.plot: A fourteen-year-old girl meets a thirty-something photographer she has been chatting with online and goes back to his house. There the tables turn, as she reveals she has come to expose and punish him for what she believes he has done.

r-revenge-2017.plot: A young woman on a romantic getaway with her wealthy married lover in the desert is assaulted by one of his friends and left for dead. She survives and turns the hunt around on the three men.

r-iris-2001.plot: The love story of novelist and philosopher Iris Murdoch and her husband, critic John Bayley, shown in two eras: their spirited courtship at 1950s Oxford, and decades later, as Alzheimer's disease slowly erodes her brilliant mind.

won: Actor in a Supporting Role — Jim Broadbent
nominated: Actress in a Leading Role — Judi Dench
Actress in a Supporting Role — Kate Winslet

r-molly-s-game-2017.plot: After a career-ending skiing injury, Olympic hopeful Molly Bloom runs an exclusive high-stakes poker game for celebrities and businessmen. When the FBI arrests her, her only ally is a lawyer who learns there is more to her than tabloids report.

r-71-2014.plot: During the Troubles in 1971, a young British soldier is accidentally left behind by his unit after a riot in Belfast. Wounded and alone in hostile streets, he must survive a single night while various factions hunt for him.

r-la-famille-belier-2014.plot: Teenage Paula is the only hearing member of her deaf farming family and serves as their interpreter. When a music teacher discovers her singing talent and pushes her to audition for a prestigious Paris school, she must weigh her dream against her family's need for her.

r-sing-street-2016.plot: In 1985 Dublin, a teenage boy forced into a tough school forms a band to impress a mysterious girl. Inspired by the new wave music his brother loves, he writes songs and makes music videos as his family falls apart.

r-idiocracy-2006.plot: A thoroughly average Army librarian is chosen for a secret hibernation experiment that is soon forgotten. He wakes five hundred years later in a society so dumbed-down that he is now the smartest man alive.

r-wag-the-dog-1997.plot: Days before an election, the US President is hit by a sex scandal. A political fixer hires a Hollywood producer to distract the public by staging a fake war with Albania, complete with invented footage, songs and heroes.

nominated: Actor in a Leading Role — Dustin Hoffman

r-mars-attacks-1996.plot: A fleet of Martian flying saucers arrives on Earth. While the US government hopes for peace, the gleeful invaders start zapping everyone in sight, and an assortment of unlikely Americans must find a way to fight back.

r-wheel-of-fortune-and-fantasy-2021.plot: Three separate stories follow women navigating coincidences, regrets and missed connections: a love triangle, a seduction plot gone wrong, and a chance meeting between two women who mistake each other for someone else.

r-perfect-days-2023.plot: Hirayama, a quiet man who cleans public toilets in Tokyo, lives a contented routine of work, cassette tapes, books and photographing trees. A series of unexpected encounters gently reveals more about his past.

r-dune-1984.plot: In the far future, the young heir of a noble house is sent with his family to the desert planet Arrakis, sole source of the precious spice. Betrayed by rivals, he takes refuge among the desert's native people.

r-visaranai-2015.plot: Four Tamil migrant laborers in Andhra Pradesh are arrested and brutally tortured by police to force them to confess to a crime they did not commit. Their ordeal exposes them to a deeper web of police corruption.

r-asuran-2019.plot: When his teenage son kills a powerful landlord in a caste-driven land feud, a quiet farmer flees with the boy through the countryside. His violent past, which he long tried to bury, resurfaces as enemies close in.

r-article-15-2019.plot: A privileged police officer posted to a rural Uttar Pradesh district investigates the disappearance of three Dalit girls. He runs into entrenched caste discrimination and official cover-ups as he tries to uphold the constitution's promise of equality.

r-battle-of-the-sexes-2017.plot: In 1973, tennis champion Billie Jean King fights for equal pay for women players while privately exploring her sexuality. She accepts a challenge from former champion and self-styled chauvinist Bobby Riggs to a heavily hyped exhibition match.

r-borg-vs-mcenroe-2017.plot: The cool, composed Swede Björn Borg and the hot-headed American John McEnroe face off in the 1980 Wimbledon final. Flashbacks reveal that the two rivals have more in common than their opposite public images suggest.

r-i-tonya-2017.plot: A darkly comic portrait of figure skater Tonya Harding, from her abusive upbringing and turbulent marriage to her rise in the sport. The story culminates in the infamous 1994 attack on her rival Nancy Kerrigan, told through conflicting interviews.

won: Actress in a Supporting Role — Allison Janney
nominated: Actress in a Leading Role — Margot Robbie

r-freaks-1932.plot: A beautiful trapeze artist in a traveling circus learns that a sideshow performer has inherited a fortune and schemes to marry and poison him. The tight-knit community of sideshow performers, played by real performers, discovers her plot.

r-spider-man-2-2004.plot: Peter Parker struggles to balance college, work and his love for Mary Jane with his duties as Spider-Man, and his powers begin to fail. Meanwhile, a brilliant scientist's fusion experiment goes wrong, turning him into the mechanical-armed villain Doctor Octopus.

r-spider-man-homecoming-2017.plot: Fresh from his adventure with the Avengers, teenager Peter Parker returns to high school in Queens, eager to prove himself as Spider-Man under Tony Stark's watchful eye. He takes on the Vulture, a salvager selling weapons built from alien tech.

r-doctor-strange-2016.plot: After a car accident ruins his hands, an arrogant neurosurgeon travels to Kathmandu looking for a cure. There he's trained in the mystic arts and drawn into a battle against dark forces threatening reality itself.

setting.place: New York City; Kathmandu; London; Hong Kong

r-stalingrad-1993.plot: A squad of German soldiers fresh from North Africa is sent to fight in Stalingrad. Through the brutal street fighting and the freezing encirclement, their faith in the war collapses.

r-alita-battle-angel-2019.plot: A scientist rebuilds a discarded cyborg girl with no memory of her past. As Alita discovers extraordinary combat skills in a dangerous scrapyard city, she fights to uncover her origins and challenge the powerful sky city above.

r-aquaman-2018.plot: Arthur Curry, half-human heir to the undersea kingdom of Atlantis, reluctantly sets out to claim his birthright. He must find a legendary trident to stop his half-brother from waging war on the surface world.

r-priscilla-2023.plot: Teenage Priscilla Beaulieu meets Elvis Presley at a party in West Germany. She later moves into Graceland and marries him, but the fairy tale gives way to loneliness and control as she finds her own identity.

r-swiss-army-man-2016.plot: A man stranded on a deserted island and about to give up discovers a corpse washed ashore. The flatulent body turns out to have many uses, and as the two journey home, the dead man helps him rediscover the joys of life.

r-kung-fu-hustle-2004.plot: In 1940s Shanghai, a small-time crook dreams of joining the feared Axe Gang and tries to extort a rundown tenement. The slum turns out to be home to hidden kung fu masters, setting off escalating, cartoonish battles.

r-the-guard-2011.plot: A crude, irreverent Irish police sergeant in rural Connemara is paired with a straitlaced FBI agent pursuing an international drug-smuggling ring. Their clash of styles turns into an odd partnership as the stakes rise.

r-pain-and-glory-2019.plot: An aging, ailing film director in creative paralysis reflects on his childhood, his first love, his mother and his career. Reconnecting with an estranged actor and old memories slowly moves him toward working again.

nominated: Actor in a Leading Role — Antonio Banderas

r-armageddon-time-2022.plot: In 1980 Queens, a Jewish sixth-grader from a striving family befriends a Black classmate who faces harsher treatment from teachers. Guided by his loving grandfather, he begins to see the injustices and privileges around him.

r-top-gun-1986.plot: A hotshot Navy fighter pilot is sent to an elite training school, where he competes with a cool rival, falls for an instructor, and must confront the loss of his best friend.

r-mission-impossible-fallout-2018.plot: After a mission goes wrong and stolen plutonium falls into terrorist hands, Ethan Hunt and his team race to prevent nuclear attacks. A CIA assassin is assigned to shadow him as old enemies resurface.

r-the-square-2017.plot: The chief curator of a Stockholm contemporary art museum prepares a new installation encouraging altruism. After his phone and wallet are stolen, his reaction and a disastrous viral marketing campaign spiral into a series of moral embarrassments.

r-force-majeure-2014.plot: On a ski holiday in the French Alps, a Swedish family is having lunch when a controlled avalanche appears to be heading straight for them. The father's instinctive reaction in that moment sets off a slow crisis in his marriage and his sense of himself.

setting.place: Ski resort in the French Alps

r-the-menu-2022.plot: A young woman accompanies a food-obsessed date to an exclusive island restaurant run by a celebrated chef. As the elaborate tasting menu unfolds, the meal turns increasingly sinister for the wealthy guests.

r-clouds-of-sils-maria-2014.plot: A celebrated middle-aged actress agrees to appear in a revival of the play that made her famous, but this time as the older woman. Rehearsing in the Swiss Alps with her young personal assistant, the lines between the play and their own relationship begin to blur.

r-mustang-2015.plot: In a village in northern Turkey, five orphaned sisters are confined to their home by their conservative family after an innocent beach game is deemed scandalous. As their house becomes a prison and marriages are arranged, the girls resist in their own ways.

setting.place: Village on Turkey's Black Sea coast

r-super-30-2019.plot: A brilliant mathematician from a poor family in Bihar loses his chance at Cambridge. He founds a free coaching program that trains thirty underprivileged students each year for India's toughest engineering entrance exam, angering powerful rivals.

r-bamboozled-2000.plot: A frustrated Black TV writer, hoping to get fired, pitches an outrageously racist modern minstrel show. To his horror, the network loves it and it becomes a hit, with consequences that spiral out of control.

r-wonder-boys-2000.plot: A pot-smoking Pittsburgh writing professor, stuck on an endless second novel, has a chaotic weekend during a literary festival. His married lover is pregnant, his editor is in town, and a troubled, gifted student draws him into a series of mishaps.

r-saint-omer-2022.plot: A novelist attends the trial of a Senegalese immigrant accused of leaving her infant daughter to drown on a northern French beach. As testimony unfolds, the case unsettles the writer's own feelings about motherhood.

r-enchanted-2007.plot: An animated fairy-tale princess about to marry her prince is banished by a wicked queen to live-action modern New York City. Lost and naively optimistic, she is taken in by a cynical divorce lawyer and his daughter, and begins to rethink true love.

setting.place: New York City; the animated kingdom of Andalasia

r-legally-blonde-2001.plot: A bubbly Los Angeles sorority president is dumped by her boyfriend, who wants a more serious partner for his political future. She follows him to Harvard Law School, where she is underestimated at every turn but proves her talent.

r-hostiles-2017.plot: In 1892, a hardened U.S. Army captain is ordered to escort a dying Cheyenne war chief and his family back to their tribal lands in Montana. Along the way, they encounter a widow whose family was murdered, and the old enemies must rely on each other.

r-love-mercy-2014.plot: A dual portrait of Beach Boys leader Brian Wilson: as a young man crafting the groundbreaking album Pet Sounds while battling mental illness, and as a middle-aged man under the control of a domineering therapist, until a woman he meets helps him break free.

r-fat-man-and-little-boy-1989.plot: General Leslie Groves and physicist J. Robert Oppenheimer lead the secret Manhattan Project at Los Alamos, where scientists race to build the atomic bomb while wrestling with what they are creating.

r-columbus-2017.plot: When his architect father falls into a coma, a Korean-born translator is stuck in Columbus, Indiana, a town famous for modernist architecture. He befriends a young local woman who is passionate about the buildings but hesitant to leave home and her mother.

r-bride-of-frankenstein-1935.plot: Having survived the fire, Henry Frankenstein is blackmailed by the sinister Dr. Pretorius into building a mate for his creature. The monster, wandering lonely, learns friendship and speech, and longs for a companion of his own.

setting.place: A village in Central Europe; Lake Geneva prologue

r-the-last-detail-1973.plot: Two career Navy petty officers are assigned to escort a naive young sailor to prison for a petty theft. Feeling sorry for him, they turn the trip up the East Coast into a final spree of drinking, brawling and life lessons.

setting.place: Norfolk, Virginia to Portsmouth, New Hampshire

nominated: Actor in a Leading Role — Jack Nicholson
Actor in a Supporting Role — Randy Quaid

r-under-the-skin-2013.plot: An alien in the guise of a seductive woman drives around Scotland luring lone men into a mysterious void. As her encounters with humans accumulate, she starts to experience something like curiosity and empathy, with unsettling consequences.

r-the-white-ribbon-2009.plot: In a Protestant village in northern Germany on the eve of World War I, a series of mysterious and cruel incidents strikes the community. The local schoolteacher, narrating years later, observes the strict, repressive upbringing of the village children.

r-i-m-not-there-2007.plot: Six actors portray different facets of a musician modeled on Bob Dylan, from a young drifter and a protest folk singer to an electric-era rock star and an aging outlaw. The fragmented stories explore identity, fame and reinvention.

nominated: Actress in a Supporting Role — Cate Blanchett

r-uncut-gems-2019.plot: A fast-talking New York jeweler with gambling debts acquires a rare uncut opal he believes will win him a fortune. Juggling creditors, family and a basketball star who wants the stone, he makes increasingly reckless bets.

r-jujutsu-kaisen-0-2021.plot: Yuta Okkotsu, haunted by the cursed spirit of his childhood friend, enrolls at Tokyo Jujutsu High under the teacher Satoru Gojo. As he learns to control her power, a rogue sorcerer plots a massacre and covets Yuta's curse.

r-the-end-of-evangelion-1997.plot: An alternate conclusion to the Neon Genesis Evangelion series. As a shadowy council launches its plan to merge humanity into a single being, NERV headquarters comes under attack, and a traumatized teenage pilot must decide the fate of everyone.

r-the-two-popes-2019.plot: Frustrated with the Church's direction, Argentine Cardinal Bergoglio asks Pope Benedict XVI to let him retire. Instead, the conservative pope summons him to Rome, and the two men debate faith, guilt and the future of Catholicism.

nominated: Actor in a Leading Role — Jonathan Pryce
Actor in a Supporting Role — Anthony Hopkins

r-dancer-in-the-dark-2000.plot: A Czech immigrant factory worker in 1960s rural America is secretly going blind and saving every cent for an operation to spare her son the same fate. She escapes her hardships by imagining musical numbers, until a betrayal leads to tragedy.

r-central-station-1998.plot: A bitter retired teacher writes letters for illiterate travelers at Rio's main train station. When a boy's mother is killed, she reluctantly takes him on a long journey into Brazil's northeast to find the father he has never met.

nominated: Actress in a Leading Role — Fernanda Montenegro

r-drishyam-2013.plot: A cable-TV operator in a Kerala village, a devoted fan of movies, lives contentedly with his wife and daughters. When his family becomes entangled in the disappearance of a powerful police officer's son, he uses everything he learned from films to protect them.

r-kaithi-2019.plot: A just-released convict hoping to meet his young daughter for the first time is forced to help a police officer. Over one night he must drive a truck of poisoned officers to safety while a drug gang hunts them.

r-vikram-2022.plot: A special police unit led by a shrewd agent investigates a string of murders committed by masked men targeting a drug syndicate. The case leads to a hidden figure with a vengeful personal mission and a ruthless drug lord.

r-sleepers-1996.plot: Four boyhood friends from Hell's Kitchen are sent to a reform school after a prank goes wrong, where guards abuse them. Years later, two of them kill a former guard, and the others devise a plan for revenge through the trial.

r-the-fountainhead-1949.plot: An uncompromising modernist architect refuses to alter his designs to suit public taste, even if it costs him his career. His integrity draws a newspaper heiress, a powerful publisher and a weak, opportunistic rival into conflict around him.

r-vox-lux-2018.plot: A teenage girl survives a school shooting and becomes famous after singing at a memorial. Years later she is a volatile pop superstar preparing a comeback concert while a new act of violence echoes her past.

r-the-fly-1986.plot: An eccentric scientist builds teleportation pods and tests them on himself, not noticing a housefly sharing the pod. At first he feels stronger than ever, but his body begins a horrifying transformation as a journalist he loves watches.

r-death-becomes-her-1992.plot: Two lifelong rivals, a fading actress and a novelist, both drink a potion that promises eternal youth. The catch becomes clear as their bodies take a beating, while the hapless plastic surgeon between them wants out.

r-robot-dreams-2023.plot: A lonely dog in 1980s Manhattan builds a robot companion, and the two become inseparable. After a beach trip leaves the robot stranded until the next summer, both dream of reuniting. Told entirely without dialogue.

r-wicked-for-good-2025.plot: Now branded the Wicked Witch of the West, Elphaba lives in exile fighting the Wizard's regime, while Glinda becomes Oz's beloved public symbol of goodness. Their divided friendship is tested as Dorothy's arrival changes everything.

r-into-the-woods-2014.plot: A childless baker and his wife set out to break a witch's curse by collecting items from fairy tales, crossing paths with Cinderella, Little Red Riding Hood, Jack and Rapunzel. Wishes come true, but their consequences prove far more complicated than happily ever after.

nominated: Actress in a Supporting Role — Meryl Streep

r-save-the-green-planet-2003.plot: A troubled beekeeper convinced that aliens are about to destroy Earth kidnaps a powerful chemical company executive, believing him to be an extraterrestrial prince. A wild blend of comedy, torture thriller and sci-fi follows as a detective closes in.

r-the-killing-of-a-sacred-deer-2017.plot: A successful heart surgeon has been secretly befriending a teenage boy connected to his past. When the boy's presence turns sinister, the doctor's family begins suffering a mysterious affliction, and he is faced with an unthinkable choice.

r-misery-1990.plot: A best-selling novelist injured in a car crash in a snowstorm is rescued by a nurse who calls herself his biggest fan. Her devotion turns menacing when she learns what he has done to her favorite character.

won: Actress in a Leading Role — Kathy Bates

r-demon-slayer-mugen-train-2020.plot: Tanjiro and his fellow demon slayers board a train where dozens of passengers have vanished. Joining the flamboyant Flame Hashira Rengoku, they confront a demon who traps victims in seductive dreams.

r-ninja-scroll-1993.plot: In feudal Japan, a wandering swordsman for hire is pulled into a fight against a band of demonic warriors with supernatural powers who are plotting to overthrow the shogunate.

r-frankenstein-1931.plot: A young scientist obsessed with creating life assembles a body from corpses and brings it to life in his mountaintop laboratory. The bewildered creature, given a criminal's brain and treated with fear and cruelty, escapes into the countryside with tragic consequences.

r-mary-shelley-s-frankenstein-1994.plot: A brilliant young scientist obsessed with conquering death assembles and reanimates a man from corpses, then abandons him. The creature, intelligent and rejected, seeks a reckoning with his creator.

r-all-is-true-2018.plot: After the Globe Theatre burns down, William Shakespeare retires to Stratford and the family he long neglected. Grieving his dead son, he must face old resentments with his wife and daughters in his final years.

r-good-time-2017.plot: After a botched bank robbery lands his intellectually disabled brother in jail, a small-time crook spends one frantic night in New York trying to break him out. His desperate schemes drag him deeper into chaos.

r-running-on-empty-1988.plot: Two former anti-war radicals have been on the run from the FBI for years, moving their sons from town to town under new names. When their gifted teenage son falls in love and earns a shot at music school, the family faces a hard choice.

nominated: Actor in a Supporting Role — River Phoenix

r-raising-arizona-1987.plot: An ex-con and his police-officer wife learn they cannot have children, so they steal one of a furniture magnate's newborn quintuplets. Their plans unravel as escaped convicts and a demonic bounty hunter come after the baby.

r-the-worst-person-in-the-world-2021.plot: Over four years in Oslo, Julie, a restless woman nearing thirty, drifts between careers and relationships, including one with an older comic artist. Told in chapters, the film follows her search for who she wants to be.

r-oslo-august-31st-2011.plot: A recovering drug addict is allowed to leave his rehab clinic for a day to attend a job interview in Oslo. Over the next 24 hours he drifts through the city, reconnecting with old friends and weighing whether he has any future.

r-from-dusk-till-dawn-1996.plot: Two criminal brothers on the run take a preacher and his children hostage to cross into Mexico. They wait for their contact at a rowdy truck-stop bar that turns out to be crawling with vampires.

r-near-dark-1987.plot: A young Oklahoma farm boy is bitten by a mysterious drifter girl and drawn into her nomadic family of vampires, who roam the highways at night. He must choose between them and the family he left behind.

r-nosferatu-2024.plot: In 1830s Germany, a young estate agent travels to Transylvania to close a deal with the reclusive Count Orlok. Back home, his wife Ellen is haunted by visions as the ancient vampire's obsession with her draws him toward their town.

r-bacurau-2019.plot: After their matriarch dies, residents of a remote Brazilian village find their town has vanished from maps and strange things are happening. They soon realize outsiders are hunting them and band together to resist.

r-aquarius-2016.plot: Clara, a retired music critic in her sixties, is the last resident of a seaside apartment building in Recife. When a construction company that has bought all the other units pressures her to sell, she resists their increasingly sinister tactics.

r-the-conformist-1970.plot: In the late 1930s, an Italian official desperate to seem normal joins the Fascist secret police. On his honeymoon in Paris, he is ordered to help assassinate his former university professor, an anti-Fascist exile, and becomes entangled with the professor's alluring wife.

r-first-cow-2019.plot: In the 1820s Oregon Territory, a quiet cook and a Chinese immigrant become friends and start selling oily cakes made with milk secretly taken from a wealthy landowner's prized cow. Their small business thrives, but the risk grows.

r-jockey-2021.plot: An aging jockey with failing health hopes to ride one last championship on a promising horse. His plans are shaken when a young rider arrives claiming to be his son.

r-jason-and-the-argonauts-1963.plot: To reclaim the throne stolen from his family, the hero Jason assembles a crew of Greece's finest warriors and sets sail on the Argo to find the fabled Golden Fleece. The gods watch and meddle as he faces a bronze giant, harpies, a hydra and an army of skeletons.

rs-prison-break-2005.plot: Structural engineer Michael Scofield gets himself locked up in a maximum-security prison, with its blueprints tattooed on his body, to break out his older brother, who is on death row for a murder he didn't commit.

setting.place: Illinois, USA; later Panama and Yemen

rs-tom-clancy-s-jack-ryan-2018.plot: CIA analyst Jack Ryan is pulled from his desk into dangerous field work after uncovering suspicious bank transfers, tracking terrorists, corrupt regimes and conspiracies across the globe.
rs-tom-clancy-s-jack-ryan-2018.source: Jack Ryan character by Tom Clancy

setting.place: Washington D.C., Middle East, Venezuela, Europe

rs-the-night-agent-2023.plot: Low-level FBI agent Peter Sutherland mans an emergency phone in the White House basement that never rings, until one night it does, pulling him into a conspiracy reaching the highest levels of government; later seasons bring new threats.
rs-the-night-agent-2023.source: The Night Agent by Matthew Quirk

rs-devs-2020.plot: After her boyfriend dies following his first day in a secretive division of a Silicon Valley quantum computing company, software engineer Lily Chan investigates and uncovers what the project is really building.

rs-foundation-2021.plot: Mathematician Hari Seldon predicts the fall of a Galactic Empire ruled by a dynasty of clones and establishes a Foundation on a remote world to preserve knowledge and shorten the coming dark age, a plan that unfolds across centuries.

rs-silo-2023.plot: Thousands of people live in a vast underground silo, told the outside world is toxic and bound by strict rules. When a mechanical engineer investigates a death, she starts uncovering lies about the silo's history and what lies beyond.

rs-great-news-2017.plot: An ambitious but overlooked producer at a struggling cable news show gets an unwelcome surprise when her overbearing mother is hired as the newsroom's new intern.

rs-community-2009.plot: Disbarred lawyer Jeff Winger enrolls at the chaotic Greendale Community College and forms a misfit Spanish study group that becomes a surrogate family. The sitcom is known for genre parodies, paintball wars and meta humor.

rs-that-70s-show-1998.plot: A group of teenage friends hang out in Eric Forman's basement in suburban Wisconsin in the late 1970s, dealing with parents, dating, jobs and growing up.

rs-alf-1986.plot: A wisecracking, cat-craving alien from the destroyed planet Melmac crash-lands in the garage of the suburban Tanner family, who hide him from nosy neighbors and the government while he wreaks havoc on their lives.

rs-resident-alien-2021.plot: An alien sent to wipe out humanity crash-lands in Colorado, assumes the identity of a small-town doctor and is pressed into solving a local murder, gradually growing fond of the humans he was meant to destroy.

rs-the-little-drummer-girl-2018.plot: In 1979, Charlie, a young English actress with radical sympathies, is recruited by an Israeli spymaster to play the role of her life, infiltrating a Palestinian terrorist network across Europe.
rs-the-little-drummer-girl-2018.source: The Little Drummer Girl by John le Carré

rs-game-set-and-match-1988.plot: Weary British intelligence officer Bernard Samson is pulled back into field work in Berlin to extract a valuable agent, setting off a hunt for a mole inside London Central that leads uncomfortably close to home.
rs-game-set-and-match-1988.source: Berlin Game, Mexico Set and London Match by Len Deighton

rs-the-sandbaggers-1978.plot: Neil Burnside, ruthless Director of Operations at British intelligence, runs a small team of elite field agents on dangerous Cold War missions while battling his superiors, Whitehall politics and American allies. A grounded, unglamorous espionage drama.

rs-tenko-1981.plot: After the fall of Singapore in 1942, British, Dutch and Australian women are captured and held in a Japanese internment camp in Sumatra, where they must survive starvation, disease and brutality while class and national tensions divide them.

rs-anzacs-1985.plot: A group of young Australians enlist together in 1914 and follow the fortunes of their battalion from Gallipoli to the Western Front, facing the horror of World War I with mateship and larrikin humor.

rs-the-far-pavilions-1984.plot: Raised as a Hindu servant boy, Englishman Ashton Pelham-Martyn becomes a British Guides officer in colonial India, torn between two cultures and his forbidden love for an Indian princess, amid court intrigue and the Second Anglo-Afghan War.
rs-the-far-pavilions-1984.source: The Far Pavilions by M. M. Kaye

rs-the-first-lady-2022.plot: Interweaving the lives of three First Ladies, Eleanor Roosevelt, Betty Ford and Michelle Obama, the series looks at their paths to the White House and the political and personal struggles they faced once there.

rs-the-kennedys-after-camelot-2017.plot: After the assassinations of John and Robert Kennedy, Jacqueline Kennedy Onassis and Ted Kennedy hold the family together through scandal, tragedy and political ambition across the following decades.
rs-the-kennedys-after-camelot-2017.source: After Camelot by J. Randy Taraborrelli (nonfiction book)

rs-dr-quinn-medicine-woman-1993.plot: A wealthy Boston doctor moves to frontier Colorado Springs in the 1860s, where she must win over skeptical townsfolk, raise three adopted children and find love with a rugged mountain man.

rs-lark-rise-to-candleford-2008.plot: In 1890s Oxfordshire, teenage Laura Timmins leaves the farming hamlet of Lark Rise to work at the post office in the nearby market town of Candleford. Gentle stories contrast rural poverty with town gentility as modern change creeps in.
rs-lark-rise-to-candleford-2008.source: Lark Rise to Candleford trilogy (Flora Thompson)

rs-little-women-2017.plot: While their father is away at the Civil War, the four March sisters grow up in Concord, Massachusetts, with their mother, facing poverty, romance, ambition and loss on the way to adulthood.
rs-little-women-2017.source: Little Women by Louisa May Alcott

rs-the-house-of-eliott-1991.plot: Left penniless after their father's death in 1920s London, sisters Beatrice and Evangeline Eliott use their dressmaking talent to build a prestigious fashion house, navigating romance, business rivals and a changing society.

rs-mr-selfridge-2013.plot: American retail visionary Harry Gordon Selfridge opens a grand department store on London's Oxford Street in 1909. The series tracks his business triumphs, extravagance and personal failings over two decades, along with his staff.
rs-mr-selfridge-2013.source: Shopping, Seduction & Mr Selfridge by Lindy Woodhead

rs-poldark-2015.plot: Ross Poldark returns from the American War of Independence to find his father dead, his estate in ruins and his sweetheart engaged to his cousin, and sets about reviving his family's Cornish tin mine while clashing with the powerful banker George Warleggan.

rs-parenthood-2010.plot: The sprawling Braverman family of Berkeley, California, four adult siblings, their aging parents and their children, deal with autism, illness, divorce, money troubles and new love, leaning on each other through ordinary crises.

rs-brothers-sisters-2006.plot: After their patriarch's sudden death reveals secrets and a troubled family business, the wealthy Walker siblings and their mother Nora lean on, argue with and protect one another in Southern California.

rs-once-and-again-1999.plot: Two divorced parents in their forties, Lily and Rick, fall in love and try to build a relationship while managing their exes and children, with characters confiding to the camera in black-and-white interludes.

rs-superstore-2015.plot: The employees of Cloud 9, a big-box store in St. Louis, cope with demanding customers, corporate policies and each other, as a new hire and the floor supervisor grow closer and the workers push for better conditions.

rs-brooklyn-nine-nine-2013.plot: A talented but immature detective and his quirky colleagues at a Brooklyn police precinct must adjust to a stern new captain. The squad bonds as they solve cases, play pranks and hold heists.

rs-boiling-point-2023.plot: Months after the events of the film, sous chef Carly runs her own London restaurant, Point North, with much of her old crew, juggling staff tensions, money pressures and personal crises in a high-stress kitchen.

rs-this-is-england-86-2010.plot: Three years after the film, Shaun and his former skinhead friends drift into adulthood amid unemployment and the 1986 World Cup, as Lol and Woody's troubled engagement and the return of Lol's abusive father bring buried pain to the surface.

rs-national-treasure-2016.plot: A beloved veteran comedian is arrested over historical sexual assault allegations, and as the case proceeds his wife and troubled daughter are forced to question what they believe about him.

rs-the-outer-limits-1963.plot: "There is nothing wrong with your television set": a Control Voice takes over the screen to present stand-alone science-fiction tales of alien encounters, scientific experiments gone wrong and humanity facing the unknown.

rs-route-66-1960.plot: Two restless young men, wealthy-turned-broke Tod Stiles and streetwise Buz Murdock (later Linc Case), drive a Corvette across America, taking odd jobs and getting caught up in the lives and troubles of the people they meet.

rs-thriller-1960.plot: Boris Karloff introduces hour-long tales of crime and suspense that increasingly turn to gothic horror, adapting writers such as Robert Bloch and Robert E. Howard; Stephen King later called it the best horror series ever on TV.

rs-dick-powell-s-zane-grey-theatre-1956.plot: Dick Powell hosts a Western anthology of stand-alone stories about gunfighters, lawmen, settlers and outcasts on the frontier, starring a different Hollywood guest each week; early episodes adapted Zane Grey's fiction.

rs-one-step-beyond-1959.plot: Host John Newland presents dramatizations of reportedly true encounters with the paranormal, from premonitions and ghosts to telepathy, inviting viewers to judge whether the unexplained really happened.

rs-underground-2016.plot: In 1857 Georgia, a group of enslaved people on a plantation plan a daring 600-mile escape north, aided by abolitionists on the Underground Railroad and pursued by relentless slave catchers.

rs-mercy-street-2016.plot: In Union-occupied Alexandria, Virginia, during the Civil War, a New England abolitionist nurse and a Confederate-sympathizing local woman work at a hotel converted into a military hospital, where medicine and loyalties collide.

rs-tales-of-the-unexpected-1979.plot: Each episode tells a self-contained story of suspense, black humor or the macabre ending with a sting in the tail, many adapted from Roald Dahl's short stories, with Dahl himself introducing early episodes.
rs-tales-of-the-unexpected-1979.source: Short stories by Roald Dahl and others

rs-night-gallery-1970.plot: In a dim museum, Rod Serling introduces eerie paintings, each opening into a tale of the supernatural, horror or macabre irony. Episodes often combine several stories, from adaptations of classic weird fiction to Serling's own originals.

rs-inside-no-9-2014.plot: Each self-contained half-hour story takes place behind a door marked number nine. Genres shift from macabre comedy to horror and tragedy, usually ending with a sharp twist.

rs-the-undoing-2020.plot: A Manhattan therapist's privileged life unravels when a mother from her son's elite school is found murdered and her charming oncologist husband vanishes, forcing her to confront whether she ever really knew him.
rs-the-undoing-2020.source: You Should Have Known (Jean Hanff Korelitz)

rs-the-missing-2014.plot: Each series follows a family devastated by the disappearance of a child and a dogged French detective. The stories cut between the search and its aftermath years later.

rs-defending-jacob-2020.plot: When his 14-year-old son is accused of murdering a classmate, an assistant district attorney in a Massachusetts town must choose between his duty to the law and his unconditional love for his child, as the family is torn apart.

rs-till-death-us-do-part-1965.plot: Loud, bigoted East End dock worker Alf Garnett rants about politics, race, religion and the Royal Family, clashing with his long-suffering wife Else, daughter Rita and her left-wing "Scouse git" husband Mike.

rs-roseanne-1988.plot: Sharp-tongued Roseanne Conner and her husband Dan raise three kids in blue-collar Lanford, Illinois, in a frank, funny portrait of a working-class family dealing with money worries, jobs and parenting.

rs-steptoe-and-son-1962.plot: In a West London junkyard, aspiring Harold Steptoe longs to escape his dead-end rag-and-bone business and his grubby, manipulative widowed father Albert, who always finds a way to keep him at home.

rs-crazy-ex-girlfriend-2015.plot: A successful but unhappy New York lawyer impulsively moves to West Covina, California, chasing her summer-camp ex-boyfriend, and her messy search for love and self-understanding plays out through original musical numbers.

rs-suits-2011.plot: Hotshot Manhattan closer Harvey Specter hires Mike Ross, a brilliant college dropout with a photographic memory, as his associate, even though Mike never went to law school. They win cases while hiding the fraud and fighting power struggles inside the firm.

rs-the-good-fight-2017.plot: After a financial scam wipes out her savings and reputation, veteran lawyer Diane Lockhart joins a prominent Black-owned Chicago law firm, taking on politically charged cases in the chaotic Trump era.

rs-seven-seconds-2018.plot: When a white Jersey City police officer accidentally hits a Black teenager with his car and his colleagues cover it up, the boy's grieving parents and a struggling prosecutor fight for the truth amid racial tension.

rs-guerrilla-2017.plot: In early-1970s London, a politically active couple frees a political prisoner and forms an underground radical cell, while a Special Branch unit aimed at Black activists closes in on them.

rs-show-me-a-hero-2015.plot: In late-1980s Yonkers, New York, young mayor Nick Wasicsko is caught in a bitter fight over a federal court order to build public housing in white neighbourhoods, while residents on all sides see their lives shaped by the decision.
rs-show-me-a-hero-2015.source: Show Me a Hero by Lisa Belkin

rs-o-j-made-in-america-2016.plot: A five-part documentary that traces O.J. Simpson's rise from football star to celebrity and his murder trial, set against the history of race relations and policing in Los Angeles.

rs-a-very-english-scandal-2018.plot: Liberal Party leader Jeremy Thorpe, desperate to hide his past affair with young stable hand Norman Scott, is accused of conspiring to have him murdered, leading to a sensational 1979 trial.
rs-a-very-english-scandal-2018.source: A Very English Scandal by John Preston (nonfiction book)

rs-one-day-at-a-time-2017.plot: Penelope Alvarez, a Cuban-American Army veteran and nurse, raises her two teenagers in Los Angeles with help from her old-school mother and a friendly building manager, tackling immigration, mental health and identity with warmth.

rs-vida-2018.plot: Two estranged Mexican-American sisters return to their Eastside Los Angeles neighborhood after their mother's death, discovering secrets about her life and taking on her struggling bar amid gentrification.
rs-vida-2018.source: Pour Vida by Richard Villegas Jr.

rs-gentefied-2020.plot: Three Mexican-American cousins in the Boyle Heights neighborhood of Los Angeles try to save their grandfather's taco shop from gentrification while chasing their own dreams.

rs-penny-dreadful-2014.plot: In Victorian London an explorer, a mysterious medium, an American gunslinger and Dr. Frankenstein band together against supernatural threats. Their battle draws in literary figures such as Dorian Gray and Dracula.
rs-penny-dreadful-2014.source: Frankenstein, Dracula, The Picture of Dorian Gray and other Gothic fiction

rs-midnight-mass-2021.plot: A disgraced young man returns to his isolated, dying island community just as a charismatic new priest arrives, bringing seemingly miraculous events that ignite religious fervor and conceal something far more sinister.

rs-scream-queens-2015.plot: A college sorority ruled by a vicious queen bee is terrorized by a masked serial killer tied to a decades-old secret; the second season moves the satirical slasher mayhem to a hospital.

rs-the-honeymooners-1955.plot: Blustering Brooklyn bus driver Ralph Kramden dreams up get-rich-quick schemes with his sewer-worker pal Ed Norton, while his sharp-tongued wife Alice keeps him grounded in their bare tenement apartment.
rs-the-honeymooners-1955.source: sketches from Cavalcade of Stars and The Jackie Gleason Show

rs-the-life-of-riley-1949.plot: Chester A. Riley, a bumbling aircraft-plant riveter, keeps turning small domestic problems into disasters for his patient wife and kids. This first TV version of the radio hit starred Jackie Gleason and won the first Emmy for best filmed TV program.

rs-the-jeffersons-1975.plot: Brash dry-cleaning tycoon George Jefferson and his patient wife Louise move from Queens to a deluxe Manhattan high-rise, where George clashes with neighbors, an interracial couple and their sharp-tongued maid Florence. A spin-off of All in the Family.

rs-fall-of-eagles-1974.plot: A sweeping drama of the European dynasties of Habsburg, Hohenzollern and Romanov, from the mid-nineteenth century to their collapse in the First World War and the Russian Revolution, featuring figures from Bismarck and Kaiser Wilhelm II to Nicholas II and Lenin.

rs-the-last-czars-2019.plot: A docudrama mixing dramatized scenes and expert interviews to tell the story of Tsar Nicholas II and the fall of the Romanov dynasty, from his coronation through revolution to his family's execution and the Anastasia legend.

rs-catherine-the-great-2019.plot: Empress Catherine II rules 18th-century Russia while navigating court intrigue, wars and reforms, and her passionate, turbulent relationship with the military commander Grigory Potemkin.

rs-masters-of-the-air-2024.plot: The airmen of the U.S. 100th Bomb Group, nicknamed the 'Bloody Hundredth', fly dangerous daylight bombing raids over Nazi Germany from England, suffering heavy losses, capture and the strain of a brutal air war.
rs-masters-of-the-air-2024.source: Masters of the Air by Donald L. Miller

rs-colditz-1972.plot: Allied officers held in Colditz Castle, the Nazis' supposedly escape-proof prison for persistent escapers, plot ingenious breakouts while sparring with their honorable but determined German commandant during the Second World War.

rs-fellow-travelers-2023.plot: During the 1950s Lavender Scare, a charming State Department official and a young idealistic staffer begin a secret, volatile love affair that spans decades of American history, from McCarthyism to the AIDS crisis.

rs-queer-as-folk-1999.plot: Three gay men in Manchester's Canal Street scene, the hedonistic Stuart, his devoted best friend Vince and 15-year-old newcomer Nathan, navigate sex, friendship and family.
