rs-looking-2014.plot: Three gay friends in San Francisco, a video-game designer, an aspiring artist and an older restaurateur, navigate love, sex and careers. A 2016 TV film followed the two seasons.

rs-war-and-peace-2016.plot: During the Napoleonic Wars, the lives of three young Russian aristocrats, the awkward idealist Pierre, the spirited Natasha and the disillusioned Prince Andrei, intertwine through love, loss and war.
rs-war-and-peace-2016.source: War and Peace by Leo Tolstoy

rs-doctor-zhivago-2002.plot: Physician and poet Yuri Zhivago is torn between his devoted wife and the passionate Lara as war and the Russian Revolution tear apart the world they know.

rs-middlemarch-1994.plot: In a provincial English town on the eve of reform, idealistic Dorothea Brooke and ambitious young doctor Tertius Lydgate each make disastrous marriages as the community's ambitions, scandals and secrets unfold.

rs-the-diary-of-anne-frank-2009.plot: In Nazi-occupied Amsterdam, teenage Anne Frank and her family go into hiding in the secret annex above her father's business, sharing cramped rooms with others for two years. Drawn closely from her diary, it captures her humor, frustrations and hopes.
rs-the-diary-of-anne-frank-2009.source: The Diary of a Young Girl (Anne Frank)

rs-a-small-light-2023.plot: Carefree young Amsterdam woman Miep Gies becomes the secret lifeline for Otto Frank's family as they hide from the Nazis in an annex above his business, risking everything to keep them fed and hidden.

rs-uprising-2001.plot: In Nazi-occupied Warsaw, a group of young Jews in the ghetto, led by Mordechai Anielewicz, organize an armed resistance as deportations to the death camps intensify, culminating in the 1943 Warsaw Ghetto Uprising.

rs-the-10th-kingdom-2000.plot: New York waitress Virginia and her father fall through a magic mirror into a fairy-tale realm of nine kingdoms, where with a lovesick werewolf and an enchanted dog-prince they try to thwart an evil queen.

setting.place: New York and a fairy-tale realm

rs-frank-herbert-s-dune-2000.plot: Young Paul Atreides moves with his noble family to the desert planet Arrakis, sole source of the precious spice, where betrayal forces him to join the native Fremen and fulfill a messianic destiny.

rs-the-storyteller-1987.plot: By a fireside, an old storyteller and his sardonic talking dog recount lesser-known European folktales, brought to life with Jim Henson's puppetry and creature effects, mixing wonder, darkness and humor.

rs-the-l-word-2004.plot: A circle of lesbian and bisexual friends in West Hollywood navigate love, careers, infidelity and identity, centered on a couple trying to have a child and a writer newly exploring her sexuality.

rs-green-acres-1965.plot: New York lawyer Oliver Wendell Douglas fulfills his dream of farming by buying a dilapidated farm near Hooterville, dragging along his glamorous, city-loving wife Lisa amid surreal, eccentric locals.

rs-the-brady-bunch-1969.plot: Widowed architect Mike Brady, with three sons, marries Carol, who has three daughters, and the blended family plus housekeeper Alice navigate sibling rivalries, school dramas and growing pains in their suburban Los Angeles home.

rs-the-partridge-family-1970.plot: Widowed mother Shirley Partridge and her five children form a pop band and tour in a painted school bus, managed by the kid-averse Reuben Kincaid, juggling gigs with family life in their California hometown.

rs-the-act-2019.plot: The true story of Gypsy Rose Blanchard, a young woman who tries to escape her overprotective mother Dee Dee, who has convinced everyone that Gypsy is chronically ill, leading to a shocking murder.
rs-the-act-2019.source: Dee Dee Wanted Her Daughter to Be Sick (BuzzFeed article)

rs-normal-people-2020.plot: Marianne and Connell, from different social classes in a small Irish town, begin a secret relationship at school and continue drifting together and apart through university at Trinity College Dublin.

rs-you-2018.plot: Joe Goldberg, a charming bookstore manager, becomes dangerously obsessed with women he falls for, using social media and stalking to insert himself into their lives and eliminating anyone who gets in his way.

rs-eric-2024.plot: In 1980s New York, a troubled children's TV puppeteer falls apart after his young son disappears, and becomes convinced that a giant monster puppet his boy drew, Eric, is the key to bringing him home.

rs-the-residence-2025.plot: During a glamorous state dinner, a senior White House staff member is found dead, and an eccentric, bird-watching detective questions the large staff of the residence to find out who among them is the killer.
rs-the-residence-2025.source: Inspired by The Residence by Kate Andersen Brower

rs-upstairs-downstairs-2010.plot: In 1936, diplomat Sir Hallam Holland and his wife Lady Agnes reopen 165 Eaton Place, hiring former maid Rose Buck to staff it. Above and below stairs, the household faces the abdication crisis, fascism and the approach of war.

rs-starsky-hutch-1975.plot: Streetwise Dave Starsky and laid-back Ken Hutchinson, plainclothes detectives in fictional Bay City, California, chase down criminals in their red-and-white Ford Gran Torino, helped by flamboyant informant Huggy Bear.

rs-police-woman-1974.plot: Sergeant Pepper Anderson of the Los Angeles Police Department's criminal conspiracy unit goes undercover as prostitutes, gangsters' molls and other covers to help her team catch criminals. One of the first successful dramas led by a female cop.

rs-the-sweeney-1975.plot: Hard-drinking Detective Inspector Jack Regan and his sergeant George Carter of the Metropolitan Police's Flying Squad pursue armed robbers and violent criminals across 1970s London, often bending the rules to get results.

rs-the-thin-blue-line-1995.plot: Pompous, by-the-book Inspector Raymond Fowler runs a small-town police station, clashing with his ambitious CID rival and his bumbling uniformed officers.

rs-police-squad-1982.plot: Deadpan Detective Frank Drebin of Police Squad investigates crimes in a parody of 1950s-60s cop shows, where every scene is packed with sight gags, literal-minded wordplay and absurd running jokes.

rs-get-shorty-2017.plot: Miles Daly, a Nevada mob enforcer who wants a better life for his daughter, tries to launder money and reinvent himself as a Hollywood producer, partnering with a washed-up B-movie producer on a terrible script.

rs-search-party-2016.plot: Directionless Brooklyn twentysomething Dory becomes obsessed with the disappearance of a former college acquaintance and drags her self-absorbed friends into an amateur investigation that spirals into crime and darkness.

rs-patriot-2017.plot: A depressed intelligence officer who sings melancholy folk songs takes a mundane cover job at a Milwaukee piping firm to stop Iran from going nuclear, as his deadpan mission spirals into absurd disasters.

rs-the-green-hornet-1966.plot: Newspaper publisher Britt Reid secretly fights crime as the masked Green Hornet, posing as a criminal to infiltrate the underworld, aided by his martial-artist valet Kato and their high-tech car, Black Beauty.

rs-wonder-woman-1975.plot: Amazon princess Diana leaves Paradise Island to fight Nazi agents during World War II as Wonder Woman alongside pilot Steve Trevor, then returns in the 1970s to battle spies and villains for a U.S. intelligence agency. Based on the DC Comics heroine.

rs-batman-the-brave-and-the-bold-2008.plot: A lighthearted animated take on Batman in which the Caped Crusader teams up with a different DC hero each episode, from Blue Beetle to Green Arrow. Inspired by the Silver Age comics, it embraces campy villains, bright colors and old-fashioned adventure.
rs-batman-the-brave-and-the-bold-2008.source: Batman / The Brave and the Bold (DC Comics)

rs-highlander-the-series-1992.plot: Duncan MacLeod, a 400-year-old Scottish immortal, lives quietly as an antiques dealer but is drawn into sword duels with other immortals who must behead one another until only one remains, with flashbacks to his past lives.

rs-forever-knight-1992.plot: Nick Knight, an 800-year-old vampire seeking to atone for his past and regain his humanity, works the night shift as a Toronto homicide detective, aided by a coroner searching for a cure and tormented by his maker LaCroix.

rs-angel-1999.plot: The cursed vampire Angel, who has regained his soul, moves to Los Angeles and opens a detective agency to help the helpless and atone for his past, eventually battling the demonic law firm Wolfram & Hart.

rs-killing-it-2022.plot: A struggling Florida security guard dreaming of owning a business enters a contest to kill the most Burmese pythons in the Everglades, teaming with an eccentric rideshare driver in a satire of the American dream.

rs-bad-sisters-2022.plot: Four Garvey sisters in Dublin conspire to kill their sister's controlling, abusive husband, while after his death two insurance-agent brothers dig into the family's suspicious behavior. A second season brings a new death and investigation.

rs-halston-2021.plot: Traces the rise and fall of fashion designer Halston, from Jackie Kennedy's pillbox hat to building a fashion empire and partying at Studio 54, until excess and a disastrous licensing deal cost him control of his own name.

rs-hollywood-2020.plot: In post-World War II Hollywood, a group of aspiring actors and filmmakers fight to break into the movie business, in a revisionist fantasy where they challenge the industry's racism, sexism and homophobia.

rs-dr-kildare-1961.plot: Idealistic young intern James Kildare learns medicine and compassion at Blair General Hospital under the gruff mentorship of veteran physician Dr. Leonard Gillespie, treating patients with complicated medical and personal problems.
rs-dr-kildare-1961.source: Dr. Kildare stories by Max Brand and the MGM films

rs-the-nurses-1962.plot: Veteran head nurse Liz Thorpe guides idealistic young student nurse Gail Lucas through the medical crises and human dramas of a busy New York City hospital.

rs-medical-center-1969.plot: At a Los Angeles university hospital, idealistic surgeon Dr. Joe Gannon and chief of staff Dr. Paul Lochner treat patients whose cases often raise social issues of the day, from drug abuse to controversial surgeries.

rs-franklin-2024.plot: In 1776, aging Benjamin Franklin sails to France on a secret mission to win King Louis XVI's support for the American Revolution, navigating spies, court intrigue and rivalries with his own fellow diplomats.
rs-franklin-2024.source: A Great Improvisation by Stacy Schiff

rs-liberty-the-american-revolution-1997.plot: A documentary history of the American Revolution from the colonial protests of the 1760s to the Constitution, told through letters and diaries read by actors in character, along with historians' commentary.

rs-turn-washington-s-spies-2014.plot: During the American Revolution, a Long Island farmer is drawn into espionage and forms the Culper Ring with childhood friends. They spy on British forces for George Washington.

rs-i-dream-of-jeannie-1965.plot: Astronaut Tony Nelson finds a bottle on a desert island and releases Jeannie, a 2,000-year-old genie who falls for her new master; her well-meant magic constantly threatens his NASA career and his attempts to keep her secret.

rs-the-munsters-1964.plot: A family of friendly monsters, led by Frankenstein-like Herman and vampire wife Lily, live a cheerful suburban life at 1313 Mockingbird Lane, oblivious to why their ordinary niece Marilyn's dates run away.

rs-sabrina-the-teenage-witch-1996.plot: On her sixteenth birthday, Sabrina Spellman learns she is a witch, and while living with her two witch aunts and a talking cat she tries to master magic alongside high school, college and romance.

rs-nine-perfect-strangers-2021.plot: Stressed city dwellers check into a boutique wellness retreat run by the enigmatic Masha, whose unorthodox methods promise transformation but carry hidden risks; a second season moves her experiment to the Austrian Alps with new guests.

rs-under-the-banner-of-heaven-2022.plot: A devout Mormon detective investigating the brutal killing of a young mother and her baby in suburban Utah finds his faith shaken as the case leads to her husband's fundamentalist brothers and the church's own violent history.
rs-under-the-banner-of-heaven-2022.source: Under the Banner of Heaven by Jon Krakauer

rs-keep-sweet-pray-and-obey-2022.plot: Survivors of the Fundamentalist Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-Day Saints recount life under prophet Warren Jeffs, who imposed underage marriages and total control over followers until his arrest and conviction.

rs-the-path-2016.plot: Eddie Lane, a member of the Meyerist Movement, a fictional faith that promises enlightenment, begins doubting his beliefs, putting him at odds with his devout wife and the group's ambitious leader.

rs-monsters-the-lyle-and-erik-menendez-s.plot: Brothers Lyle and Erik Menendez shoot their wealthy parents in their Beverly Hills mansion in 1989, then claim years of abuse during sensational televised trials, as the series questions what drove them to kill.

rs-dirty-john-2018.plot: A true-crime anthology about love gone deadly: the first season follows an interior designer who falls for a charming con man, the second dramatizes Betty Broderick's violent unraveling after her husband leaves her.
rs-dirty-john-2018.source: Dirty John (Los Angeles Times series and podcast by Christopher Goffard)

rs-super-pumped-2022.plot: A dramatized account of Uber's explosive rise under co-founder Travis Kalanick, whose aggressive, rule-breaking ambition builds a tech empire while alienating investors, employees and regulators, until the company's board turns against him.
rs-super-pumped-2022.source: Super Pumped: The Battle for Uber by Mike Isaac

rs-everybody-hates-chris-2005.plot: Narrated by Chris Rock, this comedy follows teenage Chris growing up in 1980s Bed-Stuy, Brooklyn, juggling a strict mother, a penny-pinching father, his siblings and life as the only Black kid at a mostly white school.

rs-grown-ish-2018.plot: Zoey Johnson leaves home for college at California University, learning about friendship, romance, independence and identity as she discovers adulthood is harder than it looks.

rs-the-fresh-prince-of-bel-air-1990.plot: After a scuffle in West Philadelphia, street-smart teen Will is sent to live with his wealthy uncle Phil, aunt Vivian and cousins in their Bel-Air mansion, where his swagger clashes with their upper-class world.

rs-our-mutual-friend-1998.plot: In Victorian London, the apparent drowning of an heir sets off a chain of schemes and romances involving a waterman's daughter, a poor young woman made rich, and a cast of grasping social climbers.
rs-our-mutual-friend-1998.source: Our Mutual Friend by Charles Dickens

rs-dickensian-2015.plot: Characters from Charles Dickens' novels share the streets of one Victorian London neighbourhood, where Inspector Bucket investigates the murder of Jacob Marley and the backstories of Miss Havisham and others intertwine.

rs-north-south-2004.plot: Margaret Hale, a parson's daughter from the genteel south, moves to an industrial northern mill town and clashes with proud mill owner John Thornton over workers' rights as mutual prejudice gives way to attraction.
rs-north-south-2004.source: North and South by Elizabeth Gaskell

rs-gaslit-2022.plot: Watergate retold through overlooked figures, chiefly Martha Mitchell, the outspoken wife of Nixon's attorney general John Mitchell, who sounds the alarm about the scandal, and White House counsel John Dean.

rs-white-house-plumbers-2023.plot: Political operatives E. Howard Hunt and G. Gordon Liddy, hired to plug leaks for the Nixon White House, bungle their way through the Watergate break-in and accidentally help bring down the president they served.
rs-white-house-plumbers-2023.source: Integrity by Egil 'Bud' Krogh and Matthew Krogh

rs-watergate-2018.plot: Charles Ferguson's documentary combines archival footage, interviews and dramatized reenactments of the Nixon tapes to chronicle the Watergate scandal from the break-in to Richard Nixon's resignation.

rs-the-staircase-2022.plot: A dramatization of novelist Michael Peterson's long legal fight after his wife Kathleen is found dead at the foot of a staircase, examining his family, the trial, and the documentary crew whose cameras shaped the case.

rs-love-death-2023.plot: Two churchgoing couples in a small Texas town become close friends, until an affair between Candy Montgomery and Allan Gore ends with Allan's wife dead from dozens of axe blows and Candy on trial for murder.
rs-love-death-2023.source: Evidence of Love by John Bloom and Jim Atkinson

rs-kraft-suspense-theatre-1963.plot: Sponsored by Kraft Foods, this hour-long anthology presented a different crime drama, thriller or melodrama each week with a new cast of film and television stars.

rs-the-capture-2019.plot: After a British soldier is caught on CCTV apparently committing a crime he insists he didn't commit, a detective uncovers a hidden world of manipulated surveillance footage and state deception.

rs-vigil-2021.plot: When a fishing trawler vanishes and a crew member dies aboard a British nuclear-armed submarine, a police detective is sent aboard to investigate while her partner on land uncovers a wider conspiracy. Later series bring new high-stakes military cases.

rs-spooks-2002.plot: Officers of MI5's counter-terrorism Section D at Thames House juggle bombings, foreign agents and political betrayal, often at heavy personal cost, under section chief Harry Pearce.

rs-the-high-chaparral-1967.plot: Rancher Big John Cannon builds a cattle empire in the Arizona Territory, forging an alliance through marriage with a powerful Mexican family while facing Apache conflicts, rustlers and the harsh desert.

rs-the-big-valley-1965.plot: Strong-willed widow Victoria Barkley runs a vast cattle ranch in California's San Joaquin Valley with her grown children, including an illegitimate son of her late husband, defending their land against swindlers and outlaws.

rs-the-virginian-1962.plot: The mysterious, principled foreman of the sprawling Shiloh Ranch near Medicine Bow, Wyoming, and the ranch's owners and hands deal with outlaws, settlers, land disputes and drifters in 90-minute frontier stories.

rs-texas-rising-2015.plot: After the fall of the Alamo, Sam Houston leads a ragtag Texian army and the newly formed Texas Rangers in a desperate fight against Santa Anna's Mexican forces, culminating in the Battle of San Jacinto.

rs-the-son-2017.plot: Eli McCullough, kidnapped and raised by Comanches as a boy, becomes a ruthless Texas cattle and oil patriarch; parallel timelines in the 1840s and 1915 show his family's violent rise amid border unrest.

rs-lawmen-bass-reeves-2023.plot: Formerly enslaved Bass Reeves becomes one of the first Black deputy U.S. marshals west of the Mississippi, tracking outlaws through Indian Territory while the job tests his morals and strains his family life.

rs-shark-2006.plot: Ruthless celebrity defense attorney Sebastian Stark switches sides after a client he got acquitted kills again, leading a team of young prosecutors in Los Angeles while trying to reconnect with his teenage daughter.

rs-parade-s-end-2012.plot: A principled, old-fashioned Tory aristocrat is trapped in a marriage to his unfaithful, glamorous wife while falling for a young suffragette. Their love triangle plays out against the end of Edwardian England and the First World War.
rs-parade-s-end-2012.source: Parade's End by Ford Madox Ford

rs-sword-of-honour-2001.plot: Guy Crouchback, a disillusioned Catholic aristocrat, joins the army at the outbreak of World War II hoping for a noble cause, but finds bureaucracy, farce and moral compromise from Britain to Crete and Yugoslavia.
rs-sword-of-honour-2001.source: Sword of Honour trilogy by Evelyn Waugh

rs-the-line-of-beauty-2006.plot: Young gay Oxford graduate Nick Guest lodges with the wealthy family of a rising Tory MP in Thatcher-era London, where his entry into high society, drugs and romance unfolds against the shadow of AIDS.
rs-the-line-of-beauty-2006.source: The Line of Beauty by Alan Hollinghurst

rs-queen-charlotte-a-bridgerton-story-20.plot: A Bridgerton prequel about young Charlotte's arranged marriage to King George III, their growing love despite his hidden illness, and how their union reshaped society, intercut with the older queen's story in the Bridgerton era.

rs-sanditon-2019.plot: Spirited young Charlotte Heywood leaves her rural home for the developing seaside resort of Sanditon, where she becomes entangled in its society, scandals and a romance with the brooding Sidney Parker.

rs-outlander-2014.plot: In 1945 a British combat nurse is mysteriously sent back to 1743 Scotland, where she is forced into marriage with a Highland warrior. Their love story spans Jacobite risings, France and colonial America.

rs-comanche-moon-2008.plot: A prequel to Lonesome Dove following young Texas Rangers Gus McCrae and Woodrow Call in the 1850s and 1860s as they pursue Comanche raiders and a Mexican bandit, while juggling the women they love on the frontier.

rs-hell-on-wheels-2011.plot: After the Civil War, former Confederate soldier Cullen Bohannon hunts the Union men who killed his wife, a quest that leads him to work on the Union Pacific's construction of the first transcontinental railroad and the lawless camp that follows it.

rs-the-english-2022.plot: In 1890, an English aristocrat seeking revenge for her son's death crosses the American West and forms an uneasy alliance with a Pawnee ex-cavalry scout trying to claim land he was promised, as violence and old crimes trail them.

rs-the-goldbergs-2013.plot: In the 1980s, a young boy with a video camera records the chaos of his loud, loving suburban family. His overbearing mother, grumpy dad, siblings and fun-loving grandfather fill the stories, which are based on the creator's own childhood.

rs-young-sheldon-2017.plot: Nine-year-old genius Sheldon Cooper starts high school in small-town East Texas, struggling to fit in with his loving but bewildered family, narrated by his adult self years later.

rs-the-days-and-nights-of-molly-dodd-198.plot: Divorced, thirtysomething New Yorker Molly Dodd drifts through jobs, romances and quiet disappointments in this bittersweet, unconventional comedy-drama with no laugh track and a melancholy, jazz-tinged tone.

rs-newsradio-1995.plot: New news director Dave Nelson tries to manage the eccentric, self-absorbed staff of a New York AM news radio station, including an egotistical anchor and the station's oddball billionaire owner.

rs-the-comeback-2005.plot: Faded sitcom actress Valerie Cherish lets reality-TV cameras follow her every move as she clings to fame, enduring humiliation after humiliation across her attempted comebacks.

rs-return-to-lonesome-dove-1993.plot: Woodrow Call drives a herd of wild mustangs from Texas to Montana to start a ranch, while Newt, Gus McCrae's old flame Clara and a new set of allies and enemies face hardship on the frontier.

rs-bones-2005.plot: Brilliant but socially awkward forensic anthropologist Temperance 'Bones' Brennan teams with cocky FBI agent Seeley Booth to solve murders from victims' remains, aided by her team at the Jeffersonian.
rs-bones-2005.source: Temperance Brennan novels by Kathy Reichs

rs-criminal-minds-2005.plot: An elite team of FBI profilers in the Behavioral Analysis Unit travels the country analyzing the psychology of serial killers and other violent offenders to anticipate their next moves.

setting.place: Quantico, Virginia and across the USA

rs-silent-witness-1996.plot: Forensic pathologists, first led by Sam Ryan and later by Nikki Alexander and colleagues at the Lyell Centre, examine the dead to uncover the truth behind murders and suspicious deaths, usually in two-part stories.

rs-your-show-of-shows-1950.plot: A live 90-minute Saturday-night revue built around Sid Caesar's comic genius, featuring movie parodies, sketches, foreign-language double-talk and musical numbers, written by a legendary room including Mel Brooks, Neil Simon and Carl Reiner.

rs-the-carol-burnett-show-1967.plot: Carol Burnett and her ensemble deliver movie parodies, recurring sketches like "The Family" and musical numbers, opening each week with an audience Q&A and closing with Carol's trademark ear tug.

rs-saturday-night-live-1975.plot: A live late-night sketch comedy show from New York's Studio 8H, with a weekly celebrity host, a musical guest, a repertory cast and the 'Weekend Update' news parody, satirizing politics and pop culture. It has launched generations of comedy stars.

rs-prime-suspect-1991.plot: Detective Chief Inspector Jane Tennison battles institutional sexism within London's Metropolitan Police while leading complex murder investigations, in a run of gripping multi-part stories that follow her career and personal costs.

rs-scott-bailey-2011.plot: Manchester murder detectives Rachel Bailey, impulsive and chaotic, and Janet Scott, steady and methodical, work major cases under their formidable boss Gill Murray, while their friendship is tested by messy personal lives.

rs-rizzoli-isles-2010.plot: Tough Boston homicide detective Jane Rizzoli and refined chief medical examiner Maura Isles are opposites and best friends who team up to solve murders, combining street smarts with forensic science.

rs-punk-d-2003.plot: A hidden-camera prank show in which celebrities are set up in elaborate, embarrassing hoaxes before being told they have been 'punk'd'.

rs-trigger-happy-tv-2000.plot: Dom Joly stages surreal hidden-camera pranks on unsuspecting members of the public, from shouting into a giant mobile phone to wearing animal costumes in the street, set to an indie soundtrack.

rs-jackass-2000.plot: Johnny Knoxville and a crew of friends perform dangerous, painful and gross-out stunts and pranks on themselves and the public, filmed in raw, homemade style.

rs-barnaby-jones-1973.plot: Retired Los Angeles private investigator Barnaby Jones returns to work after his son is murdered, solving that case and many more with his widowed daughter-in-law Betty, relying on folksy charm and a home crime lab.

rs-banacek-1972.plot: Suave Boston freelance investigator Thomas Banacek recovers seemingly impossible thefts for insurance companies in exchange for a ten percent finder's fee, quoting Polish proverbs and outwitting a rival insurance agent along the way. Part of the NBC Mystery Movie rotation.

rs-harry-o-1974.plot: Harry Orwell, a former cop forced into retirement by a bullet lodged in his back, works as a laid-back private investigator in San Diego and later Los Angeles, often taking the bus because his car is always broken.

rs-centennial-1978.plot: An epic saga of the land and people that become the town of Centennial, Colorado, tracing Native Americans, fur trappers, settlers, ranchers and their descendants from the late eighteenth century to the 1970s. Adapted from James A. Michener's novel.

rs-north-and-south-1985.plot: Orry Main of a South Carolina plantation family and George Hazard of a Pennsylvania industrial family become best friends at West Point, but slavery, love affairs and sectional hatred strain their bond as the nation heads toward civil war.
rs-north-and-south-1985.source: North and South by John Jakes

rs-little-gloria-happy-at-last-1982.plot: In 1920s and 1930s New York, young heiress Gloria Vanderbilt becomes the prize in a bitter custody battle between her glamorous, careless mother and her formidable aunt Gertrude Vanderbilt Whitney, exposing the cruelty behind high-society wealth.
rs-little-gloria-happy-at-last-1982.source: Little Gloria... Happy at Last by Barbara Goldsmith

rs-f-troop-1965.plot: Bumbling Captain Wilton Parmenter accidentally becomes a Civil War hero and is put in charge of remote Fort Courage, where crafty Sergeant O'Rourke and Corporal Agarn run profitable schemes with the local Hekawi tribe.

rs-omnibus-1952.plot: Host Alistair Cooke presents a wide-ranging cultural magazine of drama, music, dance, science and history, including Leonard Bernstein's celebrated music lectures, aiming to bring the arts and ideas to a mass audience.

rs-lux-video-theatre-1950.plot: Sponsored by Lux soap, this anthology presented live and later filmed adaptations of plays and Hollywood movies with film stars in the leading roles, introduced each week by a host.

rs-schlitz-playhouse-of-stars-1951.plot: Sponsored by Schlitz beer, this anthology offered a different drama, comedy or mystery each week, starring well-known Hollywood actors and, in its first season, hosted by Irene Dunne.

rs-wings-1990.plot: Estranged brothers Joe and Brian Hackett run a tiny one-plane airline out of Nantucket's small airport, bickering with each other and with a quirky staff that includes a lunch-counter owner and an eccentric cab driver.

rs-black-books-2000.plot: Misanthropic, wine-soaked Irish bookseller Bernard Black does everything he can to avoid customers in his London shop, aided and hindered by his gentle assistant Manny and his friend Fran.

rs-the-good-doctor-2017.plot: Shaun Murphy, a young surgeon with autism and savant syndrome, joins a prestigious San Jose hospital, proving himself to skeptical colleagues while solving difficult medical cases and navigating relationships.

rs-new-amsterdam-2018.plot: Dr. Max Goodwin, the idealistic new medical director of America's oldest public hospital, tears down bureaucracy to put patients first, while facing personal tragedy and illness of his own.

rs-the-knick-2014.plot: In 1900 New York, a brilliant, cocaine-addicted surgeon pushes the limits of medicine at the Knickerbocker Hospital. Racism, corruption and the hospital's money troubles complicate his pioneering work.

rs-in-the-heat-of-the-night-1988.plot: In small-town Sparta, Mississippi, white police chief Bill Gillespie and Black chief of detectives Virgil Tibbs overcome mutual distrust to solve crimes while confronting racism and social change in the modern South.
rs-in-the-heat-of-the-night-1988.source: In the Heat of the Night (1967)

rs-rectify-2013.plot: A man freed after nearly 20 years on death row, when new DNA evidence casts doubt on his conviction, returns to his small Georgia hometown. He struggles to adapt as his family and the town reckon with the crime that put him away.

rs-broadchurch-2013.plot: The murder of a young boy in a close-knit Dorset seaside town brings a troubled outsider detective and a local sergeant together. The investigation exposes the community's secrets, and later series cover a trial and a sexual assault case.

rs-tour-of-duty-1987.plot: Sergeant Zeke Anderson leads a platoon of young American infantrymen through combat in the Vietnam War, confronting danger, racial tension, moral dilemmas and the war's toll, later including Saigon and special operations missions.

rs-the-sympathizer-2024.plot: A half-French, half-Vietnamese communist spy flees to Los Angeles after the fall of Saigon with a South Vietnamese general, secretly reporting on the refugee community while torn between his two identities.
rs-the-sympathizer-2024.source: The Sympathizer by Viet Thanh Nguyen

rs-an-american-family-1973.plot: A camera crew follows the Louds, an affluent Santa Barbara family, through seven months of 1971, capturing everyday life as well as the parents' separation and son Lance's openness about being gay. Often called the first reality TV series.

rs-unreal-2015.plot: Rachel, a gifted but troubled producer on a Bachelor-style dating show, manipulates contestants to create drama under her ruthless boss Quinn, exposing the cynical machinery behind reality television.

rs-suspense-1949.plot: A live anthology of thrillers, mysteries and tales of menace adapted from the long-running radio program, each episode presenting a new cast caught in a tense, often deadly situation.

rs-warrior-2019.plot: In 1870s San Francisco, Chinese martial arts prodigy Ah Sahm arrives to find his sister and becomes a hatchet man for a powerful tong during the Tong Wars, amid racism and political turmoil in Chinatown.
rs-warrior-2019.source: Based on writings by Bruce Lee

rs-into-the-badlands-2015.plot: In a post-apocalyptic feudal land ruled by barons who command armies of trained killers, the warrior Sunny and a mysterious young boy set out on a journey to find enlightenment and escape the Badlands.

rs-outer-banks-2020.plot: In the coastal Outer Banks of North Carolina, a tight-knit group of working-class teens called the Pogues hunts for a legendary lost treasure linked to the disappearance of their leader John B's father, clashing with wealthy rivals.

rs-poker-face-2023.plot: Charlie Cale has an uncanny ability to tell when someone is lying. On the run from a casino boss, she drives across America and keeps stumbling into murders that she can't help solving, one per episode.

rs-monk-2002.plot: Adrian Monk, a brilliant former San Francisco detective crippled by obsessive-compulsive disorder and phobias after his wife's murder, consults for the police on baffling cases while hoping to solve her death.

rs-inspector-morse-1987.plot: Cerebral, opera-loving and melancholy Detective Chief Inspector Morse and his down-to-earth sergeant Lewis investigate murders among the colleges and leafy streets of Oxford in feature-length mysteries.
rs-inspector-morse-1987.source: Inspector Morse novels by Colin Dexter

rs-cambridge-spies-2003.plot: Four idealistic Cambridge students, Kim Philby, Guy Burgess, Donald Maclean and Anthony Blunt, are recruited by Soviet intelligence in the 1930s and rise through the British establishment while secretly betraying it.

rs-the-plot-against-america-2020.plot: An alternate history in which aviator and isolationist Charles Lindbergh defeats Franklin Roosevelt in 1940, seen through a working-class Jewish family in Newark as antisemitism and authoritarianism spread across America.

rs-wives-and-daughters-1999.plot: In 1830s rural England, sweet-natured Molly Gibson's life is upended when her widowed father marries a vain widow, bringing a glamorous stepsister whose romantic entanglements threaten Molly's happiness.
rs-wives-and-daughters-1999.source: Wives and Daughters by Elizabeth Gaskell

rs-candy-2022.plot: In 1980 Texas, a seemingly perfect churchgoing housewife, Candy Montgomery, is accused of killing her friend Betty Gore with an axe, as the series revisits the affair and suburban pressures that led to the killing.

rs-vinyl-2016.plot: In 1973 New York, cocaine-fueled record executive Richie Finestra tries to save his failing label by chasing the city's emerging punk, disco and hip-hop sounds, while a crime from his past threatens to catch up with him.

rs-nashville-2012.plot: A fading country-music queen and a rising young pop-country star clash and collaborate in Nashville. The series follows their careers, romances and family secrets, along with the musicians around them, with plenty of original songs.

rs-pistol-2022.plot: Guitarist Steve Jones tells the story of the Sex Pistols, from forming a band in 1970s London with Malcolm McLaren's backing to Johnny Rotten's arrival, the punk explosion and the chaos around Sid Vicious and Nancy Spungen.
rs-pistol-2022.source: Lonely Boy: Tales from a Sex Pistol (Steve Jones)

rs-knots-landing-1979.plot: Gary Ewing, black sheep of the Dallas oil family, and his wife Valene settle on a Southern California cul-de-sac, where they and their neighbors are drawn into affairs, business schemes, crime and family turmoil. A spin-off of Dallas.

rs-falcon-crest-1981.plot: In California's wine country, ruthless matriarch Angela Channing schemes to control the Falcon Crest vineyard and the valley, battling her nephew Chase Gioberti and a succession of rivals in feuds over land, money and love.

rs-landman-2024.plot: Tommy Norris, a crisis manager for an oil company in West Texas, deals with drilling disasters, cartels, lawyers and billionaire bosses during an oil boom, while his chaotic ex-wife and children keep complicating his life.

rs-bloodline-2015.plot: The respected Rayburn family runs an inn in the Florida Keys. When the black-sheep eldest son returns home, buried secrets and resentments threaten to destroy them.

rs-billions-2016.plot: Ambitious U.S. Attorney Chuck Rhoades goes after brilliant hedge fund king Bobby Axelrod in a high-stakes battle of power and money, complicated by the fact that Rhoades' wife works for Axelrod.

rs-how-to-get-away-with-murder-2014.plot: A formidable criminal-defense attorney and law professor recruits five ambitious students to work at her firm. They become entangled in a murder plot that ties them to her, told through flash-forwards and twists.

rs-good-girls-2018.plot: Three suburban Michigan mothers, desperate for money, rob a local grocery store, only to find themselves entangled with a charismatic gang leader and drawn ever deeper into crime.

rs-grace-and-frankie-2015.plot: Two women in their seventies with very different personalities are thrown together when their husbands, longtime law partners, announce they are in love with each other and want to marry, forcing them to rebuild their lives.

rs-queen-sugar-2016.plot: After their father's death, the estranged Bordelon siblings, a journalist, a businesswoman and a struggling single father, reunite to run his 800-acre sugarcane farm in rural Louisiana.

rs-evening-shade-1990.plot: Former Pittsburgh Steelers quarterback Wood Newton returns to his small Arkansas hometown to coach a hopeless high school football team, surrounded by his lawyer wife, kids and a colorful cast of eccentric locals.

rs-hot-in-cleveland-2010.plot: Three glamorous Los Angeles women past forty, a novelist, a soap actress and an eyebrow stylist, make an emergency landing in Cleveland and decide to stay, renting a house that comes with a feisty elderly caretaker, Elka.

rs-devious-maids-2013.plot: Four Latina housekeepers working for wealthy Beverly Hills families become entangled in their employers' secrets after a fellow maid's murder. Their friendship carries them through scandals, romances and mysteries.
rs-devious-maids-2013.source: Ellas son... la alegría del hogar

rs-why-women-kill-2019.plot: A darkly comic anthology about women driven to murder by the betrayals in their marriages; the first season tracks three wives living in the same Pasadena house in different decades, the second a 1949 housewife.

rs-pretty-little-liars-2010.plot: A year after their ringleader Alison vanished, four estranged high-school friends in Rosewood, Pennsylvania begin receiving threatening messages from an anonymous 'A' who knows their darkest secrets, pulling them into a long mystery of murder and stalking.

rs-primeval-2007.plot: When anomalies in time begin opening across Britain, letting dinosaurs and other prehistoric and future creatures through, evolutionary zoologist Nick Cutter and a small team race to contain them.

rs-terra-nova-2011.plot: In 2149, with Earth dying from pollution, the Shannon family travels back 85 million years through a time fracture to join Terra Nova, a colony in the age of dinosaurs. Beyond prehistoric predators, the settlement faces rebels and a hidden agenda.

setting.place: Terra Nova colony, Late Cretaceous Earth

rs-the-pallisers-1974.plot: Over two decades of Victorian high society and politics, earnest heir Plantagenet Palliser rises toward prime minister while his spirited wife Lady Glencora struggles with a marriage arranged against her heart. Adapted from Anthony Trollope's six Palliser novels.

rs-lillie-1978.plot: The life of Lillie Langtry, a Jersey clergyman's daughter who became a celebrated society beauty, mistress of the Prince of Wales, a successful actress in Britain and America, and a symbol of the Victorian and Edwardian eras.

rs-victoria-2016.plot: Queen Victoria takes the throne at 18 and must learn to rule amid scheming courtiers and political crises, while her romance and marriage with Prince Albert shape her early reign.

rs-jag-1995.plot: Former Navy pilot Harmon Rabb Jr. serves as a lawyer in the Navy's Judge Advocate General corps, investigating and litigating military crimes alongside Marine officer Sarah MacKenzie.

rs-narcos-mexico-2018.plot: The rise of the Guadalajara Cartel under Miguel Ángel Félix Gallardo in the 1980s, as DEA agent Kiki Camarena works to bring it down, and the bloody splintering of Mexico's drug trade that follows.

rs-crime-story-1986.plot: In early-1960s Chicago, Lieutenant Mike Torello's Major Crime Unit wages an obsessive war against rising mobster Ray Luca, a feud that follows them to Las Vegas as Luca climbs the ranks of organized crime.

rs-snowfall-2017.plot: In 1983 Los Angeles, young dealer Franklin Saint, a Mexican wrestler's niece and a rogue CIA officer collide as crack cocaine arrives and transforms South Central, fueling Franklin's rise into a drug empire.

rs-escobar-el-patron-del-mal-2012.plot: The rise and fall of Colombian drug lord Pablo Escobar, from petty crime in Medellín to running the world's most powerful cocaine cartel. It depicts his war against the state and the many victims of his violence.
rs-escobar-el-patron-del-mal-2012.source: La parábola de Pablo (book by Alonso Salazar)

rs-zerozerozero-2020.plot: A cocaine shipment travels from a Mexican cartel through an American shipping-broker family to the 'Ndrangheta in Calabria, and the series traces how the global drug trade binds and destroys everyone along the route.

rs-the-play-of-the-week-1959.plot: A prestige anthology presenting full-length productions of classic and modern stage plays, from Ibsen and Chekhov to Eugene O'Neill, performed by leading theater actors for local New York station WNTA and syndication.

rs-armstrong-circle-theatre-1950.plot: A long-running dramatic anthology that began with original plays and later specialized in documentary-style dramatizations of real news events, social issues and true stories, introduced by a host-narrator.

rs-the-big-c-2010.plot: Buttoned-up suburban teacher Cathy Jamison is diagnosed with terminal melanoma and decides to keep it secret, using her remaining time to shake up her life, her marriage to man-child Paul and her relationship with her teenage son.

rs-somebody-somewhere-2022.plot: Grieving her sister's death and adrift in her Kansas hometown, a woman in her forties rediscovers her singing voice and finds belonging among a group of misfit friends.

rs-feel-good-2020.plot: Canadian stand-up comedian Mae, a recovering addict living in Manchester, falls into an intense relationship with Londoner George, who has never dated a woman before, as both confront their pasts and identities.

rs-the-colbys-1985.plot: In this Dynasty spin-off, Jeff Colby and Fallon are drawn into the lavish, scheming world of his wealthy Los Angeles relatives, ruled by shipping and aerospace tycoon Jason Colby, amid family secrets, romance and corporate warfare.

rs-third-watch-1999.plot: The police officers, paramedics and firefighters who work the 3-to-11 p.m. shift in a New York neighborhood face dangerous emergencies on the job and turmoil at home.

rs-casualty-1986.plot: The doctors, nurses and paramedics of Holby City Hospital's emergency department treat a stream of accident and trauma victims while their own personal lives, relationships and rivalries play out across the shifts.

rs-code-black-2015.plot: In the overcrowded emergency room of Los Angeles' Angels Memorial Hospital, where patients often outnumber resources, a demanding residency director and her staff train new doctors to make fast, high-stakes decisions.

rs-peyton-place-1964.plot: Behind the respectable facade of a small New England town, scandal, secret affairs, family feuds and hidden pasts entangle residents such as Constance MacKenzie, her daughter Allison and the wealthy Harrington family. A pioneering prime-time soap opera.

rs-edward-the-seventh-1975.plot: The life of Queen Victoria's eldest son, Albert Edward, from a strict childhood and decades as a pleasure-loving Prince of Wales kept from power by his mother, to his brief reign as king and his role as a peacemaker in Europe.

rs-the-tudors-2007.plot: A lusty, volatile young Henry VIII rules England amid court intrigue, his break with Rome and a succession of six wives, as ambitious courtiers rise and fall with his favor.

rs-the-virgin-queen-2005.plot: Elizabeth I survives imprisonment under her sister Mary to take the English throne, then rules for decades amid plots, war with Spain and pressure to marry, sacrificing personal love for power.

rs-becoming-elizabeth-2022.plot: After Henry VIII's death, the teenage Elizabeth Tudor navigates the treacherous court politics of her brother Edward VI's reign, including a dangerous entanglement with Thomas Seymour, on her path toward the throne.

rs-copper-2012.plot: An Irish-American police detective returns from the Civil War to patrol the violent Five Points slum of 1860s New York. While solving crimes across class lines he searches for the truth about his missing wife and dead daughter.

rs-elvis-presley-the-searcher-2018.plot: A two-part documentary exploring Elvis Presley's musical roots and artistic drive, from his Memphis upbringing and Sun Records breakthrough through Hollywood, the 1968 comeback and his final years.

rs-younger-2015.plot: Liza, a 40-year-old divorced mother struggling to re-enter publishing, passes herself off as 26 to land an entry-level job, and must keep up the lie as her career and romances take off.

rs-call-my-agent-2015.plot: At a struggling Paris talent agency, a team of agents scrambles to keep real French film stars happy, employed and out of trouble, while their own careers, rivalries and love lives threaten to unravel the firm.

rs-gossip-girl-2007.plot: Privileged teens on Manhattan's Upper East Side scheme, romance and betray one another while an anonymous blogger known as Gossip Girl exposes their secrets to everyone.
rs-gossip-girl-2007.source: Gossip Girl by Cecily von Ziegesar

rs-lucky-hank-2023.plot: Hank Devereaux, the cynical chair of the English department at an underfunded Pennsylvania college, has a midlife crisis after an outburst at a student goes viral, upsetting his job, his marriage and his relationship with his famous father.

rs-ballers-2015.plot: A retired NFL star turns financial manager for current and former players in Miami. He steers clients through money trouble, contracts and the temptations of fame while fixing his own life.

rs-extras-2005.plot: Struggling background actor Andy Millman and his friend Maggie hustle on film and TV sets alongside celebrities playing warped versions of themselves, until Andy's sitcom becomes a hit and fame proves hollow.

rs-episodes-2011.plot: A married British comedy-writing couple move to Los Angeles to adapt their hit sitcom for American TV, only to see it mangled by network executives and recast with Matt LeBlanc, playing a self-absorbed version of himself.

rs-black-bird-2022.plot: Jimmy Keene, a drug dealer serving ten years, is offered freedom if he can befriend suspected serial killer Larry Hall inside a maximum-security prison and get him to reveal where he buried his victims.
rs-black-bird-2022.source: In with the Devil (James Keene, Hillel Levin)

rs-skins-2007.plot: Successive generations of Bristol sixth-form students navigate sex, drugs, parties, mental illness and family dysfunction, with each episode focusing on a different member of the group.

rs-my-so-called-life-1994.plot: Fifteen-year-old Angela Chase narrates her turbulent sophomore year in suburban Pittsburgh, as she reinvents herself with new friends, pines for the enigmatic Jordan Catalano and clashes with her parents.

rs-13-reasons-why-2017.plot: High schooler Clay Jensen receives a box of cassette tapes recorded by his classmate and crush Hannah Baker before her suicide, each explaining how a different person contributed to her decision.
rs-13-reasons-why-2017.source: Thirteen Reasons Why by Jay Asher

rs-the-king-of-queens-1998.plot: Delivery driver Doug Heffernan and his sharp-tongued wife Carrie navigate married life in Queens, complicated by Carrie's eccentric father Arthur living in their basement.

rs-the-middle-2009.plot: Frankie Heck, a harried car saleswoman in small-town Indiana, narrates the struggles of her lower-middle-class family: laconic husband Mike, slacker son Axl, relentlessly hopeful daughter Sue and quirky youngest Brick, as they scrape by from paycheck to paycheck.

rs-twisted-metal-2023.plot: In a lawless post-apocalyptic America, a wisecracking milkman delivers packages between walled-off cities, teaming up with a car thief as they face raiders, a homicidal clown named Sweet Tooth, and a deadly demolition derby.

rs-station-eleven-2021.plot: Years after a flu pandemic collapses civilization, a young actress tours the Great Lakes region with a troupe performing Shakespeare, while flashbacks link survivors connected by a famous actor's onstage death and a mysterious graphic novel.

rs-smash-2012.plot: Songwriters, a director and producers mount a Broadway musical about Marilyn Monroe. Two actresses compete for the lead role, while backstage rivalries and romances threaten the show.

rs-bunheads-2012.plot: A Las Vegas showgirl impulsively marries a devoted admirer and moves to his sleepy California town. After a sudden tragedy she ends up teaching at her new mother-in-law's ballet school, mentoring its teenage students.

rs-degrassi-junior-high-1987.plot: Students at a Toronto junior high deal frankly with adolescence, from crushes and friendships to teen pregnancy, drugs, divorce and identity, in a realistic drama cast with non-professional young actors.

rs-eight-is-enough-1977.plot: Sacramento newspaper columnist Tom Bradford raises eight children, first after the loss of his wife and then with his new wife Abby, coping with the romances, ambitions and crises of a large, boisterous family.

rs-my-three-sons-1960.plot: Widowed aeronautical engineer Steve Douglas raises his three sons with help from their grandfather Bub and later Uncle Charley, through school troubles, romances, weddings and an ever-changing household.

rs-full-house-1987.plot: After his wife's death, San Francisco sportscaster Danny Tanner enlists his rock-musician brother-in-law Jesse and comedian best friend Joey to help raise his three young daughters, in a warm family comedy.

rs-american-dad-2005.plot: Ultra-patriotic CIA agent Stan Smith lives in suburban Langley Falls with his liberal daughter, nerdy son, cheerful wife, a German-speaking goldfish and Roger, a flamboyant alien with endless disguises.

rs-futurama-1999.plot: Pizza delivery boy Philip J. Fry is accidentally frozen and wakes up in the year 3000, where he joins a ragtag interplanetary delivery company with a one-eyed captain and a hard-drinking robot.

rs-bob-s-burgers-2011.plot: Bob Belcher runs a struggling burger joint in a seaside town with his enthusiastic wife Linda and their three eccentric kids, Tina, Gene and Louise, whose schemes, crushes and songs keep the family business and their lives in comic chaos.

rs-the-a-word-2016.plot: When five-year-old Joe, who loves music and lives in his own world, is diagnosed with autism, his parents and extended family in the Lake District struggle to adapt and face their own problems.

rs-atypical-2017.plot: Sam, an 18-year-old on the autism spectrum, decides he is ready to date and gain independence, setting off a journey of self-discovery that shakes up his overprotective mother, his father and his sister.

rs-growing-pains-1985.plot: Psychiatrist Jason Seaver moves his practice home so his journalist wife Maggie can return to work, and he juggles raising their wisecracking teen son Mike and his siblings on Long Island.

setting.place: Huntington, Long Island, New York, USA

rs-spin-city-1996.plot: Deputy Mayor Mike Flaherty and his dysfunctional staff scramble to keep New York's gaffe-prone mayor out of trouble and in the headlines for the right reasons.

rs-who-s-the-boss-1984.plot: Retired baseball player and widowed father Tony Micelli moves from Brooklyn to Connecticut to work as live-in housekeeper for driven advertising executive Angela Bower, blending their families while a slow-burning romance develops.

rs-a-spy-among-friends-2022.plot: After Kim Philby defects to the Soviet Union in 1963, his closest friend and fellow MI6 officer Nicholas Elliott is questioned about their decades-long friendship, revisiting how Britain's most notorious double agent deceived everyone.

rs-deutschland-83-2015.plot: A young East German border guard is forced to go undercover in West Germany as an aide to a NATO general, spying for the Stasi at the height of Cold War tensions; later seasons follow him through 1986 and 1989.

rs-leave-it-to-beaver-1957.plot: Curious, well-meaning young Theodore "Beaver" Cleaver gets into everyday scrapes at school and around the neighborhood, then learns gentle lessons from his patient parents June and Ward and his older brother Wally.

rs-the-donna-reed-show-1958.plot: Donna Stone, a warm and capable homemaker married to a small-town pediatrician, steers her two teenage children through everyday family comedies and gentle moral lessons.

rs-the-last-tycoon-2016.plot: In 1930s Hollywood, golden-boy studio executive Monroe Stahr battles his boss and mentor Pat Brady for control of a movie studio, as the Depression and the rise of Nazi Germany shadow the film industry.
rs-the-last-tycoon-2016.source: The Last Tycoon by F. Scott Fitzgerald

rs-science-fiction-theatre-1955.plot: Host Truman Bradley introduces stand-alone tales of scientists and ordinary people confronting strange phenomena, new inventions and possible alien contact, stories grounded in plausible science of the day.

rs-matinee-theater-1955.plot: An ambitious weekday-afternoon anthology broadcast live and in color, presenting a new hour-long drama every day, from classic adaptations to original plays, introduced by host John Conte.

rs-scenes-from-a-marriage-2021.plot: An intimate portrait of a contemporary American couple, a philosophy professor and a tech executive, whose marriage erodes through infidelity, separation and divorce, explored over years of raw, conversation-driven encounters.

rs-divorce-2016.plot: After years of marriage, Frances decides she wants a divorce from her husband Robert, and the couple's long, messy split plays out in the suburbs of New York as they fight, co-parent and slowly start new lives.

rs-mrs-fletcher-2019.plot: When her son leaves for college, divorced single mother Eve Fletcher explores a new sense of freedom and sexuality in suburbia, while her son struggles to fit in at college.

rs-pennies-from-heaven-1978.plot: In 1930s England, frustrated sheet-music salesman Arthur Parker escapes his drab marriage and failing business into the romantic world of popular songs, as the cast lip-sync to period recordings, while his affair with a schoolteacher leads to disaster.

setting.place: London and Forest of Dean, England

rs-the-singing-detective-1986.plot: Hospitalized with crippling psoriasis, embittered pulp writer Philip Marlow escapes into feverish fantasies mixing his 1940s noir detective novel, childhood memories and paranoid suspicions, with characters bursting into lip-synced period songs.

rs-open-all-hours-1976.plot: Miserly, stammering shopkeeper Arkwright runs a corner shop in a northern English town, squeezing pennies from customers, working his put-upon nephew Granville to the bone and pursuing the nurse across the street.

rs-the-ed-sullivan-show-1948.plot: Newspaper columnist Ed Sullivan hosts a Sunday-night variety hour mixing comedians, singers, rock bands, circus acts, opera stars and puppets. Originally titled Toast of the Town, it became America's showcase stage, famous for introducing Elvis Presley and the Beatles to national audiences.

rs-sports-night-1998.plot: Behind the scenes of a nightly cable sports-highlights show, the anchors, producers and staff race the clock, trade rapid-fire banter and wrestle with ethics, ratings and romance.

rs-a-different-world-1987.plot: Spun off from The Cosby Show, it follows students at historically Black Hillman College in Virginia as they navigate classes, romance, friendship and social issues, centering on Whitley Gilbert and Dwayne Wayne.

rs-becker-1998.plot: Dr. John Becker, a brilliant but chronically grumpy physician running a small practice in the Bronx, rants about everything while secretly caring for his patients, staff and diner friends.

rs-for-all-mankind-2019.plot: In an alternate history where the Soviet Union lands on the Moon first, the space race never ends, and NASA's astronauts, engineers and their families drive decades of technological and social change as humanity expands to the Moon and Mars.

rs-the-right-stuff-2020.plot: At the dawn of the space race, NASA selects the Mercury Seven astronauts, and the series follows the rivalries, ambitions and family strains of pilots like John Glenn and Alan Shepard as they compete to be the first American in space.

rs-the-astronaut-wives-club-2015.plot: As NASA's Mercury Seven astronauts become national heroes in the space race, their wives are thrust into the spotlight, forming an unlikely sisterhood while dealing with fame, danger and strained marriages.
rs-the-astronaut-wives-club-2015.source: The Astronaut Wives Club by Lily Koppel

rs-physical-2021.plot: In 1980s San Diego, a quietly tormented housewife supporting her husband's political ambitions discovers aerobics and builds a fitness empire, all while battling a vicious inner voice and an eating disorder.

rs-minx-2022.plot: In 1970s Los Angeles, an earnest young feminist teams up with a sleazy porn publisher to launch the first erotic magazine for women, using its centerfolds to sell her political message.

rs-a-league-of-their-own-2022.plot: In 1943, women join the new All-American Girls Professional Baseball League, while a Black woman barred from the league pursues her own baseball dream; both stories explore race, sexuality and ambition.

rs-the-comey-rule-2020.plot: A two-part dramatization of FBI Director James Comey's handling of the Hillary Clinton email investigation and the Russia inquiry, culminating in his fraught relationship with President Donald Trump and his 2017 firing.

rs-the-loudest-voice-2019.plot: The story of Roger Ailes and his rise to build Fox News into a dominant political force, and his eventual downfall amid sexual harassment allegations from women including Gretchen Carlson.
rs-the-loudest-voice-2019.source: The Loudest Voice in the Room (Gabriel Sherman)

rs-tanner-88-1988.plot: Fictional Michigan congressman Jack Tanner runs for the Democratic presidential nomination in a mock-documentary filmed on the real 1988 campaign trail, where actual politicians mingle with his staff and family.

rs-death-valley-days-1952.plot: A Western anthology dramatizing true stories of pioneers, prospectors, outlaws and settlers in the Old West, especially around Death Valley, introduced by a series of hosts including the Old Ranger and Ronald Reagan. Sponsored by 20 Mule Team Borax.

rs-over-there-2005.plot: A squad of young U.S. Army soldiers on their first tour in Iraq faces combat, moral dilemmas and fear, while their families back home struggle with their absence.

rs-the-long-road-home-2017.plot: On April 4, 2004, a platoon from the 1st Cavalry Division is ambushed in Sadr City, Baghdad, as soldiers fight for survival and their families wait anxiously back home in Fort Hood, Texas.
rs-the-long-road-home-2017.source: The Long Road Home by Martha Raddatz (nonfiction book)

setting.place: Sadr City, Iraq and Fort Hood, Texas

rs-manhattan-2014.plot: Scientists and their families live in a secret, guarded town at Los Alamos during World War II while racing to build the atomic bomb. Secrecy, rivalry and suspicion of spies strain their work and marriages.

rs-leonardo-2021.plot: Arrested and accused of poisoning his muse, Leonardo da Vinci recounts his life to an investigator, from his training in Verrocchio's workshop to rivalries and patrons in Renaissance Florence and Milan, in a heavily fictionalized portrait.

rs-desperate-romantics-2009.plot: In 1850s London, the young rebel painters of the Pre-Raphaelite Brotherhood, Rossetti, Hunt and Millais, chase artistic fame, patronage and muses like Lizzie Siddal, with critic John Ruskin championing them. A playful, racy dramatization of real art history.

rs-eyes-on-the-prize-1987.plot: An acclaimed documentary chronicling the American civil rights movement from the Emmett Till case and Montgomery bus boycott through voting rights struggles and the rise of Black Power, using archival footage and participant interviews.

rs-women-of-the-movement-2022.plot: After her 14-year-old son Emmett Till is murdered while visiting Mississippi in 1955, Mamie Till-Mobley fights for justice and insists the world see what was done to him, helping spark the civil rights movement.
rs-women-of-the-movement-2022.source: Death of Innocence by Mamie Till-Mobley and Christopher Benson

rs-sons-of-liberty-2015.plot: A dramatized account of the American Revolution's beginnings, following Samuel Adams, John Hancock, Paul Revere and Joseph Warren as their resistance to British rule in Boston escalates into open war.

rs-the-american-revolution-2025.plot: Ken Burns chronicles the American War of Independence, exploring the political ideas, battles and ordinary people (colonists, soldiers, Native Americans and enslaved people) caught up in the founding of the United States.

rs-the-wild-wild-west-1965.plot: Secret Service agents James West and master of disguise Artemus Gordon travel the frontier in a gadget-filled private train on orders from President Grant, battling mad scientists and conspirators in a mix of Western and spy adventure.

rs-when-things-were-rotten-1975.plot: Mel Brooks's slapstick spoof of the Robin Hood legend follows Robin and his bumbling Merry Men in Sherwood Forest as they battle the Sheriff of Nottingham and Prince John with puns, anachronisms and sight gags.

rs-broad-city-2014.plot: Two broke best friends in their twenties stumble through New York City's absurd everyday adventures. They support each other through dead-end jobs, dating and get-rich schemes.

rs-high-maintenance-2016.plot: An unnamed bicycle-riding marijuana dealer, known as The Guy, delivers weed across New York City, and each episode follows the varied, often quirky lives of his clients and the people around them.

rs-high-school-musical-the-musical-the-s.plot: Students at East High, the school where High School Musical was filmed, stage theatrical productions of the movie and other musicals while navigating friendships, romance and rivalries in a mockumentary-style musical drama.

rs-american-primeval-2025.plot: In 1857, a mother and her son travelling through the Utah Territory are caught up in a violent clash among Mormon militias, the U.S. Army, Native tribes and frontiersmen, and must rely on a reluctant guide to survive.

rs-david-copperfield-1999.plot: Young David Copperfield survives a cruel stepfather, child labor and poverty in Victorian England, finding allies in his eccentric aunt and the hapless Mr. Micawber as he grows up to become a writer.

rs-private-practice-2007.plot: Neonatal surgeon Addison Montgomery leaves Seattle Grace for Los Angeles to join a wellness practice run by old friends, navigating ethical dilemmas, rivalries and tangled romances.

rs-chicago-med-2015.plot: Doctors and nurses in the emergency department of Chicago's Gaffney Medical Center handle life-or-death cases each week while juggling ethical dilemmas, hospital politics and their personal relationships, crossing paths with the city's firefighters and police.

rs-alice-2009.plot: A modern reimagining of Wonderland: martial-arts instructor Alice follows her kidnapped boyfriend through a looking glass into a decayed, corrupt Wonderland ruled by the Queen of Hearts, who drains human emotions. She allies with the resistance and a roguish Hatter.

rs-jonathan-strange-mr-norrell-2015.plot: In early 19th-century England, where magic has faded into theory, the reclusive Mr Norrell and the brilliant, impulsive Jonathan Strange revive practical magic, aid the war against Napoleon and become bitter rivals.
rs-jonathan-strange-mr-norrell-2015.source: Jonathan Strange & Mr Norrell by Susanna Clarke

rs-have-gun-will-travel-1957.plot: Paladin, a cultured gentleman who enjoys fine wine and literature in a San Francisco hotel, hires out his gun as a professional troubleshooter across the West, often siding with the underdog against those who hired him.

setting.place: San Francisco and the American West

rs-rawhide-1959.plot: Trail boss Gil Favor and his ramrod Rowdy Yates lead a cattle drive along the Sedalia Trail, facing stampedes, outlaws, weather and the troubled strangers they meet on the long road north.

rs-the-rifleman-1958.plot: Widowed homesteader Lucas McCain raises his young son Mark on a ranch near North Fork, New Mexico Territory, defending the town with his rapid-fire modified Winchester rifle while teaching the boy right from wrong.

rs-i-m-dying-up-here-2017.plot: In 1970s Los Angeles, a group of young stand-up comedians hustle for stage time at a famous Sunset Strip comedy club run by a tough matriarch, dreaming of a spot on The Tonight Show.
rs-i-m-dying-up-here-2017.source: Inspired by I'm Dying Up Here by William Knoedelseder (nonfiction book)

rs-better-things-2016.plot: Sam Fox, a working actress and single mother in Los Angeles, raises her three daughters while caring for her eccentric mother next door, finding humor and frustration in the everyday chaos of family life.

rs-masterpiece-theatre-1971.plot: PBS's long-running showcase of mostly British drama, from literary adaptations and period serials like Upstairs, Downstairs and Downton Abbey to modern mysteries, introduced over the years by hosts including Alistair Cooke. Now branded simply as Masterpiece.

rs-hawaii-five-0-2010.plot: Navy SEAL Steve McGarrett returns to Oahu to avenge his father's murder and is asked by the governor to lead an elite task force with broad powers. With partner Danny Williams, Chin Ho Kelly and Kono Kalakaua, he tackles kidnappers, terrorists and murderers.

rs-adam-12-1968.plot: Veteran LAPD officer Pete Malloy and his rookie partner Jim Reed patrol Los Angeles in their squad car, responding to radio calls that range from routine to dangerous over the course of a shift.

rs-benson-1979.plot: Sharp-witted butler Benson DuBois runs the household of a bumbling, good-hearted state governor, rising over the years to state budget director and lieutenant governor before running for governor himself. A spin-off of Soap.

rs-hemingway-2021.plot: A three-part, six-hour documentary on Ernest Hemingway that weighs the brilliance and influence of his writing against the macho myth he built around himself and the alcoholism, violence and depression that shaped his life.

rs-z-the-beginning-of-everything-2015.plot: Spirited Southern belle Zelda Sayre meets aspiring writer F. Scott Fitzgerald in 1918, and their whirlwind romance launches them into Jazz Age celebrity while straining her identity and their marriage.
rs-z-the-beginning-of-everything-2015.source: Z: A Novel of Zelda Fitzgerald by Therese Anne Fowler

setting.place: Montgomery, Alabama and New York City

rs-babylon-berlin-2017.plot: In Weimar-era Berlin, police inspector Gereon Rath, a traumatized war veteran, and aspiring detective Charlotte Ritter investigate crimes that pull them into a city of political extremism, decadence and conspiracy as democracy collapses.
rs-babylon-berlin-2017.source: Gereon Rath novels by Volker Kutscher

rs-misfits-2009.plot: Five young offenders doing community service on a London estate are struck by a strange storm that gives them odd superpowers. Rather than becoming heroes, the foul-mouthed group mostly tries to cover up accidental killings and survive others with powers.

rs-fringe-2008.plot: FBI agent Olivia Dunham teams with institutionalized scientist Walter Bishop and his estranged son Peter to investigate bizarre phenomena tied to rogue science. Their cases gradually reveal a war with a parallel universe and secrets in Walter's own past.

rs-the-umbrella-academy-2019.plot: Seven children with extraordinary powers, adopted by an eccentric billionaire, reunite as dysfunctional adults after his death and must work together to stop a looming apocalypse, which their time-travelling brother has seen coming.
rs-the-umbrella-academy-2019.source: The Umbrella Academy (Gerard Way, Gabriel Bá)

rs-southland-2009.plot: Shot in a gritty, documentary-like style, the series follows LAPD patrol officers and detectives, including rookie Ben Sherman and his veteran training officer John Cooper, through dangerous shifts on the streets of Los Angeles and the personal toll of the job.

rs-murder-one-1995.plot: Defense attorney Ted Hoffman and his Los Angeles firm spend an entire season on a single high-profile murder trial, following every twist from arrest to verdict; the second season tackled several cases.

rs-the-war-2007.plot: Ken Burns and Lynn Novick tell the story of World War II through the experiences of ordinary men and women from four American towns, both on the battlefronts and at home.

rs-turning-point-the-bomb-and-the-cold-w.plot: A documentary history of the nuclear age, from the Manhattan Project and Hiroshima through the Cold War arms race to present-day tensions with Russia, featuring historians, officials and survivors.

rs-the-nazis-a-warning-from-history-1997.plot: Drawing on archive film and interviews with former Nazis, victims and witnesses, this series examines how Hitler's party won power in Germany and carried out war and genocide.

rs-generation-war-2013.plot: Five young friends in Berlin part in 1941 as war sweeps them apart: two brothers go to the Eastern Front as soldiers, one becomes a nurse, one a singer and one, a Jewish tailor, is hunted. Their wartime choices test their friendship and morals.

rs-allo-allo-1982.plot: In a small town in occupied France, café owner René Artois tries to keep his head down while being dragged into the Resistance's schemes, juggling Nazi officers, a hapless Gestapo agent, a stolen painting and his affairs with the waitresses.

rs-dad-s-army-1968.plot: Pompous bank manager Captain Mainwaring commands a platoon of elderly and unfit Home Guard volunteers in the seaside town of Walmington-on-Sea, preparing for a German invasion during World War II.

rs-we-were-the-lucky-ones-2024.plot: When World War II breaks out, a Polish Jewish family is torn apart and scattered across continents, each member struggling to survive the Holocaust while hoping to find one another again.
rs-we-were-the-lucky-ones-2024.source: We Were the Lucky Ones by Georgia Hunter

rs-the-u-s-and-the-holocaust-2022.plot: Ken Burns and his collaborators examine how Americans and their government responded to Nazi persecution and genocide, looking at immigration quotas, antisemitism and public opinion that limited help for Jews trying to flee Europe.

rs-last-man-standing-2011.plot: Mike Baxter, a macho marketing executive for a Denver outdoor-sporting-goods store, lives in a house full of women: his wife and three daughters. He airs his old-fashioned opinions in video blogs while navigating family life and changing times.

rs-coach-1989.plot: Gruff but lovable Hayden Fox coaches the struggling Minnesota State Screaming Eagles college football team alongside his dim assistants, while juggling his relationship with a TV anchorwoman and his estranged daughter.

rs-home-fires-2015.plot: In a rural Cheshire village at the start of the Second World War, the women of the local Women's Institute pull together to support the war effort while coping with absent husbands, rationing and private struggles.

rs-american-dreams-2002.plot: A Catholic family in 1960s Philadelphia navigates social upheaval as teenage daughter Meg lands a spot dancing on American Bandstand, while the Vietnam War, civil rights and changing values reshape their lives.

rs-land-girls-2009.plot: During World War II, young women of the Women's Land Army are sent to work the fields of the Hoxley estate in rural England, facing hard labor, romance, class tensions and the war's losses far from the front line.

rs-prisoners-of-war-2010.plot: Three Israeli soldiers held captive in Lebanon for seventeen years are released, but only two return alive. As they struggle to reconnect with families who moved on without them, military psychologists suspect they are hiding what really happened in captivity.

rs-fauda-2015.plot: Doron, a veteran of an Israeli undercover counterterrorism unit, is pulled back into service to hunt dangerous militants, and each mission brings personal costs for his team and the people on the other side of the conflict.

rs-tehran-2020.plot: A Mossad hacker-agent born in Iran goes undercover in Tehran to help disable the country's air defenses. When the mission goes wrong she is stranded, hunted by a relentless Revolutionary Guard investigator and drawn into the city's underground resistance.

rs-sharpe-1993.plot: Richard Sharpe, a rough soldier raised from the ranks, leads his loyal riflemen through the Napoleonic Wars in Portugal, Spain and France, battling the French as well as snobbish officers on his own side.

rs-the-terror-2018.plot: A horror anthology rooted in history and folklore: the first season follows the Royal Navy's doomed Franklin expedition trapped in Arctic ice and stalked by something monstrous; later seasons move to WWII internment camps and a modern psychiatric hospital.

rs-black-sails-2014.plot: Two decades before Treasure Island, the ruthless Captain Flint and his crew operate out of the pirate haven of Nassau. Flint chases a fortune in Spanish gold while the pirates' world comes under threat from colonial powers.
rs-black-sails-2014.source: Treasure Island by Robert Louis Stevenson (prequel)

rs-the-last-kingdom-2015.plot: Uhtred, born a Saxon nobleman but raised by Danes after Vikings kill his family, is torn between both peoples as he fights for Alfred the Great to defend Wessex and reclaim his ancestral home of Bebbanburg.
rs-the-last-kingdom-2015.source: The Saxon Stories by Bernard Cornwell

rs-vikings-2013.plot: Viking farmer and warrior Ragnar Lothbrok leads raids west to England and rises to become king. Later seasons follow his sons as they carry his legacy across Europe and beyond.

rs-the-witcher-2019.plot: Geralt of Rivia, a mutated monster hunter, struggles to find his place in a world where people often prove more wicked than beasts, as his destiny becomes bound to the sorceress Yennefer and the hunted princess Ciri.

rs-new-girl-2011.plot: After a bad breakup, quirky teacher Jess Day moves into a Los Angeles loft with three single men, bartender Nick, self-styled ladies' man Schmidt and ex-athlete Winston, and the roommates become a found family through dating mishaps and the drinking game True American.

rs-happy-endings-2011.plot: When Alex leaves Dave at the altar, their tight-knit group of six Chicago friends tries to stay together despite the awkwardness, trading rapid-fire jokes and pop-culture riffs through dating disasters and everyday nonsense.

rs-how-i-met-your-father-2022.plot: In 2050, Sophie tells her son how she met his father, flashing back to 2022 New York, where she and her close-knit group of friends navigate dating apps, careers and relationships in search of love.

rs-captive-audience-a-real-american-horr.plot: A docuseries on the 1972 kidnapping of seven-year-old Steven Stayner, held for seven years before escaping, and how his ordeal and its retelling as a TV movie rippled through his family for decades.

rs-laverne-shirley-1976.plot: Best friends and roommates Laverne DeFazio and Shirley Feeney work as bottle cappers at a Milwaukee brewery in the late 1950s, chasing romance and better lives with neighbors Lenny and Squiggy, before later moving to California. A spin-off of Happy Days.

rs-chewing-gum-2015.plot: Tracey, a sheltered, religious 24-year-old shop assistant on a London council estate, decides she wants to lose her virginity and discover the wider world, stumbling through awkward and outrageous encounters along the way.

rs-rain-dogs-2023.plot: Struggling writer and single mother Costello Jones scrapes by in London with her young daughter, relying on a chaotic chosen family: a wealthy, self-destructive gay friend and a volatile ex-convict, as poverty and bad choices keep testing them.

rs-the-goldbergs-1949.plot: Warm-hearted Molly Goldberg, a Jewish mother in a Bronx apartment building, dispenses advice through the window, meddles lovingly in her neighbors' lives and keeps her family together. Adapted from Gertrude Berg's hugely popular radio serial.

rs-little-house-on-the-prairie-1974.plot: Charles and Caroline Ingalls raise their daughters, including spirited Laura, on a farm near Walnut Grove, Minnesota, facing hardship, illness and community life on the American frontier. Loosely based on Laura Ingalls Wilder's autobiographical novels.

rs-danger-man-1960.plot: John Drake, a principled secret agent who prefers wits to guns and gadgets, takes dangerous assignments around the world, first for NATO and later British intelligence, foiling plots and exposing traitors.

rs-the-persuaders-1971.plot: A retired judge coerces two wealthy playboys, brash self-made American Danny Wilde and suave English aristocrat Lord Brett Sinclair, into teaming up to bring criminals to justice across glamorous European locations.

rs-any-day-now-1998.plot: Two women, one white and one Black, who were childhood friends in 1960s Birmingham, Alabama, reconnect as adults, with flashbacks to the civil rights era interwoven with their present-day lives.

rs-fatal-vision-1984.plot: Army doctor Jeffrey MacDonald claims drug-crazed intruders murdered his pregnant wife and two daughters in 1970, but his father-in-law's growing doubts drive a years-long quest to bring him to trial.

rs-living-single-1993.plot: Six Black friends in their twenties navigate careers, romance and friendship in Brooklyn, centered on magazine publisher Khadijah James and the housemates and neighbors sharing her brownstone.

rs-rap-sh-t-2022.plot: Two estranged former high-school friends in Miami, a disillusioned hotel worker and a hustling single mom, reconnect and form a rap duo, navigating a music industry driven by social media.

rs-run-the-world-2021.plot: Four ambitious Black women and best friends in Harlem support each other through career moves, romances and personal setbacks as they try to take on the world together.

rs-wecrashed-2022.plot: Charismatic entrepreneur Adam Neumann and his wife Rebekah turn a shared-office startup into WeWork, a company valued at billions, before hype, excess and a failed IPO bring the dream crashing down.

rs-bad-vegan-fame-fraud-fugitives-2022.plot: Sarma Melngailis, owner of a celebrated New York vegan restaurant, falls under the control of a man who promises to make her dog immortal, and ends up defrauding investors and staff before going on the run.

rs-columbo-1968.plot: Rumpled, cigar-smoking LAPD homicide lieutenant Columbo, with his shabby raincoat and endless "just one more thing," pursues wealthy, arrogant murderers whose crimes the audience sees at the start, unraveling their perfect alibis.
