rs-mcmillan-wife-1971.plot: San Francisco police commissioner Stewart McMillan and his inquisitive wife Sally keep getting entangled in murders, solving them with banter and help from his sergeant and their wisecracking housekeeper. A rotating feature-length entry of the NBC Mystery Movie.

rs-longstreet-1971.plot: New Orleans insurance investigator Mike Longstreet, blinded by the bomb that killed his wife, keeps working cases with the help of his guide dog, his other heightened senses and martial-arts training from his friend Li Tsung.

rs-the-buccaneers-1995.plot: In the 1870s, four wealthy but socially snubbed American girls cross the Atlantic to London, where they set out to marry into the British aristocracy and discover the costs of titles and tradition.

rs-jesus-of-nazareth-1977.plot: Franco Zeffirelli's reverent epic dramatizes the life of Jesus as told in the Gospels, from the betrothal of Mary and Joseph and the Nativity through his ministry, miracles and teachings to the Crucifixion and Resurrection.

rs-a-d-the-bible-continues-2015.plot: After Jesus' crucifixion and resurrection, his followers spread the new faith in Jerusalem. They face persecution from the Temple authorities and the Roman governor Pontius Pilate.

rs-house-of-david-2025.plot: As King Saul's rule falters, a young shepherd named David is secretly anointed as Israel's next king, rising from obscurity through his battle with Goliath into a dangerous rivalry with the throne.

rs-the-hollow-crown-2012.plot: Feature-length films of Shakespeare's history plays trace English royal power from Richard II through Henry IV and Henry V to the Wars of the Roses and Richard III. Leading British actors star in the cycle.

rs-world-without-end-2012.plot: Set in the fictional English town of Kingsbridge in the 14th century, two centuries after The Pillars of the Earth. Townspeople fight corrupt nobles and church authorities during the Hundred Years' War and the Black Death.
rs-world-without-end-2012.source: World Without End by Ken Follett

rs-isabel-2012.plot: The life of Isabella I of Castile, from a young princess surrounded by court intrigue to queen. It follows her marriage to Ferdinand of Aragon, her struggle for the throne and the shaping of a unified Spain.

rs-wonderfalls-2004.plot: Jaye Tyler, an overeducated slacker working in a Niagara Falls gift shop, finds that animal-shaped figurines start talking to her, nudging her into cryptic deeds that end up helping strangers.

rs-touched-by-an-angel-1994.plot: Angels Monica and Tess, joined by the Angel of Death Andrew, are sent to Earth to help people at crossroads in their lives, delivering messages of hope and God's love.

rs-abraham-1993.plot: Called by God to leave his homeland for Canaan, the patriarch Abraham and his wife Sarah journey through trials of faith, a long wait for a promised son, and the ultimate test of being asked to sacrifice Isaac.

rs-owen-marshall-counselor-at-law-1971.plot: Compassionate Santa Barbara defense attorney Owen Marshall, a widower raising a young daughter, takes on difficult cases with his younger associates, often defending clients the community has already judged.

rs-matlock-1986.plot: Folksy but brilliant Atlanta defense attorney Ben Matlock charges top fees and wins seemingly hopeless murder cases by investigating himself and unmasking the real killer in dramatic courtroom confrontations.

rs-good-times-1974.plot: Florida and James Evans struggle to raise their three children, including wisecracking artist J.J., in a Chicago public housing project, facing poverty and racism with humor and resilience. A spin-off of Maude.

rs-that-girl-1966.plot: Ann Marie leaves her small hometown for New York City to pursue an acting career, taking odd jobs to pay the rent while dating her devoted boyfriend Donald, a magazine writer, under her protective father's eye.

rs-the-joe-schmo-show-2003.plot: An unsuspecting ordinary person believes he is competing on a reality show, but every other contestant and the host are actors performing an elaborate scripted hoax around him.

rs-who-is-america-2018.plot: Sacha Baron Cohen disguises himself as a series of outlandish characters to interview politicians, celebrities and ordinary Americans, exposing prejudices and absurdities across the political spectrum through hidden-camera satire.

rs-documentary-now-2015.plot: Introduced by Helen Mirren as a long-running prestige series, each episode is a meticulous parody of a famous documentary or documentary style, from Grey Gardens to Stop Making Sense, mostly starring Fred Armisen and Bill Hader.

rs-one-day-at-a-time-1975.plot: Newly divorced Ann Romano moves to an Indianapolis apartment with her two teenage daughters, Julie and Barbara, balancing work, romance and parenting while the building's cocky superintendent Schneider constantly drops in.

rs-grace-under-fire-1993.plot: Grace Kelly, a wisecracking divorced mother of three who escaped an abusive marriage, works at an oil refinery in small-town Missouri while raising her kids and keeping her sense of humor.

rs-the-fall-2013.plot: A London detective superintendent is called to Belfast to review a stalled murder inquiry. She hunts a serial killer who lives a seemingly ordinary life as a family man and grief counselor.

rs-alias-2001.plot: Graduate student Sydney Bristow discovers that the secret CIA division she works for is actually a criminal organization, and becomes a double agent alongside her estranged father in a world of spies and ancient prophecies.

rs-hanna-2019.plot: Raised in a remote forest by a former CIA operative, teenage Hanna has been trained as a killer; after she is discovered, she is hunted by agent Marissa Wiegler and the secret program that created her.

rs-genius-mlk-x-2024.plot: The fourth Genius installment traces the parallel lives of Martin Luther King Jr. and Malcolm X, from their upbringings and marriages to their differing visions and leadership in the struggle for Black civil rights.

rs-flipper-1964.plot: Park ranger Porter Ricks and his two sons, Sandy and Bud, live at a Florida Keys marine preserve, where their bottlenose dolphin friend Flipper helps them rescue people and catch wrongdoers.

rs-the-adventures-of-rin-tin-tin-1954.plot: Orphaned boy Rusty and his courageous German Shepherd Rin Tin Tin, survivors of an Indian raid, are adopted by the U.S. Cavalry at Fort Apache, where the dog helps the troopers face outlaws, raiders and frontier dangers.

rs-law-order-special-victims-unit-1999.plot: Detectives of the NYPD's Special Victims Unit, led over the years by Olivia Benson, investigate sexually based crimes and offenses against children and the vulnerable, working with prosecutors to bring cases to trial.

rs-law-order-criminal-intent-2001.plot: Detectives of the NYPD's Major Case Squad, led by eccentric profiler Robert Goren and his partner Alex Eames, delve into the psychology of criminals to solve high-profile crimes, often shown from the killer's side.

rs-the-closer-2005.plot: Deputy Chief Brenda Leigh Johnson, a Southern-born CIA-trained interrogator, heads an LAPD homicide unit that handles high-profile cases, where her talent for extracting confessions clashes with her chaotic personal life.

rs-masters-of-sex-2013.plot: In the late 1950s, gynecologist William Masters and his assistant Virginia Johnson begin a pioneering scientific study of human sexuality. Their research upends social taboos and their own complicated relationship.
rs-masters-of-sex-2013.source: Masters of Sex by Thomas Maier

rs-julia-2022.plot: In 1960s Boston, Julia Child turns her love of French cooking into The French Chef, a pioneering public-television cooking show, supported by her husband Paul and her friends as she defies the skeptics.

rs-call-the-midwife-2012.plot: Nurse-midwives and nuns of Nonnatus House serve the poor families of London's East End from the late 1950s onward. Each episode follows births and medical crises alongside the changing lives of the staff and the community.
rs-call-the-midwife-2012.source: Call the Midwife (memoirs by Jennifer Worth)

rs-the-last-movie-stars-2022.plot: Ethan Hawke traces the 50-year marriage and careers of Paul Newman and Joanne Woodward, drawing on transcripts of abandoned memoir interviews read aloud by contemporary actors alongside archival footage.

rs-manhunt-2024.plot: After Abraham Lincoln is assassinated, Secretary of War Edwin Stanton leads the 12-day hunt for John Wilkes Booth while fighting to protect Lincoln's plans for Reconstruction from the conspirators and their allies.
rs-manhunt-2024.source: Manhunt: The 12-Day Chase for Lincoln's Killer by James L. Swanson

rs-the-blue-and-the-gray-1982.plot: A Virginia-born newspaper artist sketches the American Civil War from the front lines, his loyalties torn between his Southern family and the Northern family he marries into, as the conflict divides the two households.

rs-maid-2021.plot: After fleeing an emotionally abusive relationship with her young daughter, Alex takes work cleaning houses in Washington state, battling bureaucracy, poverty and her erratic mother as she fights to build a safe life.
rs-maid-2021.source: Maid: Hard Work, Low Pay, and a Mother's Will to Survive (Stephanie Land)

rs-indian-summers-2015.plot: In the hill station of Simla in the early 1930s, British officials and Indian locals spend the summer together as the Raj begins to crack, with romance, scandal and political unrest spreading among the colonial elite and those they rule.

rs-freedom-at-midnight-2024.plot: A political drama about the final years of British rule in India, following Nehru, Gandhi, Patel, Jinnah and Lord Mountbatten as negotiations over independence lead to the Partition and its violent aftermath.
rs-freedom-at-midnight-2024.source: Freedom at Midnight by Larry Collins and Dominique Lapierre

rs-the-leftovers-2014.plot: Three years after 2% of the world's population vanished without explanation, a small-town police chief and his family struggle to carry on. Grief, cults and faith reshape the lives of those left behind.

setting.place: New York and Texas, USA; Australia

rs-from-2022.plot: Travelers who take a detour find themselves trapped in a mysterious small town that no one can leave, where nightfall brings humanlike creatures that hunt the residents, who struggle to survive and uncover the place's secrets.

rs-the-hour-2011.plot: In 1956 London, the BBC launches a current-affairs program led by ambitious producer Bel Rowley, fiery journalist Freddie Lyon and polished anchor Hector Madden. Against the Suez Crisis and Cold War paranoia, Freddie uncovers a murder conspiracy.

rs-state-of-play-2003.plot: When a young political researcher dies and a teenage thief is shot, a London newspaper team led by journalist Cal McCaffrey uncovers links to a rising MP and the oil industry.

rs-press-2018.plot: Journalists at two rival London newspapers, a struggling liberal broadsheet and a ruthless best-selling tabloid, chase stories and clash over ethics, truth and survival in a changing media landscape.

rs-modern-love-2019.plot: Each episode adapts a personal essay from The New York Times column Modern Love, exploring romantic, familial and platonic love among different people in New York and beyond.
rs-modern-love-2019.source: Modern Love (The New York Times column)

rs-the-love-boat-1977.plot: Aboard the cruise ship Pacific Princess, Captain Stubing and his crew watch over passengers, usually played by guest stars, whose intertwining comic and romantic stories unfold over each voyage.

rs-happy-days-1974.plot: Teenager Richie Cunningham, his family and friends grow up in 1950s and early-1960s Milwaukee, hanging out at Arnold's drive-in, while leather-jacketed cool guy Fonzie becomes their friend, protector and the show's breakout star.

rs-the-tony-randall-show-1976.plot: Widowed Philadelphia judge Walter Franklin juggles demanding courtroom cases with raising two children, managing his British housekeeper and his hopeful dating life, often with fussy, opinionated flair.

rs-brothers-1984.plot: Three Philadelphia brothers navigate family life after the youngest comes out as gay just before his wedding, with his macho ex-football-player brother and more easygoing sibling learning to accept him, alongside his flamboyant best friend.

rs-ellen-1994.plot: Neurotic Los Angeles bookstore owner Ellen Morgan muddles through life with her quirky friends; in its later seasons the show broke ground when Ellen came out as gay.

rs-them-2021.plot: A horror anthology about American racism. The first season follows a Black family who moves to an all-white Los Angeles neighborhood in 1953 and is besieged by hostile neighbors and malevolent forces; the second follows an LAPD detective in 1991.

rs-cracker-1993.plot: Brilliant but self-destructive criminal psychologist Eddie 'Fitz' Fitzgerald, a gambler and heavy drinker, helps Manchester police get inside the minds of killers while his own family life unravels.

rs-hannibal-2013.plot: An FBI criminal profiler with a gift for empathizing with killers is assigned a brilliant psychiatrist to keep him stable. The psychiatrist is secretly the cannibal serial killer Hannibal Lecter, and a dark bond grows between them.
rs-hannibal-2013.source: Red Dragon and Hannibal novels by Thomas Harris

rs-catch-22-2019.plot: In World War II Italy, U.S. Army Air Forces bombardier John Yossarian is desperate to stop flying missions, but the absurd military rule called Catch-22 and a bureaucracy that keeps raising the quota trap him in deadly service.

rs-dharma-greg-1997.plot: Free-spirited yoga teacher Dharma and buttoned-up lawyer Greg marry on their first date, and their opposite personalities and clashing families make for a chaotic but loving marriage.

rs-catastrophe-2015.plot: An American businessman and an Irish teacher in London have a week-long fling that results in a pregnancy, so they decide to try making a real relationship work, navigating marriage, children and family with brutal honesty.

rs-love-2016.plot: Mickey, a self-destructive radio station manager, and Gus, a nerdy on-set tutor, meet by chance in Los Angeles and stumble into an awkward, honest and frequently messy relationship.

rs-simon-simon-1981.plot: Mismatched brothers, laid-back Vietnam veteran Rick and straight-laced college graduate A.J., run a struggling private detective agency in San Diego, taking on cases while bickering and competing with a rival firm.

rs-psych-2006.plot: Shawn Spencer, a slacker with extraordinary powers of observation honed by his cop father, poses as a psychic to consult for the Santa Barbara police, dragging his best friend Gus along on cases.

rs-burn-notice-2007.plot: Blacklisted spy Michael Westen, stranded in Miami with no money or credentials, takes freelance jobs helping people in trouble with his ex-girlfriend and a retired Navy SEAL while hunting whoever burned him.

rs-raising-hope-2010.plot: Aimless 23-year-old pool cleaner Jimmy Chance becomes a single father after a one-night stand with a woman who turns out to be a serial killer. He raises baby Hope with help from his young, unprepared parents and senile great-grandmother.

rs-77-sunset-strip-1958.plot: Two suave former government agents run a Hollywood private detective agency at 77 Sunset Strip, solving glamorous cases with help from Kookie, the hip, hair-combing parking attendant at the restaurant next door.

rs-around-the-world-in-80-days-2021.plot: In 1872, Victorian gentleman Phileas Fogg accepts a wager to circle the globe in 80 days, setting off with his resourceful valet Passepartout and ambitious journalist Abigail Fix on a race full of danger and detours.
rs-around-the-world-in-80-days-2021.source: Around the World in Eighty Days (Jules Verne)

rs-doc-martin-2004.plot: A brilliant but brusque London surgeon who develops a fear of blood becomes the GP of a quaint Cornish fishing village, where his lack of bedside manner clashes with the eccentric locals and complicates his romance with the schoolteacher.

rs-the-killing-2011.plot: In rain-soaked Seattle, homicide detective Sarah Linden, on her last day before moving away, and her new partner Stephen Holder investigate the murder of teenager Rosie Larsen, a case that devastates her family and touches a mayoral campaign.

rs-task-2025.plot: In the working-class suburbs of Philadelphia, a grieving FBI agent leads a task force investigating violent home invasions of biker-gang drug houses, carried out by an unassuming garbage collector with his own reasons.

rs-shrill-2019.plot: Annie, a young Portland journalist, decides to stop apologizing for her body and starts asserting herself in her career, relationships and life, despite a dismissive boss and an unreliable boyfriend.
rs-shrill-2019.source: Shrill: Notes from a Loud Woman (Lindy West)

rs-oliver-twist-2007.plot: Orphan Oliver escapes the workhouse and falls in with Fagin's gang of child pickpockets in Victorian London, caught between the brutal Bill Sikes and the secrets of his own parentage.

rs-a-d-1985.plot: After the crucifixion, the apostles spread Christianity across the Roman Empire while emperors Tiberius, Caligula, Claudius and Nero rule through intrigue and cruelty, culminating in persecution of believers in Rome.

rs-spartacus-2010.plot: A Thracian warrior betrayed by Rome is enslaved and forced to fight as a gladiator in Capua. Stylized, blood-soaked and steamy, the saga follows his rise in the arena, his escape and the slave rebellion he leads against the Republic.

rs-ramy-2019.plot: Ramy Hassan, a first-generation Egyptian-American in New Jersey, tries to balance his Muslim faith with the temptations and expectations of millennial life, while his family pursues their own complicated paths.

rs-alias-smith-and-jones-1971.plot: Charming outlaws Hannibal Heyes and Kid Curry are offered a secret amnesty if they can stay out of trouble for a year, but under the aliases Smith and Jones they keep running into bounty hunters, old gang members and crooked schemes across the Old West.

rs-longmire-2012.plot: A widowed Wyoming sheriff investigates murders and crimes across his rural county and a neighboring Cheyenne reservation. Aided by his deputies and his oldest friend, he also confronts his own grief and local politics.
rs-longmire-2012.source: Walt Longmire Mysteries by Craig Johnson

rs-gomer-pyle-u-s-m-c-1964.plot: Naive, good-natured gas-station attendant Gomer Pyle leaves Mayberry to join the Marines, where his innocence and cheerful mishaps exasperate his hot-tempered drill instructor, Sergeant Vince Carter.

rs-emergency-1972.plot: Paramedics Johnny Gage and Roy DeSoto of Los Angeles County Fire Department Station 51 respond to fires, accidents and medical crises, working with the doctors and nurses of Rampart General Hospital. It helped popularize the paramedic profession nationwide.

rs-cursed-2020.plot: A reimagining of Arthurian legend in which Nimue, a young Fey woman with mysterious powers, is tasked with delivering an ancient sword to Merlin and becomes a rebel leader against the Church's Red Paladins, alongside the mercenary Arthur.

rs-camelot-2011.plot: After King Uther's death, the sorcerer Merlin installs the young, untested Arthur as king, while Arthur's ruthless half-sister Morgan plots to take the throne with dark magic. A grittier, sensual retelling of the Arthurian legend.

rs-21-jump-street-1987.plot: Young-looking police officers go undercover in high schools and colleges to investigate youth crime, tackling drugs, abuse, racism and other social issues while the rookies wrestle with blurred identities.

rs-lady-in-the-lake-2024.plot: In 1960s Baltimore, a housewife leaves her marriage to become a journalist and becomes fixated on the unsolved death of a Black woman found in a park fountain, whose own story runs parallel to hers.
rs-lady-in-the-lake-2024.source: Lady in the Lake by Laura Lippman

rs-i-know-this-much-is-true-2020.plot: Dominick Birdsey struggles to care for his identical twin brother Thomas, who has paranoid schizophrenia, while uncovering the painful history of their family across generations in a Connecticut town.
rs-i-know-this-much-is-true-2020.source: I Know This Much Is True (Wally Lamb)

rs-leverage-2008.plot: A former insurance investigator leads a crew of thieves, a hacker, a grifter and a hitter who use elaborate cons to take down the rich and powerful on behalf of ordinary people they have wronged. Each episode is a modern Robin Hood caper.

rs-the-many-loves-of-dobie-gillis-1959.plot: Lovesick teenager Dobie Gillis chases unattainable girls while dodging his grocer father's demands, aided by his beatnik best friend Maynard G. Krebs and pursued by brainy Zelda, who's sure they'll marry.

rs-head-of-the-class-1986.plot: Laid-back substitute Charlie Moore takes over a Manhattan high school's honors class of gifted but socially awkward students, teaching them about life beyond test scores while clashing with their grade-obsessed principal.

rs-boy-meets-world-1993.plot: Philadelphia-area kid Cory Matthews grows from sixth grade through college under the guidance of his family and his teacher-neighbor Mr. Feeny, alongside best friend Shawn and his longtime love Topanga.

rs-the-north-water-2021.plot: In 1859 a disgraced former army surgeon signs on as ship's doctor aboard a Yorkshire whaling vessel bound for the Arctic, where he crosses paths with a brutal, amoral harpooner and the voyage turns into a fight for survival.

rs-fresh-off-the-boat-2015.plot: In the mid-1990s, a Taiwanese-American family moves from Washington, D.C.'s Chinatown to suburban Orlando so the father can open a steakhouse, as hip-hop-loving eldest son Eddie and his strict mother adjust to life in a very different community.
rs-fresh-off-the-boat-2015.source: Fresh Off the Boat: A Memoir by Eddie Huang

rs-remington-steele-1982.plot: Private investigator Laura Holt invents a fictional male boss to win clients, until a charming con man with a mysterious past assumes the identity of Remington Steele, and the two solve cases while sparring romantically.

rs-hart-to-hart-1979.plot: Self-made millionaire Jonathan Hart and his journalist wife Jennifer, a glamorous and devoted Bel Air couple, solve murders and thwart crooks as amateur sleuths, aided by their gravel-voiced butler Max.

rs-castle-2009.plot: Bestselling mystery novelist Richard Castle, bored with his own books, talks his way into shadowing NYPD homicide detective Kate Beckett for inspiration. Their banter-filled partnership solves murders weekly while a slow-burn romance and the mystery of her mother's death develop.

rs-my-favorite-martian-1963.plot: Newspaper reporter Tim O'Hara finds a Martian anthropologist stranded after his ship crashes near Los Angeles, and passes him off as his "Uncle Martin" while hiding his telepathy, invisibility and other powers.

rs-the-ten-commandments-2006.plot: Moses, raised as an Egyptian prince, learns of his Hebrew origins, flees, and returns at God's command to lead the Israelites out of slavery and across the desert toward the Promised Land.

rs-swarm-2023.plot: Dre, a lonely young woman obsessed with a pop superstar, spirals after a personal tragedy and sets off across the country, violently targeting anyone who disrespects her idol.

rs-boston-public-2000.plot: Principal Steven Harper and his dedicated, flawed teachers at a struggling Boston high school confront violence, scandals and student crises while trying to make a difference.

rs-good-girls-revolt-2015.plot: At a New York news magazine in 1969, the women employed as researchers do much of the reporting but get none of the bylines, and a group of them begin organizing to challenge the publication's sexist policies.
rs-good-girls-revolt-2015.source: The Good Girls Revolt by Lynn Povich

rs-miss-marple-1984.plot: Agatha Christie's shrewd elderly spinster Jane Marple uses her knowledge of village human nature to solve murders that baffle the police, in faithful period adaptations of the novels starring Joan Hickson.
rs-miss-marple-1984.source: Miss Marple novels by Agatha Christie

rs-midsomer-murders-1997.plot: Detective Chief Inspector Tom Barnaby, and later his cousin John Barnaby, investigate an improbable number of murders among the picturesque villages of the English county of Midsomer.
rs-midsomer-murders-1997.source: Chief Inspector Barnaby novels by Caroline Graham

rs-diagnosis-murder-1993.plot: Dr. Mark Sloan, a cheerful chief of internal medicine at a Los Angeles hospital, moonlights as an amateur sleuth, helping his police detective son crack murders with the aid of his young colleagues.

rs-dream-on-1990.plot: Recently divorced Manhattan book editor Martin Tupper, raised on television, navigates dating, work and co-parenting, with his inner thoughts expressed through clips from old black-and-white movies and TV shows.

rs-herman-s-head-1991.plot: Aspiring writer Herman Brooks works as a fact-checker at a Manhattan magazine while four personified parts of his psyche, representing intellect, lust, anxiety and sensitivity, argue inside his head over every decision.

rs-great-performances-1972.plot: PBS's long-running performing-arts showcase presents opera, classical concerts, ballet, Broadway musicals, stage plays and popular-music specials, bringing major performances from leading venues and companies to a broad television audience.

rs-american-playhouse-1982.plot: PBS's anthology of American drama presented original teleplays, stage adaptations and independent films by American writers and filmmakers, helping launch acclaimed works such as Stand and Deliver and The Thin Blue Line.

rs-brooklyn-south-1997.plot: The uniformed officers of a Brooklyn police precinct face violence on the streets, internal investigations and personal crises in a gritty ensemble drama.

rs-dragnet-1951.plot: Terse, by-the-book Sergeant Joe Friday and his partner work cases for the Los Angeles Police Department, methodically following leads to an arrest. Dramatized from real LAPD files, with "only the names changed to protect the innocent."

rs-versailles-2015.plot: Young King Louis XIV moves his court to his father's hunting lodge at Versailles and turns it into a lavish palace, using it to control a scheming nobility amid plots, affairs and wars.

rs-gilmore-girls-2000.plot: Fast-talking single mom Lorelai Gilmore and her bookish daughter Rory share a best-friend bond in the quirky town of Stars Hollow, while Lorelai's wealthy parents pull them back into their world.

rs-starstruck-2021.plot: Jessie, a New Zealander in London juggling two dead-end jobs, has a New Year's Eve one-night stand with a man who turns out to be a famous film star, sparking an on-off romance across the gulf between their worlds.

rs-everwood-2002.plot: After his wife's death, a renowned Manhattan neurosurgeon moves his two children to a small Colorado mountain town and opens a free practice, clashing with the local doctor and struggling to reconnect with his son.

rs-inside-the-third-reich-1982.plot: Young architect Albert Speer joins Hitler's inner circle, rising to become the Nazi regime's armaments minister, and later confronts his complicity in its crimes. A two-part dramatization of Speer's memoir.

rs-world-on-fire-2019.plot: An epic drama following ordinary people in Britain, Poland, France and Germany whose lives are upended by the first years of World War II, from the invasion of Poland and Dunkirk to the Blitz and North Africa.

rs-getting-on-2013.plot: Overworked nurses and a self-absorbed doctor run an underfunded extended-care ward for elderly women in a California hospital. The dark comedy finds absurdity and humanity in bureaucracy, aging and dying.

rs-shameless-2011.plot: In Chicago's South Side, the six Gallagher children fend for themselves while their alcoholic father Frank schemes and their mother is absent. Eldest daughter Fiona holds the chaotic, resourceful family together through poverty, crime and dark comedy.

rs-this-is-going-to-hurt-2022.plot: Junior doctor Adam works punishing hours on an overstretched NHS obstetrics ward, using dark humour to cope as exhaustion, mistakes and the strain on his relationship and his colleagues pile up.
rs-this-is-going-to-hurt-2022.source: This Is Going to Hurt (memoir) by Adam Kay

rs-star-wars-the-clone-wars-2008.plot: Set between Attack of the Clones and Revenge of the Sith, the animated series follows Anakin Skywalker, his Padawan Ahsoka Tano, Obi-Wan Kenobi and clone troopers fighting the Separatists. Story arcs explore the war's toll and the Republic's slide toward darkness.

rs-star-wars-rebels-2014.plot: Five years before A New Hope, a street-smart orphan joins a small rebel crew aboard the starship Ghost. They fight the Galactic Empire, and he trains as a Jedi under a survivor of the purge.

setting.place: Lothal and a galaxy far, far away

rs-ahsoka-2023.plot: After the fall of the Empire, former Jedi Ahsoka Tano investigates signs that the exiled Grand Admiral Thrawn is preparing to return, reuniting with old Rebel allies and her estranged former apprentice Sabine Wren.

setting.period: Star Wars era after Return of the Jedi

rs-the-looming-tower-2018.plot: The FBI and CIA's bitter rivalry and failure to share intelligence in the late 1990s allow al-Qaeda's growing threat to go unchecked on the path toward the September 11 attacks.
rs-the-looming-tower-2018.source: The Looming Tower by Lawrence Wright (nonfiction book)

setting.place: New York, Washington D.C. and East Africa

rs-the-afterparty-2022.plot: A comic murder mystery in which each episode retells the same deadly night from a different suspect's point of view, each in its own film genre, as a detective pieces together who did it. The second season moves the whodunit to a wedding.

rs-the-heavy-water-war-2015.plot: During World War II, Allied commandos and Norwegian saboteurs race to destroy the Vemork plant's heavy water production, vital to Nazi Germany's atomic research, while scientists on both sides weigh the moral cost.

rs-edge-of-darkness-1985.plot: After his activist daughter is shot dead, Yorkshire detective Ronald Craven investigates and is drawn into a conspiracy involving a nuclear facility, the British state, a CIA agent and environmental secrets, while haunted by her presence.

rs-wentworth-2013.plot: A woman held on remand for the attempted murder of her husband enters Wentworth women's prison. She must survive brutal inmate power struggles and corrupt staff, and gradually rises to become the prison's top dog.

rs-december-bride-1954.plot: Lively widow Lily Ruskin lives with her daughter and son-in-law, who along with nosy neighbor Pete keep trying to find her a new husband, while Lily enjoys her independence and her friend Hilda's company.

rs-wild-wild-country-2018.plot: A documentary about the Indian guru Bhagwan Shree Rajneesh and his followers, who built a utopian city in rural Oregon in the early 1980s, sparking a bitter conflict with locals that escalated into crimes and a national scandal.

rs-queen-of-the-south-2016.plot: After her drug-runner boyfriend is murdered, Teresa Mendoza flees Mexico and becomes involved with the very cartel she ran from, gradually rising to build her own drug empire in the United States.

rs-your-honor-2020.plot: When a respected New Orleans judge's teenage son kills the son of a ruthless crime boss in a hit-and-run, the judge abandons his principles to cover it up, setting off a spiral of lies, corruption and violence.

rs-houdini-2014.plot: A two-part biopic of escape artist Harry Houdini, from his poor immigrant youth to worldwide fame. It covers his marriage, rumored spy work and late crusade against fraudulent spiritualists.
rs-houdini-2014.source: Houdini: A Mind in Chains by Bernard C. Meyer

rs-carnivale-2003.plot: In the Depression-era Dust Bowl, a young drifter with healing powers joins a traveling carnival, while a charismatic preacher discovers darker gifts, setting both on a collision course in an ancient battle between good and evil.

rs-big-mouth-2017.plot: A group of suburban New York middle schoolers navigate the chaos of puberty, egged on and tormented by hormone monsters and other embodiments of their changing bodies and emotions. Crude, frank and surprisingly tender.

rs-never-have-i-ever-2020.plot: Devi Vishwakumar, a hot-tempered Indian-American teenager in Sherman Oaks, tries to become popular and find a boyfriend while coping with the sudden death of her father, narrated by tennis star John McEnroe.

rs-the-great-2020.plot: An 'occasionally true' satirical retelling of the rise of Catherine the Great: an idealistic young bride arrives at the Russian court, finds her husband Emperor Peter a boorish tyrant, and plots to seize the throne herself.

rs-welcome-to-chippendales-2022.plot: Indian immigrant Somen 'Steve' Banerjee builds the Chippendales male-revue empire in Los Angeles, but his jealousy and paranoia toward his creative partner drive him toward violence and murder.
rs-welcome-to-chippendales-2022.source: Deadly Dance by K. Scot Macdonald and Patrick MontesDeOca

rs-the-deuce-2017.plot: In 1970s and 1980s Times Square, twin brothers, a sex worker turned filmmaker and assorted pimps, cops and mobsters ride the rise of the legalized pornography industry, through the AIDS crisis and the area's redevelopment.

rs-designated-survivor-2016.plot: Low-level cabinet member Tom Kirkman is suddenly sworn in as President of the United States after an attack on the Capitol kills everyone above him in the line of succession, and he must lead the nation while uncovering who was behind it.

rs-the-lincoln-lawyer-2022.plot: Los Angeles defense attorney Mickey Haller runs his practice from the back of a Lincoln, taking on high-profile cases each season while juggling his ex-wives, a recovering addiction and the risky clients who keep pulling him into danger.
rs-the-lincoln-lawyer-2022.source: Mickey Haller novels by Michael Connelly

rs-ellery-queen-1975.plot: In late-1940s New York, absent-minded mystery novelist Ellery Queen helps his father, an NYPD inspector, solve baffling murders, and before each reveal turns to the camera to challenge viewers to name the killer.

rs-see-it-now-1951.plot: Edward R. Murrow and producer Fred Friendly bring in-depth reporting and documentary journalism to television, most famously challenging Senator Joseph McCarthy's anti-communist crusade in 1954.

rs-60-minutes-1968.plot: CBS's flagship newsmagazine presents investigative reports, in-depth interviews and profiles, with correspondents pursuing powerful people and hidden stories, closed by the famous ticking stopwatch.

rs-inside-the-actors-studio-1994.plot: Host James Lipton conducts long, in-depth interviews with prominent actors, directors and writers before an audience of drama students, exploring their craft and careers and closing with his famous questionnaire.

rs-richard-diamond-private-detective-195.plot: Ex-cop Richard Diamond works as a suave private investigator, first in New York and later Los Angeles, taking on murders and swindles with the help of an unseen answering-service operator named Sam.

rs-mr-lucky-1959.plot: Charming professional gambler Mr. Lucky runs a floating casino aboard his yacht off the California coast with his friend Andamo, and keeps getting drawn into crime and intrigue; jazzy theme by Henry Mancini.

rs-spector-2022.plot: A docuseries on record producer Phil Spector, creator of the 'Wall of Sound', weighing his musical genius against his volatile behavior and the 2003 killing of actress Lana Clarkson, for which he was convicted.

rs-armchair-theatre-1956.plot: Britain's influential Sunday-night drama anthology, presenting a new single play each week; under Sydney Newman it championed gritty contemporary "kitchen sink" stories by new writers such as Harold Pinter and Alun Owen.

rs-the-prisoner-1967.plot: After abruptly resigning, a British secret agent is abducted to the Village, an idyllic but inescapable seaside community where he is called Number Six and his captors try to extract why he quit, while he resists and plots escape.

rs-madam-secretary-2014.plot: A former CIA analyst turned university professor is unexpectedly appointed U.S. Secretary of State. She handles international crises and Washington politics while trying to keep her family life intact.

rs-scandal-2012.plot: Olivia Pope, a former White House communications director, runs a Washington crisis-management firm that fixes the powerful's scandals. Her own secret affair with the President drags her team into conspiracies at the top of government.

rs-borgen-2010.plot: Centrist politician Birgitte Nyborg unexpectedly becomes Denmark's first female prime minister and must hold together fragile coalitions, while her marriage and family strain. Journalist Katrine Fønsmark and spin doctor Kasper Juul navigate the media side of power.

rs-unforgotten-2015.plot: London detectives reopen cold cases when human remains are discovered years after a crime, and each series follows how the investigation reaches into the lives of several suspects with long-buried secrets.

rs-my-little-margie-1952.plot: Lively, scheming Margie Albright lives in a Manhattan apartment with her widowed father, an investment-firm executive, and constantly cooks up harebrained plans to manage his love life and business that inevitably backfire.

rs-max-liebman-presents-1954.plot: A series of lavish live color "spectaculars" produced by Max Liebman, rotating original musical comedies and abridged adaptations of Broadway operettas and musicals with major stars.

rs-sliders-1995.plot: A physics student's experiment opens a vortex to parallel Earths, and he, his friends and his professor are stranded, sliding from one alternate reality to the next in search of home.

rs-doctor-who-1963.plot: The Doctor, a mysterious alien Time Lord, travels through time and space in the TARDIS, a ship disguised as a police box, battling Daleks and other menaces with human companions and periodically regenerating into a new form.

rs-journeyman-2007.plot: San Francisco newspaper reporter Dan Vasser begins involuntarily jumping back in time, where he must change the lives of particular strangers, straining his marriage and reuniting him with a lost love.

rs-crossing-jordan-2001.plot: Brilliant, headstrong Boston medical examiner Jordan Cavanaugh refuses to stay in the morgue, pushing her investigations into the field to solve murders, often clashing with her bosses and police.

rs-the-spy-2019.plot: The true story of Eli Cohen, an Israeli Mossad agent who went undercover in Syria in the 1960s, posing as a wealthy businessman and rising high in Damascus society while his double life strained his family back home.

rs-rutherford-falls-2021.plot: In a small New York town, a man obsessed with his family's colonial legacy clashes with his best friend, a Native American woman running a tribal cultural center, when a statue of his ancestor becomes a flashpoint.

rs-dark-winds-2022.plot: In the 1970s Navajo Nation, tribal police lieutenant Joe Leaphorn and his new deputy Jim Chee investigate crimes that pit them against outsiders, the FBI and their own pasts.

rs-phyllis-1975.plot: After her husband's death, self-absorbed Phyllis Lindstrom moves with her teenage daughter Bess to San Francisco, living with her late husband's family and working at a photography studio. A spin-off of The Mary Tyler Moore Show.

rs-the-serpent-2021.plot: In the 1970s, conman and serial killer Charles Sobhraj drugs, robs and murders young travelers on Asia's hippie trail, while a junior Dutch diplomat in Bangkok becomes obsessed with exposing him.

rs-kennedy-1983.plot: A dramatization of John F. Kennedy's presidency from his 1960 election to his assassination in Dallas, covering the Bay of Pigs, the Cuban Missile Crisis, civil rights and the pressures on his family and marriage.

rs-bobby-kennedy-for-president-2018.plot: Archival footage and interviews trace Robert F. Kennedy's evolution from his brother's hard-nosed attorney general to a champion of civil rights and the poor, culminating in his 1968 presidential campaign and assassination.

rs-the-book-of-negroes-2015.plot: Aminata Diallo is kidnapped from her West African village as a child and sold into slavery in South Carolina, beginning a decades-long fight for freedom that takes her through the American Revolution to Nova Scotia, Sierra Leone and London.
rs-the-book-of-negroes-2015.source: The Book of Negroes by Lawrence Hill

setting.place: West Africa, South Carolina, New York, Nova Scotia, London

rs-silk-2011.plot: Ambitious London barrister Martha Costello competes with charming rival Clive Reader to 'take silk' and become Queen's Counsel, while defending difficult criminal clients and navigating the politics and compromises of their chambers.

rs-garrow-s-law-2009.plot: In 1780s London, young barrister William Garrow fights for defendants at the Old Bailey, pioneering adversarial cross-examination at a time when the accused had little defense. His crusades win enemies, and his love for a married woman courts scandal.

rs-judge-john-deed-2001.plot: Maverick High Court judge Sir John Deed bends the rules to see justice done, defying government interference and establishment pressure while carrying on a complicated love life.

rs-then-came-bronson-1969.plot: Disillusioned after a friend's suicide, newspaperman Jim Bronson quits his job and rides his Harley-Davidson across America in search of meaning, getting drawn into the lives and troubles of the people he meets along the road.

rs-maniac-2018.plot: Two troubled strangers join a mind-bending pharmaceutical trial promising to fix all their problems, and find themselves sharing a series of surreal fantasy worlds as the experiment goes wrong.

rs-undone-2019.plot: After a car accident, Alma discovers she can bend time and communicate with her dead father, who asks her to help uncover the truth about his death, blurring the line between reality and possible mental illness.

rs-the-innocent-man-2018.plot: Two 1980s murders in the small town of Ada, Oklahoma, led to convictions that raised serious questions about police tactics, false confessions and justice, as explored by John Grisham and others.
rs-the-innocent-man-2018.source: The Innocent Man by John Grisham (nonfiction book)

rs-anne-of-green-gables-1985.plot: Imaginative, talkative orphan Anne Shirley is mistakenly sent to elderly siblings Marilla and Matthew Cuthbert on Prince Edward Island, and wins over her new family and community while growing from a mischievous girl into a young woman.
rs-anne-of-green-gables-1985.source: Anne of Green Gables by L. M. Montgomery

rs-green-wing-2004.plot: Surgeons, admin staff and a new junior doctor at a chaotic English hospital spend their days on absurd love triangles, office rivalries and surreal, semi-improvised comedy, with barely any medicine in sight.

rs-and-just-like-that-2021.plot: A continuation of Sex and the City following Carrie, Miranda and Charlotte in their fifties as they navigate grief, new relationships, careers and identity in Manhattan alongside a widening circle of friends.

rs-girlfriends-2000.plot: Four Black women in Los Angeles, led by successful lawyer Joan Clayton, support each other through careers, relationships and the ups and downs of their friendship.

rs-longitude-2000.plot: Self-taught clockmaker John Harrison spends decades in the 18th century building a marine chronometer to solve the longitude problem, while in the 1920s-30s naval officer Rupert Gould obsessively restores his clocks.

rs-the-outsider-2020.plot: When a beloved Little League coach is arrested for a child's gruesome murder despite evidence he was elsewhere, a grieving Georgia detective and an unconventional private investigator uncover a shape-shifting supernatural force.

rs-after-life-2019.plot: After his wife dies of cancer, small-town newspaper journalist Tony decides to punish the world by saying and doing whatever he likes, but his friends, colleagues and the people he meets slowly pull him back toward kindness.

rs-in-treatment-2008.plot: Each half-hour episode is a single therapy session, following a psychotherapist through a week of patients and his own sessions with a supervisor. Over time the patients' crises and the therapist's personal life bleed into one another.

rs-sinatra-all-or-nothing-at-all-2015.plot: A two-part documentary traces Frank Sinatra's life and career, structured around the songs he chose for his 1971 retirement concert, using archival footage and interviews to explore his music, fame and personal life.

rs-boss-2011.plot: Chicago mayor Tom Kane, a ruthless political operator, is diagnosed with a degenerative brain disorder and hides it from everyone while fighting to keep his grip on power amid scandal, ambitious rivals and his estranged family.

rs-the-day-of-the-jackal-2024.plot: A brilliant, elusive assassin known as the Jackal takes on a high-stakes contract while a relentless British intelligence officer tracks him across Europe, as his dangerous double life threatens the family he keeps.
rs-the-day-of-the-jackal-2024.source: The Day of the Jackal by Frederick Forsyth

rs-mary-hartman-mary-hartman-1976.plot: Anxious Ohio housewife Mary Hartman obsesses over waxy yellow buildup on her kitchen floor while her small town of Fernwood is rocked by mass murder, scandal and absurd tragedy. A deadpan, daily satire of soap operas produced by Norman Lear.

rs-strangers-with-candy-1999.plot: Jerri Blank, a 46-year-old former junkie and prostitute, returns to high school as a freshman, learning warped life lessons in a parody of after-school specials.

rs-alice-in-borderland-2020.plot: Aimless gamer Arisu and his friends are suddenly trapped in an empty, parallel Tokyo where they must compete in deadly games to survive, and soon begin searching for the truth behind the world.

rs-kingdom-2019.plot: In Korea's Joseon era, a crown prince investigating his father's mysterious illness uncovers a plague that turns the dead into ravenous monsters, while political enemies plot to seize the throne.
rs-kingdom-2019.source: The Kingdom of the Gods (Kim Eun-hee, Yang Kyung-il)

rs-hellbound-2021.plot: Supernatural beings appear to tell individuals the exact moment they will be condemned to hell, then return on schedule to kill them brutally, while a fanatical religious movement rises to exploit the public's terror.
rs-hellbound-2021.source: Hellbound (webtoon by Yeon Sang-ho and Choi Gyu-seok)

rs-trapper-john-m-d-1979.plot: Decades after the Korean War, former Army surgeon 'Trapper' John McIntyre is chief of surgery at San Francisco Memorial Hospital, mentoring brash young surgeon G. Alonzo 'Gonzo' Gates and treating a steady flow of patients.

rs-star-trek-strange-new-worlds-2022.plot: Years before Kirk, Captain Christopher Pike commands the USS Enterprise with Spock and Number One, exploring new worlds in largely episodic adventures while wrestling with foreknowledge of his own grim fate.

rs-the-orville-2017.plot: In the 25th century, a mid-level officer gets command of a middling exploratory starship, crewed by an eccentric mix of humans and aliens, including his ex-wife as first officer, in a Star Trek homage mixing comedy and drama.

rs-lost-in-space-1965.plot: In 1997 the Robinson family sets out to colonize a planet near Alpha Centauri, but sabotage by stowaway Dr. Zachary Smith leaves their ship lost among strange worlds, with only their trusty Robot for warning: "Danger, Will Robinson!"

rs-it-1990.plot: In 1960, seven misfit kids in Derry, Maine, battle a shape-shifting evil that appears as Pennywise the clown; thirty years later, the killings resume and the now-adult Losers' Club return to face it again.

rs-rose-red-2002.plot: A psychology professor leads a team of psychics, including an autistic girl with telekinetic powers, into a vast, malevolent Seattle mansion that seems to grow on its own, hoping to prove the supernatural is real.

rs-salem-s-lot-1979.plot: Novelist Ben Mears returns to his Maine hometown to write about a sinister old house, just as a mysterious antiques dealer moves in and townspeople begin turning into vampires. Tobe Hooper directed this two-part adaptation of Stephen King's novel.

rs-the-stand-2020.plot: After a weaponized flu wipes out most of humanity, survivors are drawn by dreams either to the saintly Mother Abagail in Boulder or to the demonic Randall Flagg in Las Vegas, setting up a final battle between good and evil.

rs-dark-skies-1996.plot: In the 1960s, a young congressional aide and his girlfriend uncover that aliens are secretly infiltrating Earth and that a covert government group is hiding the truth behind key events of the decade.

rs-project-blue-book-2019.plot: In the 1950s, astrophysicist J. Allen Hynek is recruited by the U.S. Air Force to debunk UFO sightings, but his investigations with Captain Michael Quinn lead him toward a deeper conspiracy.

rs-v-1983.plot: Giant spaceships arrive over Earth's cities carrying friendly human-looking Visitors who promise help, but a TV cameraman discovers they are reptilian invaders hiding sinister plans, sparking a resistance movement echoing the fight against fascism.

rs-rowan-martin-s-laugh-in-1968.plot: Comedy duo Dan Rowan and Dick Martin host a rapid-fire sketch show of one-liners, blackouts, catchphrases and topical gags performed by a large ensemble, with celebrity cameos and the famous joke wall. It defined late-1960s TV comedy.

rs-the-daily-show-1996.plot: A nightly satirical news program that lampoons politics, the media and current events through mock reports, field pieces and celebrity interviews, hosted over the years by Craig Kilborn, Jon Stewart and Trevor Noah.

rs-the-smothers-brothers-comedy-hour-196.plot: Folk-singing comedy duo Tom and Dick Smothers host an irreverent variety hour of music and topical satire, mocking the Vietnam War and politics and clashing repeatedly with CBS censors until the network cancelled it.

rs-the-sixties-2014.plot: This documentary series surveys the 1960s in America, covering politics, television, the space race, civil rights, the Vietnam War and the counterculture. Each episode takes one theme, using archival footage and interviews.

rs-manifest-2018.plot: Passengers of a turbulent flight land to discover five and a half years have passed while they were in the air; as they rebuild their lives, they begin hearing mysterious callings tied to a greater purpose.

rs-benjamin-franklin-2002.plot: A dramatized documentary tracing Benjamin Franklin's life from runaway printer's apprentice to scientist, diplomat and Founding Father, combining expert commentary with actors reading his words.

rs-ripper-street-2012.plot: In London's Whitechapel in the months after the Jack the Ripper murders, a police inspector, his sergeant and an American surgeon solve violent crimes. Their cases expose the district's poverty, and the inspector also carries secrets of his own.

rs-the-hot-zone-2019.plot: An anthology of true scientific thrillers: the first season follows Army scientist Nancy Jaax racing to contain Ebola near Washington, D.C. in 1989; the second follows the 2001 anthrax attacks investigation.

rs-the-last-ship-2014.plot: A U.S. Navy destroyer that spent months on a secret Arctic mission learns that a pandemic has wiped out most of humanity. The crew must protect a virologist racing to find a cure.
rs-the-last-ship-2014.source: The Last Ship by William Brinkley

rs-petticoat-junction-1963.plot: Widow Kate Bradley runs the Shady Rest Hotel near the rural railroad junction of Hooterville with her lazy Uncle Joe and three pretty daughters, whose antics and suitors keep the countryside lively.

rs-the-jackie-gleason-show-1952.plot: Jackie Gleason headlines a lavish variety hour with June Taylor's dancers, big musical numbers and sketches featuring his gallery of characters, including Ralph Kramden of The Honeymooners and Reginald Van Gleason III.

rs-the-saint-1962.plot: Simon Templar, a debonair adventurer and modern-day Robin Hood known as the Saint, travels the world in his Volvo, helping victims and outwitting criminals, spies and crooks the police cannot touch.
rs-the-saint-1962.source: The Saint novels by Leslie Charteris

rs-laurel-canyon-2020.plot: A two-part documentary about the Los Angeles neighborhood of Laurel Canyon, where in the 1960s and 70s musicians like Joni Mitchell, the Byrds, Crosby, Stills & Nash and the Doors lived and created a defining era of rock music.

rs-the-defiant-ones-2017.plot: The intertwined careers of record producer Jimmy Iovine and rapper-producer Dr. Dre, from studio beginnings through hip-hop and rock history to founding Beats, told through archive footage and interviews with music stars.

rs-kitchen-confidential-2005.plot: Jack Bourdain, a once-hot New York chef who burned out on excess, gets a second chance running the kitchen of an upscale Manhattan restaurant with a crew of misfit cooks.

rs-presumed-innocent-2024.plot: Chicago prosecutor Rusty Sabich becomes the prime suspect in the murder of a colleague he had an affair with, putting his marriage and family under strain as he stands trial.

rs-gilligan-s-island-1964.plot: After a three-hour tour goes wrong, the bumbling first mate Gilligan, the Skipper and five passengers are shipwrecked on an uncharted Pacific island, where their rescue plans are endlessly foiled, usually by Gilligan.

rs-fat-albert-and-the-cosby-kids-1972.plot: Bill Cosby hosts animated stories of Fat Albert and his friends from a North Philadelphia neighborhood, who hang out in a junkyard, play in their homemade band and learn lessons about honesty, peer pressure and growing up.

rs-chico-and-the-man-1974.plot: Cantankerous widower Ed Brown runs a run-down garage in East Los Angeles until optimistic young Mexican-American Chico Rodriguez talks his way into a job and a place to live, forming an unlikely friendship.

rs-the-dean-martin-show-1965.plot: Crooner Dean Martin hosts a relaxed, seemingly improvised hour of songs, comedy sketches and celebrity guests, with the Golddiggers dancers and Ken Lane at the piano, later adding the famous celebrity roasts.

rs-alpha-house-2013.plot: Four Republican U.S. senators share a rented house in Washington, D.C. They juggle re-election fights, primary challengers and scandals while living together like uneasy roommates.

rs-treadstone-2019.plot: Set in the Bourne universe, sleeper agents created by the CIA's covert Treadstone program are reactivated around the world, while the story of the program's Cold War origins unfolds in parallel.

rs-top-boy-2011.plot: On the Summerhouse estate in Hackney, East London, drug dealers Dushane and Sully fight to climb and hold the top of the local trade, while young residents are drawn into the world of gangs, violence and survival.

rs-we-own-this-city-2022.plot: In the years after Freddie Gray's death, an elite Baltimore police unit led by Sergeant Wayne Jenkins robs, lies and plants evidence with impunity, while federal investigators and a civil rights attorney work to expose the corruption.
rs-we-own-this-city-2022.source: We Own This City by Justin Fenton

rs-family-matters-1989.plot: Chicago police officer Carl Winslow and his family find their middle-class home life disrupted by nerdy, accident-prone neighbor Steve Urkel, whose crush on daughter Laura and wild inventions take over the show.

rs-the-danny-kaye-show-1963.plot: Entertainer Danny Kaye hosts an hour of music, song-and-dance numbers and comic sketches, joined by a supporting ensemble and weekly guest stars.

rs-the-real-mccoys-1957.plot: Cantankerous Grandpa Amos McCoy moves his West Virginia mountain family to a ranch in California's San Fernando Valley, where the hillbillies adjust to farming and neighbors with homespun humor.

rs-the-agency-2024.plot: A CIA covert officer is called back to London headquarters after years undercover, but when the woman he loved during his cover life reappears, his divided loyalties threaten agents and a critical operation.

rs-the-paradise-2012.plot: A young woman from the country takes a job at a glamorous department store in 1870s northern England. She rises through the ranks while drawn to the store's ambitious widowed owner, amid staff rivalries and romance.
rs-the-paradise-2012.source: Au Bonheur des Dames by Émile Zola

rs-fbi-2018.plot: Agents of the FBI's New York field office use every resource at their disposal to investigate terrorism, organized crime and other major threats to the city and the nation.

rs-the-nanny-1993.plot: Fran Fine, a brassy fashion saleswoman from Queens, talks her way into a job as nanny to the three children of a widowed British Broadway producer in Manhattan, shaking up the household and his heart.

rs-homecoming-2018.plot: A caseworker at a secretive facility helping soldiers transition to civilian life later starts a new life as a waitress, until a Defense Department investigator's questions expose what the program was really doing.

rs-the-jetsons-1962.plot: In a gleaming future of flying cars, robot maids and push-button conveniences, George Jetson works short shifts at Spacely Space Sprockets and copes with family life with his wife Jane, kids Judy and Elroy, and dog Astro.

rs-top-cat-1961.plot: Fast-talking alley cat Top Cat leads his gang of feline pals in get-rich-quick schemes around their Manhattan alley, while constantly outwitting the long-suffering beat cop Officer Dibble.

rs-the-incredible-hulk-1977.plot: After a gamma radiation experiment goes wrong, scientist David Banner transforms into a raging green creature when angered. Presumed dead and pursued by a tabloid reporter, he drifts across America under false names, helping people while seeking a cure.

rs-the-invaders-1967.plot: Architect David Vincent witnesses an alien landing and learns that beings from a dying planet are secretly infiltrating Earth in human form; with no proof and few allies, he struggles to convince a skeptical world.

rs-it-s-garry-shandling-s-show-1986.plot: Comedian Garry Shandling plays himself in a self-aware sitcom that constantly breaks the fourth wall, addressing the studio audience and toying with TV conventions while dealing with neighbors, friends and his love life.

rs-the-ernie-kovacs-show-1952.plot: Television innovator Ernie Kovacs hosts surreal, visually inventive comedy built on camera tricks, blackout gags, oddball characters like Percy Dovetonsils and wordless musical bits, alongside singer Edie Adams.

rs-the-steve-allen-show-1956.plot: Quick-witted comedian and composer Steve Allen hosts a freewheeling comedy-variety hour with music guests, ad-libbed stunts, and a celebrated ensemble whose "Man on the Street" interviews launched several comic careers.

rs-ghosts-2021.plot: A young couple inherits a crumbling country mansion and tries to turn it into a bed-and-breakfast, but after a near-death accident the wife can see and hear the bickering ghosts of former residents who haunt the house.

rs-pushing-daisies-2007.plot: Pie-maker Ned can bring the dead back to life with a touch, but a second touch kills them forever; he teams with a private investigator to solve murders and revives his childhood sweetheart, whom he can never touch again.

rs-the-buccaneers-2023.plot: In the 1870s, a group of wealthy, spirited American girls arrive in London society seeking husbands and titles, shaking up the stiff British aristocracy while discovering that marriage brings its own traps and heartbreak.

rs-belgravia-2020.plot: A secret from the eve of the Battle of Waterloo resurfaces decades later in 1840s London, threatening the social standing of two families in the newly fashionable district of Belgravia.

rs-empty-nest-1988.plot: Widowed Miami pediatrician Harry Weston expects quiet after his wife's death, but his two adult daughters move back home, and he copes with their problems, his wisecracking nurse and a womanizing neighbor.

rs-forever-2018.plot: A long-married couple stuck in a comfortable routine find their relationship tested in unexpected ways when one of them dies and they meet again in a quiet, suburban version of the afterlife.

rs-upload-2020.plot: In 2033, the dying can upload their consciousness into a digital afterlife. After app developer Nathan dies in a suspicious self-driving-car crash, he wakes in a luxury virtual resort and falls for Nora, the customer-service 'angel' assigned to him.

setting.place: USA and the virtual afterlife Lakeview

rs-years-and-years-2019.plot: The Lyons, a Manchester family, are followed over fifteen years from 2019 as political upheaval, a populist leader, economic collapse and rapid technological change transform Britain and their lives.

rs-two-for-the-money-1952.plot: A quiz show in which pairs of contestants earn cash by naming as many answers as possible to category questions against the clock, padded out with the host's folksy humor and banter.

rs-arthur-godfrey-s-talent-scouts-1948.plot: Broadcaster Arthur Godfrey hosts a talent contest in which scouts present amateur and up-and-coming performers, with the studio audience's applause meter choosing the winner. Simulcast on radio, it gave early breaks to many future stars.

rs-hee-haw-1969.plot: Country music stars Buck Owens and Roy Clark host a cornpone variety hour set in rural 'Kornfield Kounty', mixing performances by top country acts with quick-fire hayseed sketches and jokes. After CBS dropped it, it ran for decades in syndication.

rs-black-earth-rising-2018.plot: Kate Ashby, a legal investigator rescued as a child from the Rwandan genocide and raised in Britain, is drawn into the prosecution of an African militia leader, forcing her to confront her own past.

rs-the-new-edition-story-2017.plot: Five teenage friends from Boston's Roxbury projects become the R&B group New Edition, weathering bad contracts, rivalries, solo careers and reunions over three decades of fame.

rs-empire-2015.plot: Hip-hop mogul Lucious Lyon, head of the music label Empire Entertainment, must choose which of his three sons will succeed him, while his ex-wife Cookie returns from prison to claim her share of the company.

rs-the-get-down-2016.plot: In the late-1970s South Bronx, a group of teenagers, including a gifted young poet and a graffiti-artist DJ, help bring about the birth of hip-hop amid poverty, disco and political corruption.

rs-a-suitable-boy-2020.plot: In 1951 newly independent India, university student Lata Mehra is pressured by her mother to marry a suitable boy, and must choose between three very different suitors as the nation prepares for its first election.

rs-self-made-2020.plot: Inspired by the life of Madam C. J. Walker, the series follows her rise from washerwoman to the first female self-made millionaire in America, building a hair care empire for Black women in the early 1900s.

rs-11-22-63-2016.plot: Divorced English teacher Jake Epping discovers a time portal to 1960 and is persuaded to stay in the past long enough to try to prevent the assassination of President John F. Kennedy, but the past pushes back.

rs-american-dynasties-the-kennedys-2018.plot: A documentary history of the Kennedy family's rise to power, from patriarch Joseph Kennedy's ambitions through JFK's presidency, the assassinations and the scandals and political legacy that followed.

rs-a-man-on-the-inside-2024.plot: Lonely retired professor Charles is hired by a private investigator to go undercover in a San Francisco retirement community to solve a theft, and finds new purpose and friendships among the residents; later he takes on new undercover cases.

rs-the-godfather-saga-1977.plot: Francis Ford Coppola re-edits The Godfather and The Godfather Part II into chronological order with restored footage, following Vito Corleone from Sicilian orphan to New York crime boss and his son Michael's transformation into the family's ruthless heir.
rs-the-godfather-saga-1977.source: The Godfather and The Godfather Part II

rs-godfather-of-harlem-2019.plot: In the 1960s, crime boss Bumpy Johnson returns from prison to find the Italian mob running Harlem, and allies with radical preacher Malcolm X in a fight for control that intertwines crime with the civil rights movement.

rs-mob-city-2013.plot: In 1940s Los Angeles, a war-veteran detective in the LAPD's squad against organized crime faces down the gangster Bugsy Siegel and his associates. Police chief William Parker wages the war as loyalties blur.

rs-the-walking-dead-2010.plot: Sheriff's deputy Rick Grimes wakes from a coma into a world overrun by the undead and leads a band of survivors searching for safety. Over years, the greater danger proves to be other humans as communities rise, clash and rebuild.

rs-frontier-2016.plot: In the brutal North American fur trade of the late 18th century, part-Irish, part-Cree outlaw Declan Harp wages war on the Hudson's Bay Company's monopoly, as a young Irish thief is drawn into the conflict.

rs-barkskins-2020.plot: In 1690s New France, settlers, French indentured men, Indigenous people and fortune seekers converge on a remote settlement in the North American wilderness, struggling for survival amid violence and a scramble for its forests.

rs-goliath-2016.plot: Billy McBride, a once-powerful lawyer now burned out and drinking in a Santa Monica motel bar, takes on a wrongful-death case against the huge firm he co-founded, and each season pits him against a new powerful adversary.

rs-rake-2010.plot: Cleaver Greene is a brilliant but self-destructive Sydney barrister who takes on hopeless and outrageous cases while drowning in gambling debts, drink, women and a talent for antagonizing everyone, from judges to the taxman.

rs-medici-2016.plot: The Medici banking family rises to power in 15th-century Florence, first under Cosimo de' Medici after his father's suspicious death, then under his grandson Lorenzo the Magnificent amid rivalries, conspiracies and the Renaissance.

rs-civilisation-1969.plot: Art historian Kenneth Clark guides viewers through Western European art, architecture and ideas from the end of the Dark Ages to the early twentieth century, filmed on location across Europe. A landmark of the authored documentary form.

rs-the-barbara-stanwyck-show-1960.plot: Barbara Stanwyck hosts and stars in most installments of this dramatic anthology, playing a different woman in each self-contained story, from melodrama and suspense to adventure abroad.

rs-perfect-strangers-2001.plot: At a grand reunion of a sprawling family he barely knows, young Daniel is drawn into uncovering long-buried secrets, love affairs and stories that link three generations of relatives.

rs-here-s-lucy-1968.plot: Widowed Lucy Carter works as a secretary at the Los Angeles employment agency run by her gruff brother-in-law Harrison, while raising two teenagers who are often pulled into her schemes. Lucille Ball's third sitcom vehicle, co-starring her real children.

rs-the-mothers-in-law-1967.plot: Two very different next-door neighbors, brash Kaye Buell and proper Eve Hubbard, become in-laws when their children marry, and their constant meddling in the young couple's life fuels comic rivalry.

rs-charlie-s-angels-1976.plot: Three former police academy graduates work as private investigators for the never-seen millionaire Charlie Townsend, who assigns cases by speakerphone, going undercover in glamorous settings with help from his associate Bosley.

rs-wheels-1978.plot: Detroit auto executive Adam Trenton pushes to launch a revolutionary new car while his career pressures strain his marriage, set against labor unrest and the cutthroat politics of the American auto industry. Adapted from Arthur Hailey's novel.

rs-industry-2020.plot: A group of young graduates compete for permanent jobs at Pierpoint & Co, a prestigious London investment bank, where ambition, sex, drugs and cutthroat office politics shape their lives and careers.

rs-josie-and-the-pussycats-1970.plot: Josie, Melody and Valerie form an all-girl rock band who, while touring the world with their manager and friends, keep stumbling into spy plots and mad-scientist schemes. Hanna-Barbera's cartoon adaptation of the Archie Comics characters.

rs-simon-schama-s-power-of-art-2006.plot: Historian Simon Schama dramatizes a defining moment in the lives of eight great artists, from Caravaggio and Rembrandt to Van Gogh, Picasso and Rothko, arguing for art's power to shock and transform.

rs-studio-60-on-the-sunset-strip-2006.plot: After a producer's on-air meltdown, two former writers are brought back to rescue a once-great live sketch comedy show, battling network executives, censors and their own pasts behind the scenes.

rs-the-staircase-2004.plot: Filmed with remarkable access, this documentary follows novelist Michael Peterson's defense after his wife is found dead at the foot of a staircase in their North Carolina home and he is charged with murder.

rs-the-innocence-files-2020.plot: Episodes examine cases taken up by the Innocence Project, showing how flawed forensic science, faulty eyewitness identification and prosecutorial misconduct sent innocent people to prison for decades.

rs-kolchak-the-night-stalker-1974.plot: Rumpled Chicago wire-service reporter Carl Kolchak investigates strange crimes that turn out to involve vampires, werewolves, demons and other monsters, but his exasperated editor never believes him and the evidence always vanishes. A key influence on The X-Files.

rs-mcmafia-2018.plot: Alex Godman, the British-raised son of an exiled Russian mafia family, has built a legitimate life in London finance, but is pulled into the world of global organized crime to protect his family.

setting.place: London, Moscow, Prague, Tel Aviv and beyond

rs-criminal-justice-2008.plot: Each series follows one defendant through the British justice system. First, a young man wakes beside a murdered woman with no memory of the night; then a wife stabs her seemingly respectable husband. Arrest, custody, lawyers and trial expose how the system reshapes everyone involved.

rs-perfect-strangers-1986.plot: Uptight Chicagoan Larry Appleton's life is upended when his distant cousin Balki Bartokomous, an innocent, cheerful shepherd from a small Mediterranean island, arrives to live with him, leading to farcical misadventures and an unlikely friendship.

rs-bosom-buddies-1980.plot: Two young New York advertising men disguise themselves as women to rent rooms in a cheap women-only hotel, juggling their double lives, careers and crushes on their neighbors.

rs-jason-and-the-argonauts-2000.plot: Young prince Jason, cheated of his throne by his uncle, assembles a crew of heroes aboard the Argo and sails to the edge of the world to seize the Golden Fleece, encountering gods, monsters and the sorceress Medea.

rs-troy-fall-of-a-city-2018.plot: Trojan prince Paris falls for Helen, wife of the Spartan king, and their elopement triggers a ten-year siege of Troy by the Greek armies, with gods and heroes shaping the bloody outcome.
rs-troy-fall-of-a-city-2018.source: The Iliad and Greek myths of the Trojan War

rs-hercules-the-legendary-journeys-1995.plot: Demigod Hercules, son of Zeus, roams ancient Greece with his friend Iolaus, battling monsters, warlords and the schemes of his jealous stepmother Hera while defending ordinary people.

rs-victory-at-sea-1952.plot: Assembled from vast amounts of combat footage, this documentary chronicles naval warfare in World War II, from the Battle of the Atlantic to the Pacific campaigns, set to a sweeping orchestral score by Richard Rodgers.

rs-felicity-1998.plot: On a whim, high school graduate Felicity Porter follows her crush to college in New York instead of Stanford, and her four years there bring love triangles, friendships and self-discovery.

rs-play-for-today-1970.plot: The BBC's flagship single-drama strand presented original plays by writers such as Dennis Potter, Mike Leigh, Alan Bleasdale and Jim Allen, often tackling contemporary British social and political issues. Notable entries include Abigail's Party and Nuts in May.

rs-raising-the-bar-2008.plot: Idealistic public defender Jerry Kellerman and his former law-school friends, now spread across defense and prosecution, battle each other and a tough judge in Manhattan's criminal courts while their personal lives tangle.

rs-hec-ramsey-1972.plot: At the turn of the twentieth century, aging gunfighter Hec Ramsey becomes deputy in a small Oklahoma town, using the new science of fingerprints, ballistics and forensics to solve crimes alongside its young, by-the-book police chief. Part of the NBC Mystery Movie.

rs-spenser-for-hire-1985.plot: Boston private eye Spenser, a former boxer and cop who quotes poetry and cooks gourmet meals, takes on cases with help from his enigmatic enforcer friend Hawk and his psychologist girlfriend.
rs-spenser-for-hire-1985.source: Spenser novels by Robert B. Parker

rs-hollywood-1980.plot: Film historians Kevin Brownlow and David Gill chronicle the American silent film era, from its pioneers and stars to stunt work, comedy and the coming of sound, using restored clips and interviews with surviving veterans. Narrated by James Mason.

rs-the-spanish-princess-2019.plot: Spanish princess Catherine of Aragon arrives in England to marry Prince Arthur, but after his death she fights to become queen as the wife of his brother, Henry VIII.
rs-the-spanish-princess-2019.source: The Constant Princess / The King's Curse (Philippa Gregory)

rs-cougar-town-2009.plot: Newly divorced Jules Cobb, a fortysomething Florida realtor, re-enters the dating scene, but the show soon becomes about her wine-loving circle of friends, neighbors and exes who form a tight cul-de-sac family.

rs-nash-bridges-1996.plot: Charismatic San Francisco police inspector Nash Bridges leads an elite investigations unit with his ex-con partner Joe Dominguez, juggling flashy cases with a chaotic family life.

rs-a-place-to-call-home-2013.plot: In 1950s rural New South Wales, a nurse returning from years in Europe becomes entangled with a wealthy, conservative grazier family. Old wartime secrets and forbidden loves shake their estate, Ash Park.

rs-dominick-dunne-power-privilege-and-ju.plot: Writer Dominick Dunne revisits notorious crimes involving the rich and famous, examining how wealth and influence shaped the investigations and trials.

rs-when-calls-the-heart-2014.plot: A privileged young teacher from the city takes a post in a small Canadian coal-mining town in the early 20th century. She builds a life, friendships and romance with the townsfolk and a Mountie.
rs-when-calls-the-heart-2014.source: Canadian West series by Janette Oke

rs-enlightened-2011.plot: After a public meltdown, corporate executive Amy Jellicoe returns from a Hawaiian wellness retreat determined to live a spiritually awakened life. Demoted to a basement data-entry job, she clashes with coworkers and family and sets out to expose her company's wrongdoing.

rs-the-white-princess-2017.plot: After the Battle of Bosworth, Elizabeth of York is forced to marry the victorious Henry VII to unite warring houses, as plots, rival claimants and their scheming mothers threaten the new Tudor dynasty.
rs-the-white-princess-2017.source: The White Princess by Philippa Gregory

rs-swagger-2021.plot: Inspired by Kevin Durant's youth-basketball years, the series follows Jace Carson, a top-ranked teenage player in the Washington, D.C. area, and his coach as they navigate the ambition, money and corruption of elite youth basketball.

rs-last-chance-u-2016.plot: A sports documentary series that follows junior college football programs and their players, many of them talented athletes trying to rebuild academic records or reputations to earn a shot at Division I football.

rs-atlantic-crossing-2020.plot: During World War II, Norway's Crown Princess Märtha flees the Nazi invasion with her children to the United States, where she forms a close bond with President Franklin D. Roosevelt and lobbies for her country.

rs-greenleaf-2016.plot: Estranged daughter Grace Greenleaf returns home to Memphis for her sister's funeral and is drawn back into her family's sprawling megachurch, uncovering scandals, secrets and power struggles behind its pulpit.

rs-man-about-the-house-1973.plot: Two young women in a London flat take in cooking student Robin Tripp as a roommate, to the scandal of their nosy landlords George and Mildred Roper, leading to romantic tension and farce. It inspired the American remake Three's Company.

rs-the-ropers-1979.plot: Former landlords Stanley and Helen Roper move to an upscale townhouse in Cheviot Hills, where penny-pinching Stanley clashes with their snobbish neighbor while frustrated Helen seeks a livelier life. A spin-off of Three's Company.

rs-once-upon-a-time-2011.plot: Bail bondswoman Emma Swan is brought to Storybrooke, Maine, by the son she gave up, who believes the residents are fairy-tale characters trapped without memories by the Evil Queen's curse, and that only Emma can break it.

rs-callan-1967.plot: David Callan, a disillusioned working-class assassin, carries out dirty jobs for a shadowy British intelligence section, wrestling with his conscience and his bosses while relying on the grubby petty thief Lonely.

rs-all-creatures-great-and-small-1978.plot: Young vet James Herriot joins the practice of eccentric Siegfried Farnon and his feckless brother Tristan in the Yorkshire Dales, treating animals and winning over stubborn farmers from the late 1930s onward. Based on James Herriot's semi-autobiographical books.

rs-grange-hill-1978.plot: Generations of pupils at a London comprehensive school deal with bullying, friendships, first loves and serious issues such as drug addiction and racism, in a children's drama known for tackling tough subjects frankly.

rs-dirty-money-2018.plot: Each episode investigates a different case of corporate greed and corruption, from Volkswagen's emissions cheating and payday lending to the Trump business empire and pharmaceutical price gouging.

rs-shetland-2013.plot: Detective Inspector Jimmy Perez and his team investigate murders across the remote Shetland Islands, where tight-knit communities keep their secrets. Later series bring a new lead detective from the mainland.

rs-mister-ed-1961.plot: Architect Wilbur Post moves to the country and discovers that the palomino horse in his new barn can talk, but only to him, which keeps landing Wilbur in awkward situations with his wife and neighbors.
rs-mister-ed-1961.source: Mister Ed stories by Walter R. Brooks

rs-traffik-1989.plot: Three interwoven stories trace the heroin trade from a Pakistani poppy farmer to a German businessman's smuggling network and a British government minister whose daughter is an addict, exposing the human costs of the drug war.

rs-work-in-progress-2019.plot: Abby, a 45-year-old self-identified fat, queer dyke in Chicago, gives herself 180 days to improve her life before ending it, but an unexpected relationship with a younger trans man changes her outlook.

rs-when-the-levees-broke-2006.plot: Spike Lee documents the devastation of New Orleans after Hurricane Katrina and the levee failures, giving voice to residents and examining the government's failed response.

rs-jazz-2001.plot: Ken Burns chronicles the history of jazz from its roots in New Orleans through swing, bebop and beyond, profiling Louis Armstrong, Duke Ellington and other giants and examining the music's ties to American race relations.
