rs-the-vampire-diaries-2009.plot: Grieving teenager Elena Gilbert falls for Stefan Salvatore, a brooding vampire, in the town of Mystic Falls, drawing her into a love triangle with his dangerous brother Damon and a supernatural world of witches, werewolves and ancient vampires.

rs-interview-with-the-vampire-2022.plot: Vampire Louis de Pointe du Lac recounts his life to an aging journalist, from his seduction by Lestat in 1910s New Orleans to their turbulent romance and the vampire child Claudia; later seasons shift to Lestat himself.

rs-californication-2007.plot: Self-destructive New York novelist Hank Moody, stuck in Los Angeles with writer's block, drinks and sleeps his way through trouble while trying to win back the mother of his teenage daughter.

rs-anger-management-2012.plot: A former baseball player whose temper ended his career now works as an anger-management therapist. He runs group sessions, counsels prison inmates and juggles his ex-wife, teenage daughter and a casual relationship with a fellow therapist.

rs-men-behaving-badly-1992.plot: Lager-loving flatmates Gary and Tony act like overgrown adolescents, obsessing over beer, sex and football, while Gary's sensible girlfriend Dorothy and upstairs neighbor Deborah put up with them.
rs-men-behaving-badly-1992.source: Men Behaving Badly by Simon Nye

rs-yo-soy-betty-la-fea-1999.plot: Brilliant but unattractive economist Beatriz Pinzón lands a job as secretary at a Bogotá fashion company, where she becomes the president's loyal confidante, helps him hide the firm's troubles and falls in love with him.

rs-jane-the-virgin-2014.plot: A devout young Latina woman saving herself for marriage is accidentally artificially inseminated during a checkup. Her life turns into a telenovela, full of romance, crime and family drama, all wryly narrated.

rs-the-keepers-2017.plot: Former students investigate the unsolved 1969 murder of Sister Cathy Cesnik, a beloved Baltimore nun, uncovering allegations of abuse at a Catholic high school and a possible cover-up.

rs-girls5eva-2021.plot: A one-hit-wonder girl group from the late 1990s gets a second shot at fame when a rapper samples their song, so the four now-middle-aged members reunite to chase stardom while juggling their adult lives.

rs-shtisel-2013.plot: A widowed rabbi and his family live in an ultra-Orthodox Haredi neighborhood of Jerusalem. His youngest son, an artistic dreamer, searches for love and his own path within the community's traditions.

rs-avenue-5-2020.plot: In the near future, a luxury space cruise ship suffers a gravity glitch that knocks it off course, extending an eight-week trip to years, as its fraudulent captain and incompetent crew try to keep panicking passengers in line.

rs-w1a-2014.plot: A former Olympics organizer becomes the BBC's new Head of Values. He navigates the corporation's jargon-filled meetings, branding consultants and endless bureaucracy in this mockumentary.

rs-agatha-all-along-2024.plot: Freed from a spell but stripped of her powers, witch Agatha Harkness assembles a coven of misfit witches and a mysterious teenager to walk the legendary Witches' Road, a deadly series of trials that promises to grant them what they lack.

setting.place: Westview, New Jersey and the Witches' Road

rs-loki-2021.plot: After stealing the Tesseract, the god of mischief Loki is captured by the Time Variance Authority, a bureaucracy that polices the timeline, and is enlisted to hunt a dangerous variant of himself, unraveling the secrets of the multiverse.

rs-legion-2017.plot: David Haller, diagnosed with schizophrenia, discovers the voices and visions he experiences may be signs of immense mutant powers, and that a parasitic psychic entity lurks inside his fractured mind.

rs-house-of-cards-1990.plot: Passed over for promotion after Thatcher's exit, Conservative chief whip Francis Urquhart ruthlessly schemes to destroy his rivals and seize the premiership, confiding in the audience while using an ambitious young journalist.
rs-house-of-cards-1990.source: House of Cards by Michael Dobbs

rs-doom-patrol-2019.plot: A band of traumatized misfits with strange powers, including a robot man, a living energy being and a woman with dozens of personalities, are reluctantly brought together by an eccentric scientist and stumble into bizarre threats to the world.

rs-chilling-adventures-of-sabrina-2018.plot: Half-witch, half-mortal Sabrina Spellman must choose between the witching world of her aunts and the Church of Night and her human life and friends in Greendale, as dark forces gather around her.

rs-buffy-the-vampire-slayer-1997.plot: Teenager Buffy Summers, the Chosen One destined to fight vampires and demons, moves to Sunnydale, a town built over a Hellmouth, where she battles evil with her friends and her Watcher while growing up.

rs-the-addams-family-1964.plot: The macabre but devoted Addams family, led by passionate Gomez and serene Morticia, delight in all things ghoulish in their creepy mansion and cannot understand why normal visitors flee in horror.

rs-united-states-of-tara-2009.plot: Kansas artist and mother Tara Gregson has dissociative identity disorder, and when she stops medication her alternate personalities, including a teen girl, a 1950s housewife and a gruff male veteran, take over. Her husband and children try to hold the family together.

rs-what-s-happening-1976.plot: Three teenage friends in the Watts neighborhood of Los Angeles, Raj, Rerun and Dwayne, navigate school, girls and part-time jobs, under the eye of Raj's single mother and his bossy little sister Dee. Loosely inspired by the film Cooley High.

rs-humans-2015.plot: In a parallel present where lifelike androids called synths are common household servants, a family buys a secondhand synth that turns out to be one of a small group secretly given consciousness, raising questions about what it means to be human.

rs-person-of-interest-2011.plot: Reclusive billionaire Harold Finch built a secret mass-surveillance AI for the government that predicts terrorism. Using a back door that gives him the Social Security numbers of people involved in ordinary crimes, he recruits ex-CIA operative John Reese to stop them, until a rival AI emerges.

rs-evil-2019.plot: Skeptical forensic psychologist Kristen Bouchard teams with a priest-in-training and a tech contractor to investigate possessions, miracles and hauntings for the Catholic Church, while a sinister network seems to be targeting her family.

rs-brotherhood-2006.plot: In Providence, Rhode Island, two Irish-American brothers take opposite paths, one a rising state politician and the other a career criminal, yet their family ties keep drawing their worlds together.

rs-wolf-hall-the-mirror-and-the-light-20.plot: After the execution of Anne Boleyn, Thomas Cromwell reaches the height of his power as Henry VIII's chief minister, but royal marriages, rebellion and his enemies at court start to close in on him.
rs-wolf-hall-the-mirror-and-the-light-20.source: The Mirror & the Light by Hilary Mantel

rs-winston-churchill-the-wilderness-year.plot: Out of office and dismissed as a has-been through the 1930s, Winston Churchill warns against the rise of Nazi Germany and Britain's policy of appeasement, until events vindicate him on the eve of the Second World War.

rs-the-roosevelts-an-intimate-history-20.plot: Ken Burns traces the lives of Theodore, Franklin and Eleanor Roosevelt across a century of American history. Archival footage and letters show how the three shaped modern America.

rs-the-wilds-2020.plot: A group of teenage girls from very different backgrounds is stranded on a remote island after a plane crash, unaware their ordeal is part of a secret social experiment; flashbacks reveal the lives and secrets they left behind.

rs-picnic-at-hanging-rock-2018.plot: On Valentine's Day 1900, three schoolgirls and a governess from a strict Victorian boarding school vanish during a picnic at Hanging Rock, and the mystery unravels the lives of everyone connected to them.
rs-picnic-at-hanging-rock-2018.source: Picnic at Hanging Rock by Joan Lindsay

rs-what-s-my-line-1950.plot: A panel of blindfolded-when-needed celebrities questions contestants with unusual occupations, trying to guess their line of work through yes-or-no questions, while a famous Mystery Guest tries to fool them with disguised voices.

rs-match-game-1962.plot: Host Gene Rayburn runs a daytime game show in which two teams, each with a celebrity captain, try to match one another's written answers to simple questions and fill-in-the-blank prompts.

rs-hollywood-squares-1966.plot: Two contestants play tic-tac-toe on a giant board of nine celebrities, deciding whether each star's answer to host Peter Marshall's question is true or a quip-laden bluff.

rs-banshee-2013.plot: An ex-con and master thief takes on the identity of a murdered man and becomes sheriff of a small Pennsylvania Amish-country town. He hunts criminals while dodging the gangster he once betrayed.

rs-love-death-robots-2019.plot: An adult animated anthology of short films spanning science fiction, fantasy, horror and comedy, each episode told in a different animation style by a different creative team.

rs-animaniacs-1993.plot: Zany Warner siblings Yakko, Wakko and Dot escape their water tower on the Warner Bros. lot to cause chaos, headlining a fast-paced cartoon revue alongside segments like Pinky and the Brain, packed with songs, parody and pop-culture gags.

setting.place: Warner Bros. studio lot, Burbank, USA

rs-the-rocky-and-bullwinkle-show-1959.plot: Plucky flying squirrel Rocky and dim-witted moose Bullwinkle foil Cold War spies Boris and Natasha in punning cliffhanger serials, alongside segments like Peabody's Improbable History, Fractured Fairy Tales and Dudley Do-Right.

rs-the-ren-stimpy-show-1991.plot: Psychotic, short-tempered chihuahua Ren Höek and his dim-witted, good-natured cat pal Stimpy stumble through grotesque, surreal misadventures packed with gross-out humor, extreme close-ups and parody commercials.

rs-sesame-street-1969.plot: On a friendly New York City street, human neighbors and Muppets like Big Bird, Elmo, Cookie Monster and Oscar the Grouch teach preschoolers letters, numbers and social skills through songs, sketches and short films. The most influential children's educational program ever made.

rs-daniel-tiger-s-neighborhood-2012.plot: Preschooler Daniel Tiger, son of the original Mister Rogers puppet, explores the Neighborhood of Make-Believe with family and friends. Each story teaches a simple social-emotional lesson through a catchy song.

rs-reading-rainbow-1983.plot: LeVar Burton invites children to discover the joy of books, pairing a featured picture book read aloud with field trips and real-world segments on its themes, plus kids reviewing their favorite titles.

rs-the-joy-of-painting-1983.plot: Soft-spoken painter Bob Ross completes a landscape in oils in each half-hour episode using his wet-on-wet technique, encouraging viewers that anyone can paint and that there are no mistakes, only happy accidents.

rs-pee-wee-s-playhouse-1986.plot: Childlike Pee-wee Herman hosts Saturday-morning fun in his surreal, talking-furniture-filled Playhouse, welcoming quirky friends like Captain Carl, Miss Yvonne and Cowboy Curtis, with puppets, cartoons, secret words and life lessons.

rs-the-kids-in-the-hall-1988.plot: Canada's five-man comedy troupe performs surreal, dark and often cross-dressing sketches featuring recurring oddballs like the Head Crusher, Buddy Cole and the Chicken Lady, poking at office life, suburbia and social norms.

rs-mr-show-with-bob-and-david-1995.plot: Bob Odenkirk and David Cross host an absurdist sketch-comedy show in which every sketch flows into the next through surreal transitions, mixing live stage pieces with filmed segments.

rs-the-young-ones-1982.plot: Four mismatched students, an anarchist, a would-be revolutionary poet, a hippie and a suave wide boy, share a squalid London house in this anarchic alternative comedy full of surreal tangents, violence and live band performances.

rs-el-chapulin-colorado-1973.plot: A clumsy, cowardly but well-meaning superhero in a red grasshopper costume answers calls for help armed with his squeaky mallet and antennae, bungling his way to saving the day. Roberto Gómez Bolaños's beloved parody of superhero tropes.

rs-chespirito-1980.plot: Roberto Gómez Bolaños's comedy hour gathers his beloved characters and sketches, including El Chavo del Ocho, El Chapulín Colorado, Los Caquitos and Doctor Chapatín, performed by his longtime troupe of comic actors.

rs-la-familia-p-luche-2002.plot: In the city of Ciudad Godínez, hapless father Ludovico P. Luche, his loud wife Federica and their odd children live a chaotic, absurd family life full of insults, schemes and running gags.

rs-the-great-war-1964.plot: A landmark 26-part documentary marking the 50th anniversary of World War I, combining archive footage, eyewitness testimony from veterans and narration by Michael Redgrave to trace the conflict from its origins to the armistice.

rs-one-foot-in-the-grave-1990.plot: Forcibly retired security guard Victor Meldrew rails against the absurdities of modern life, disasters befalling him at every turn, while his long-suffering wife Margaret endures his rage and their exasperated neighbors.

rs-keeping-up-appearances-1990.plot: Snobbish social climber Hyacinth Bucket ("it's pronounced Bouquet") tirelessly tries to impress her neighbors with candlelight suppers, while hiding her working-class sisters and her lovably uncouth brother-in-law Onslow.

rs-the-caesars-1968.plot: A Granada drama tracing the intrigues of the early Roman Empire, from the aging Augustus's search for an heir through the reigns of Tiberius and Caligula to the unlikely rise of Claudius, as plots, poisonings and ambition shape the imperial family.

rs-the-borgias-2011.plot: In 1492 Rodrigo Borgia bribes his way to the papacy as Pope Alexander VI, then uses his children, ruthless Cesare and Lucrezia, to cement the family's power through murder, seduction and political alliances amid enemies in Renaissance Italy.

rs-are-you-being-served-1972.plot: The staff of the ladies' and gentlemen's clothing department at Grace Brothers, a fading London department store, bicker over status, sales and innuendo under the eye of their pompous floorwalker and the ancient 'Young Mr. Grace'.

rs-kim-s-convenience-2016.plot: The Kim family, Korean-Canadian immigrants, run a convenience store in Toronto's Moss Park, where stubborn but loving 'Appa', his wife and their adult children navigate customers, community and generational clashes.

rs-connections-1978.plot: Science historian James Burke shows how modern inventions emerged from unexpected chains of earlier discoveries and events, jumping across centuries and continents to link medieval innovations to the technology of the twentieth century.

rs-the-ascent-of-man-1973.plot: Mathematician and humanist Jacob Bronowski traces the development of science and human understanding from early tools and agriculture through astronomy, physics and genetics, filmed at locations around the world.

rs-wonders-of-the-solar-system-2010.plot: Physicist Brian Cox travels to striking locations on Earth to explain the forces that shape the Sun, planets and moons, from solar eclipses and Martian dust storms to the icy moons where life might exist.

rs-the-new-statesman-1987.plot: Alan B'Stard, a monstrously greedy and amoral Conservative MP, schemes, bribes and blackmails his way to power in Thatcher-era Westminster, in a vicious political satire.

rs-spitting-image-1984.plot: Grotesque latex caricature puppets of politicians, royals and celebrities star in savage satirical sketches and song parodies skewering British and world public life, from Thatcher's cabinet to Hollywood stars.

rs-porridge-1974.plot: Habitual criminal Norman Stanley Fletcher serves his sentence at HMP Slade, using wit and cunning to make prison life bearable, mentoring naive young cellmate Lennie Godber and sparring with hard-line warder Mr. Mackay.

rs-minder-1979.plot: Ex-boxer Terry McCann works as a bodyguard, or 'minder', for Arthur Daley, a wheeler-dealer forever chasing dodgy deals on the fringes of London's underworld, with Arthur's schemes usually landing Terry in trouble.

rs-the-case-book-of-sherlock-holmes-1991.plot: Sherlock Holmes and Dr. Watson take on six late cases from Arthur Conan Doyle's stories in Victorian London and the English countryside, part of Granada's long-running adaptations starring Jeremy Brett.
rs-the-case-book-of-sherlock-holmes-1991.source: Sherlock Holmes stories by Arthur Conan Doyle

rs-das-boot-2018.plot: In 1942, a young German U-boat crew sets out on a dangerous Atlantic patrol, while in occupied La Rochelle a French-German translator is drawn into the Resistance, with both stories exploring loyalty and survival.
rs-das-boot-2018.source: Das Boot by Lothar-Günther Buchheim (sequel to the 1981 film)

rs-horrible-histories-2009.plot: A children's sketch comedy that presents the gory, gross and silly side of history, from the Romans to the Victorians, through comic sketches, pop-song parodies and spoof TV formats, hosted by a talking rat puppet.

rs-ghosts-2019.plot: Young couple Alison and Mike inherit a crumbling country mansion only to find it crowded with ghosts from across history, whom only Alison can see after a near-death accident, as they try to turn it into a business.

rs-yu-yu-hakusho-1992.plot: Delinquent teen Yusuke Urameshi dies saving a child, earns a second chance at life and becomes a Spirit Detective, investigating supernatural cases and battling powerful demons in martial-arts tournaments alongside his allies.

setting.place: Japan and the Spirit and Demon Worlds

rs-dragon-ball-daima-2024.plot: After a conspiracy turns Goku and his friends into children, they travel to the mysterious Demon Realm to find the Dragon Balls there and undo the wish, uncovering a plot by its rulers.

rs-saint-seiya-1986.plot: Orphaned teen Seiya earns the Pegasus Cloth armor and joins fellow Bronze Saints to protect the reincarnated goddess Athena, battling the far stronger Gold Saints of the Sanctuary and other divine foes through sheer willpower.

rs-jeeves-and-wooster-1990.plot: Amiable, dim-witted aristocrat Bertie Wooster stumbles into romantic entanglements and schemes of meddling aunts and friends in 1920s-30s England and New York, rescued every time by his brilliant valet Jeeves.
rs-jeeves-and-wooster-1990.source: Jeeves stories by P. G. Wodehouse

setting.place: London, English country houses and New York

rs-shri-krishna-1993.plot: A devotional epic retelling the life of the Hindu deity Krishna, from his miraculous birth and playful childhood in Vrindavan to his role as guide and statesman in the events of the Mahabharata.

rs-siya-ke-ram-2015.plot: A retelling of the Ramayana from the perspective of Sita, following her life from childhood through marriage to Prince Ram, exile, abduction by the demon king Ravan and the war that follows.

rs-devon-ke-dev-mahadev-2011.plot: A mythological drama retelling the legends of the Hindu god Shiva, from his marriage to Sati and union with Parvati to the stories of their sons Ganesha and Kartikeya and his battles with demons.

rs-star-trek-deep-space-nine-1993.plot: Commander Benjamin Sisko takes charge of a former Cardassian space station beside a newly discovered wormhole, where diplomacy, religion and intrigue escalate into a galaxy-wide war with the Dominion.

rs-chanakya-1991.plot: An epic historical drama following the strategist and teacher Chanakya as he vows revenge on the Nanda dynasty, unites fractious kingdoms against foreign invaders and helps Chandragupta Maurya found the Maurya Empire.

rs-bharat-ek-khoj-1988.plot: Shyam Benegal's docudrama adaptation of Jawaharlal Nehru's The Discovery of India dramatizes 5,000 years of Indian history, from the Indus Valley and the epics through empires and colonial rule to independence, framed by Nehru's narration.
rs-bharat-ek-khoj-1988.source: The Discovery of India by Jawaharlal Nehru

rs-mystery-science-theater-3000-the-retu.plot: A new host is trapped on a moon base by mad scientist Kinga Forrester and forced to watch terrible old movies, which he and his wisecracking robot pals survive by riffing them mercilessly.

rs-space-ghost-coast-to-coast-1994.plot: The 1960s cartoon superhero Space Ghost hosts a surreal late-night talk show from space, awkwardly interviewing real celebrities while tormented by his captive bandleader Zorak and producer Moltar.

rs-scenes-from-a-marriage-1973.plot: Over a decade, seemingly happy Swedish couple Johan and Marianne face infidelity, separation and divorce, yet remain bound to each other. Ingmar Bergman's intimate six-part study of love and marriage, later cut into a feature film.

rs-berlin-alexanderplatz-1980.plot: Released from prison after killing his girlfriend, Franz Biberkopf vows to live honestly in late-1920s Berlin, but poverty, betrayal and his toxic friendship with the criminal Reinhold drag him back down. Rainer Werner Fassbinder's epic adaptation of Alfred Döblin's novel.

rs-heimat-1984.plot: Spanning six decades, this epic chronicles the Simon family and their neighbors in the fictional Hunsrück village of Schabbach, as war, Nazism, economic change and modernity transform rural German life from 1919 to 1982.

rs-dragon-ball-super-2015.plot: After defeating Majin Buu, Goku and his friends face new threats from across the multiverse, including the God of Destruction Beerus, a resurrected Frieza and a tournament where entire universes fight for survival.

rs-my-hero-academia-2016.plot: In a world where most people have superpowers called Quirks, powerless Izuku Midoriya inherits the abilities of the greatest hero, All Might, and enrolls at U.A. High School to train as a professional hero against rising villains.
rs-my-hero-academia-2016.source: My Hero Academia by Kohei Horikoshi

rs-king-of-the-hill-1997.plot: Propane salesman Hank Hill tries to uphold traditional values in the Texas suburb of Arlen while dealing with his family, neighbors and beer-drinking alley buddies; a Hulu revival picks up years later.

rs-mr-bean-the-animated-series-2002.plot: The bumbling, nearly wordless Mr. Bean, his beloved Teddy and his Mini get into silly misadventures around town, often to the annoyance of his grumpy landlady Mrs. Wicket and her cat.

rs-shaun-the-sheep-2007.plot: Clever sheep Shaun leads his flock into wordless, slapstick mischief on Mossy Bottom Farm, always trying to keep their antics hidden from the Farmer and his sheepdog Bitzer.

rs-bottom-1991.plot: Unemployed, sex-starved and deluded flatmates Richie and Eddie live in squalor in Hammersmith, pursuing doomed schemes and inflicting extreme slapstick violence on each other.

rs-baseball-1994.plot: Ken Burns traces the history of American baseball from its 19th-century origins through the modern era, using archival footage, photographs and interviews to show how the game mirrored race, labor and national identity.

rs-reconstruction-america-after-the-civi.plot: Henry Louis Gates Jr. examines the period after the American Civil War when formerly enslaved people gained rights and political power, and the violent backlash and Jim Crow laws that rolled back those gains.

rs-the-kingdom-1994.plot: Strange supernatural events plague the neurosurgical ward of Copenhagen's largest hospital, where an arrogant Swedish consultant, a hypochondriac spiritualist patient and bickering staff stumble on a ghostly mystery.

rs-eerie-indiana-1991.plot: After moving from New Jersey to a seemingly ordinary suburban town, teenager Marshall Teller and his friend Simon investigate the bizarre phenomena only they notice, from Elvis living on a paper route to sinister Tupperware.

rs-wayward-pines-2015.plot: Secret Service agent Ethan Burke wakes up after a car crash in an idyllic Idaho town where nobody is allowed to leave, and uncovers a startling truth about the town and what lies beyond its fences.
rs-wayward-pines-2015.source: Wayward Pines trilogy by Blake Crouch

rs-superman-the-animated-series-1996.plot: Clark Kent, a reporter for the Daily Planet, protects Metropolis as Superman, contending with Lex Luthor, Brainiac and Darkseid while discovering his Kryptonian heritage.

rs-gargoyles-1994.plot: A clan of medieval Scottish gargoyles, frozen in stone for a thousand years, awakens atop a Manhattan skyscraper and takes up the role of nighttime protectors of New York, aided by a police detective.

rs-the-spectacular-spider-man-2008.plot: High-schooler Peter Parker balances homework, friendships and a part-time photography job with his secret life as Spider-Man, facing a growing gallery of villains in his first year as a hero, while a mysterious crime lord pulls strings behind the scenes.

rs-selfie-2015.plot: A Ramadan comedy series of mostly standalone episodes in which Nasser Al-Qasabi and an ensemble satirize Saudi and Gulf society, tackling extremism, sectarianism, bureaucracy and social customs; its jabs at ISIS drew wide attention.

rs-masameer-county-2021.plot: An adult animated comedy set in a fictional Saudi neighborhood, where an ensemble of eccentric locals stumbles into absurd schemes that satirize modern Saudi society, social change and pop culture.

rs-maraya-1982.plot: A long-running Syrian satirical sketch show in which Yasser Al-Azma plays a different character in each self-contained episode, holding a mirror up to everyday Arab life, bureaucracy, social hypocrisy and politics.

rs-millennium-1996.plot: Former FBI profiler Frank Black, who can see into the minds of killers, works with the shadowy Millennium Group to investigate serial murders and apocalyptic threats as the year 2000 approaches.

rs-supernatural-2005.plot: Brothers Sam and Dean Winchester drive across America in a 1967 Impala hunting demons, ghosts and monsters, following their father's trail and eventually confronting angels, Lucifer and God himself.

rs-sailor-moon-1992.plot: Clumsy schoolgirl Usagi Tsukino learns from a talking cat that she is Sailor Moon, a magical warrior destined to protect Earth, and gathers fellow Sailor Guardians to battle dark forces while uncovering their past lives.

rs-moone-boy-2012.plot: A dreamy 12-year-old boy in late-1980s Ireland navigates family life with three older sisters, guided by his grown-up imaginary friend. Small-town adventures mix with childhood fantasies.

rs-the-league-of-gentlemen-1999.plot: Dark, grotesque comedy set in the fictional northern English town of Royston Vasey, whose residents include a murderous local-shop couple, a sinister circus and a vet who kills every animal he treats.

rs-serial-experiments-lain-1998.plot: After a classmate's suicide, withdrawn schoolgirl Lain Iwakura is drawn into the Wired, a global network, where the boundary between the digital and real worlds and her own identity begins to dissolve.

rs-mobile-suit-gundam-1979.plot: In the year Universal Century 0079, a space colony's war of independence against the Earth Federation pulls teenage civilian Amuro Ray into piloting the experimental Gundam robot, as he and the young crew of the warship White Base struggle to survive. The foundational 'real robot' anime.

rs-gurren-lagann-2007.plot: Timid digger Simon and the brash Kamina break out of their underground village and, piloting a mecha they find, lead humanity's ever-escalating rebellion against the Spiral King and beyond.

rs-emma-2009.plot: Handsome, clever and rich, Emma Woodhouse is sure she has a gift for matchmaking, but her meddling in the romances of Highbury, especially her friend Harriet's, goes repeatedly wrong, while her old friend Mr. Knightley looks on. An adaptation of Austen's novel.

rs-sense-and-sensibility-2008.plot: After their father's death leaves them nearly penniless, sensible Elinor Dashwood and passionate Marianne move with their mother to a Devon cottage, where both sisters face heartbreak and hidden attachments on the way to love. Andrew Davies adapts Austen's novel.

rs-mccartney-3-2-1-2021.plot: Paul McCartney sits down with producer Rick Rubin at the mixing desk to dissect songs from the Beatles, Wings and his solo career, isolating tracks and reminiscing about how the music was written and recorded.

rs-claymore-2007.plot: In a medieval land plagued by shape-shifting demons called Yoma, half-human warrior women known as Claymores hunt them for hire; one of them, Clare, travels with a boy whose family the Yoma killed, seeking revenge.

rs-dororo-2019.plot: In feudal Japan, a lord trades his newborn son's body parts to demons for prosperity; the boy, Hyakkimaru, grows up to hunt those demons to reclaim his body, joined by a young orphan thief named Dororo.

rs-devilman-crybaby-2018.plot: Gentle teenager Akira Fudo merges with a demon at the urging of his enigmatic friend Ryo, becoming Devilman, a being with a demon's powers and a human heart, as a demon war engulfs humanity.

rs-the-day-today-1994.plot: A savage parody of television news, with pompous anchor Chris Morris presiding over absurd reports, bogus graphics and incompetent correspondents that skewer the conventions of current-affairs broadcasting.

rs-look-around-you-2002.plot: A deadpan parody of earnest British schools science programmes of the late 1970s and early 1980s, presenting absurd 'facts' and experiments with straight-faced authority; the second series spoofs a 1980s science magazine show.

rs-da-ali-g-show-2000.plot: Sacha Baron Cohen interviews real, unsuspecting politicians, experts and celebrities in the guise of clueless wannabe gangster Ali G, Kazakh reporter Borat and gay Austrian fashionista Brüno.

rs-knowing-me-knowing-you-with-alan-part.plot: Spoof chat show in which socially inept, self-regarding broadcaster Alan Partridge interviews a parade of fictional guests, invariably offending them and sending the program into chaos.

rs-toast-of-london-2012.plot: Steven Toast, a pompous, middle-aged actor with a booming voice, struggles through humiliating voice-over jobs and stage flops in London. His feud with a rival actor and his agent's indifference make things worse.

rs-locked-up-2015.plot: Macarena, a naive young woman manipulated into committing fraud by her boss and lover, is sent to a women's prison where she must learn to survive among dangerous inmates and power struggles.

rs-beavis-and-butt-head-1993.plot: Two dim-witted, heavy-metal-loving teenage slackers snicker their way through aimless misadventures, dead-end fast-food shifts and failed attempts to score, while mocking the music videos they watch from their couch.

rs-robot-chicken-2005.plot: A rapid-fire stop-motion sketch show that uses action figures and toys to parody pop culture, from superheroes and Star Wars to cartoons, commercials and celebrities.

rs-trigun-1998.plot: Vash the Stampede, a legendary gunman with a huge bounty on his head, turns out to be a goofy pacifist, as two insurance agents trail him across a desert planet and uncover the dark secret of his past.

rs-ghost-in-the-shell-stand-alone-comple.plot: In a cybernetically enhanced future Japan, Major Motoko Kusanagi and the covert counter-cyberterrorism unit Public Security Section 9 investigate hackers, corruption and the elusive 'Laughing Man'.
rs-ghost-in-the-shell-stand-alone-comple.source: The Ghost in the Shell by Masamune Shirow

rs-lazarus-2025.plot: In 2052, a miracle painkiller turns out to be a time bomb that will kill everyone who took it in three years. A task force of misfits, led by a prison-breaking daredevil, races to find the drug's vanished creator and the cure.

rs-whose-line-is-it-anyway-1988.plot: Host Clive Anderson sets improvised games for a panel of four comedians, who make up scenes, songs and characters on the spot from audience suggestions, with points that famously don't matter.

rs-would-i-lie-to-you-2007.plot: A British comedy panel show in which two teams of celebrities read out embarrassing personal claims, and their opponents must interrogate them to decide whether each story is true or a lie. Team captains David Mitchell and Lee Mack trade barbs under a genial host.

rs-middleditch-schwartz-2020.plot: Comedians Thomas Middleditch and Ben Schwartz perform three hour-long, completely improvised comedy shows, building elaborate stories from a single prompt given by an audience member.

rs-undeclared-2001.plot: Awkward freshman Steven Karp tries to reinvent himself at a California university, navigating dorm life, parties and his crush on Lizzie alongside a group of equally lost new friends.

rs-one-piece-2023.plot: Rubber-bodied young pirate Monkey D. Luffy sets out to find the legendary treasure One Piece and become King of the Pirates, gathering a crew of misfits as they battle Marines and rival pirates across the seas.

setting.place: East Blue and the Grand Line

rs-fairy-tail-2009.plot: Celestial wizard Lucy Heartfilia joins Fairy Tail, a rowdy wizards' guild, teaming with fire Dragon Slayer Natsu Dragneel and his flying cat Happy. Taking on jobs and battling dark guilds, the friends grow into a family facing ever larger threats.

rs-bleach-2004.plot: Teenager Ichigo Kurosaki, who can see ghosts, gains the powers of a Soul Reaper and must protect the living from malevolent spirits called Hollows, drawing him into the politics of the afterlife.

setting.place: Karakura Town, Japan and Soul Society

rs-the-mighty-boosh-2004.plot: Self-styled jazz-loving Howard Moon and vain glam-rock dreamer Vince Noir drift from a run-down zoo to a flat above a junk shop, stumbling into surreal adventures with talking animals, shamans and musical numbers.

rs-ray-donovan-2013.plot: Ray Donovan is a 'fixer' who makes the scandals of Los Angeles's rich and famous disappear. His own family is harder to fix, especially after his volatile father gets out of prison.

rs-cold-feet-1997.plot: Three couples in Manchester navigate love, marriage, parenthood and middle age, from the first sparks of romance to divorces and reunions, in a bittersweet comedy-drama that returned years later.

rs-megalo-box-2018.plot: In a future where boxers fight with mechanical gear, an underground fighter who rigs matches for a gangster renames himself Joe and sets out to compete in Megalonia, a grand tournament for elite gear-assisted boxers.

rs-ashita-no-joe-1970.plot: Joe Yabuki, a reckless drifter from Tokyo's slums, is taken in by washed-up trainer Danpei Tange and discovers a fierce talent for boxing, forging a fateful rivalry with the formidable Toru Rikiishi. Adapted from the classic boxing manga; the story continued in a 1980 sequel series.

rs-slam-dunk-1993.plot: Hot-headed delinquent Hanamichi Sakuragi joins his high school basketball team to impress a girl, and slowly discovers a genuine passion and talent for the game as Shohoku chases a national title.

rs-combat-1962.plot: Sergeant Chip Saunders and Lieutenant Gil Hanley lead an American infantry squad fighting their way across France after D-Day, facing German forces and the moral costs of war in gritty, character-driven stories.

rs-teen-titans-2003.plot: Robin leads a team of young superheroes, Starfire, Raven, Cyborg and Beast Boy, who live in a T-shaped tower and battle villains like Slade while dealing with friendship and growing up.

rs-avengers-earth-s-mightiest-heroes-201.plot: After a mass supervillain breakout, Iron Man, Thor, Hulk, Ant-Man and Wasp band together as the Avengers, later joined by Captain America and others, to face threats from Loki and Kang to a secret Skrull invasion, in a comics-faithful animated series.

setting.place: New York City and Marvel Universe

rs-star-wars-clone-wars-2003.plot: Between Attack of the Clones and Revenge of the Sith, Jedi Knights including Anakin Skywalker, Obi-Wan Kenobi and Mace Windu lead clone armies against the Separatists, General Grievous and Asajj Ventress.

setting.period: A long time ago (Clone Wars era)

rs-castlevania-2017.plot: After his human wife is burned as a witch, Dracula unleashes a demonic army on Wallachia. Disgraced monster hunter Trevor Belmont teams up with a sorceress and Dracula's own half-human son to stop him.

rs-afro-samurai-2007.plot: In a futuristic feudal Japan, the samurai Afro carves a bloody path toward the warrior who killed his father and holds the Number One headband, the key to godlike power.

rs-dead-like-me-2003.plot: After being killed by a falling toilet seat from a space station, sardonic 18-year-old George becomes a grim reaper in Seattle, collecting souls alongside a ragtag crew while watching her grieving family from afar.

rs-seven-worlds-one-planet-2019.plot: Narrated by David Attenborough, each episode explores one of Earth's seven continents, revealing how its unique landscapes and history shaped the wildlife living there and the threats it faces.

rs-the-hunt-2015.plot: A nature documentary series narrated by David Attenborough that looks at predators and their prey across different habitats, focusing on the strategies and frequent failures of the hunt rather than just the kill.

rs-life-on-earth-1979.plot: David Attenborough traces the evolution of life on Earth, from the first single cells through plants, insects, fish, amphibians, reptiles, birds and mammals to humans, filmed across the globe. The first of his landmark 'Life' natural-history series.

rs-people-just-do-nothing-2014.plot: A mockumentary about a group of deluded MCs and DJs running a pirate garage-radio station from a council estate in west London. They chase fame while barely managing day-to-day life.
rs-people-just-do-nothing-2014.source: People Just Do Nothing (YouTube web series)

rs-letterkenny-2016.plot: In a small rural Ontario town, hick farmhands Wayne, Daryl and Squirrely Dan trade rapid-fire banter and scuffle with the town's hockey players, skids and Mennonites in a comedy built on wordplay and local feuds.

rs-corner-gas-2004.plot: In the tiny prairie town of Dog River, Saskatchewan, gas-station owner Brent Leroy and the eccentric locals pass the time with deadpan banter, petty feuds and small-town nonsense.

rs-eastbound-down-2009.plot: Kenny Powers, a crude, egotistical former MLB pitcher whose career imploded, returns to his North Carolina hometown to teach middle-school gym. Convinced of his own greatness, he schemes for a comeback while leaving chaos everywhere he goes.

setting.place: Shelby, North Carolina / Mexico / Myrtle Beach

rs-farscape-1999.plot: Astronaut John Crichton is flung through a wormhole into a distant galaxy, where he joins a band of escaped alien prisoners aboard a living ship, pursued by the militaristic Peacekeepers.

rs-killjoys-2015.plot: Three interplanetary bounty hunters, known as killjoys, take warrants across a planetary system called the Quad, while getting drawn into a class war and a mysterious threat from the elusive Lady.

rs-grantchester-2014.plot: In a village near Cambridge in the 1950s, an Anglican vicar teams up with a gruff police inspector to solve local murders. Later series pass the collar to new vicars as the partnership and the period move on.
rs-grantchester-2014.source: The Grantchester Mysteries by James Runcie

rs-chewin-the-fat-1999.plot: A Scottish sketch show featuring a gallery of recurring characters, from lighthouse keepers and pub regulars to gossiping Glasgow neds, poking fun at everyday Scottish life.

rs-last-of-the-summer-wine-1973.plot: A trio of retired men in a Yorkshire village spend their days wandering the hills, reminiscing and getting into gentle, childlike scrapes, while the formidable local women look on. The longest-running sitcom in British television history.

rs-the-chicago-code-2011.plot: Teresa Colvin, Chicago's first female police superintendent, and her former partner Jarek Wysocki form a task force to bring down corrupt, powerful alderman Ronin Gibbons, while tackling crime in the city.

rs-rescue-me-2004.plot: Hard-drinking New York firefighter Tommy Gavin, haunted by the ghosts of colleagues lost on 9/11, battles survivor's guilt, a crumbling family and the dark humor of his firehouse crew.

rs-james-may-our-man-in-japan-2020.plot: Former Top Gear host James May travels the length of Japan, from Hokkaido to Kyushu, sampling its food, culture, traditions and quirks with his typically dry, curious humor.

rs-long-way-down-2007.plot: Ewan McGregor and Charley Boorman ride motorcycles from the northern tip of Scotland through Europe and the length of Africa to Cape Town, meeting locals and charity projects along the way.

setting.place: John o' Groats to Cape Town

rs-jay-leno-s-garage-2015.plot: Car enthusiast Jay Leno explores automotive culture, showing off vehicles from his own huge collection, meeting celebrity and everyday car lovers, and testing everything from classic muscle cars to modern supercars.

rs-party-down-2009.plot: A team of struggling actors, writers and dreamers works for a Los Angeles catering company, serving a different party each episode while nursing failed Hollywood ambitions. The 2023 revival reunites the crew years later.

rs-caprica-2010.plot: Fifty-eight years before Battlestar Galactica, tech tycoon Daniel Graystone and lawyer Joseph Adama are bound by tragedy when their families die in a terrorist bombing. Graystone's attempt to resurrect his daughter's digital avatar leads to the creation of the first Cylon.

setting.period: Fictional (58 years before the fall of the Colonies)

rs-babylon-5-1993.plot: In the 2250s, a five-mile-long space station serves as a neutral diplomatic hub for humans and alien races, and its commanders become central to a galactic war against an ancient, awakening darkness, in a story planned as a five-year arc.

rs-key-peele-2012.plot: Keegan-Michael Key and Jordan Peele perform short comedy sketches built on characters, pop culture and race. Studio-audience segments link the pre-taped pieces.

rs-i-think-you-should-leave-with-tim-rob.plot: A rapid-fire sketch comedy in which Tim Robinson and guests play people who double down on their awkward social mistakes, escalating everyday situations into surreal, uncomfortable chaos.

rs-in-living-color-1990.plot: Keenen Ivory Wayans's edgy sketch comedy showcase lampoons pop culture, race and celebrities with characters like Fire Marshal Bill and the Men on Film critics, plus the Fly Girls dance troupe and hip-hop performances.

rs-fresh-meat-2011.plot: Six mismatched first-year students share a house at a Manchester university, stumbling through lectures, parties, hook-ups and identity crises over their student years, from posh JP to sweet, insecure Josie and Kingsley.

rs-friday-night-dinner-2011.plot: Adult brothers Adam and Jonny return to their North London family home every Friday for a Jewish Shabbat dinner with their eccentric parents, a ritual that dissolves into pranks, sibling torment and the unwanted visits of their strange neighbour Jim.

rs-mock-the-week-2005.plot: Host Dara Ó Briain and two teams of stand-up comedians riff on the week's news through improvised rounds such as 'Scenes We'd Like to See', mixing topical satire with quick-fire jokes.

rs-have-i-got-news-for-you-1990.plot: Team captains Ian Hislop and Paul Merton, with guest panelists and a host, compete in a satirical news quiz that lampoons the week's headlines, politicians and celebrities.

rs-harvey-birdman-attorney-at-law-2000.plot: Retired 1960s superhero Birdman becomes a lawyer at an absurd firm, defending Hanna-Barbera cartoon characters in bizarre cases while his boss Phil Ken Sebben and nemesis Reducto make things worse.

rs-jonny-quest-1964.plot: Eleven-year-old Jonny Quest joins his scientist father Dr. Benton Quest, bodyguard Race Bannon, friend Hadji and dog Bandit on globe-trotting adventures against villains, monsters and mysteries.

rs-sealab-2021-2000.plot: Using recut footage from a 1970s Hanna-Barbera cartoon, this absurd comedy follows the incompetent, bickering crew of an underwater research station who keep causing disasters and blowing it up.

rs-stargate-universe-2009.plot: After an attack on a secret base, a group of soldiers, scientists and civilians escapes through a Stargate onto Destiny, an ancient automated ship billions of light-years from Earth. Unable to return home, they struggle to survive and to work together.

rs-the-mentalist-2008.plot: Patrick Jane, a former fake psychic whose wife and daughter were murdered by serial killer Red John, consults for the California Bureau of Investigation. He uses sharp observation and manipulation to solve cases while hunting the man who destroyed his family.

rs-x-men-the-animated-series-1992.plot: Professor Charles Xavier's team of mutant heroes, including Wolverine, Cyclops, Storm, Rogue and Gambit, protect a world that fears them from Magneto, the Sentinels and cosmic threats, adapting classic Marvel comics storylines.

setting.place: Westchester, New York, USA and worldwide

rs-long-way-up-2020.plot: Ewan McGregor and Charley Boorman ride electric Harley-Davidson motorcycles 13,000 miles from the southern tip of Argentina through South and Central America to Los Angeles.

rs-anthony-bourdain-parts-unknown-2013.plot: Chef and writer Anthony Bourdain travels to places around the world, many off the usual tourist routes. Through food and conversations with locals he explores their culture, history and politics.

rs-around-the-world-in-80-days-1989.plot: Michael Palin attempts to recreate Phileas Fogg's fictional journey around the globe in 80 days without flying, traveling by train, ship, dhow and road and meeting people along the way in this humorous travelogue.

rs-psycho-pass-2012.plot: In a future Japan where a system scans people's minds to measure their likelihood of committing crimes, a rookie inspector joins a unit of enforcers. Hunting a charismatic criminal makes her question the system itself.

rs-master-keaton-1998.plot: Taichi Hiraga-Keaton, a mild-mannered archaeology lecturer and former SAS survival instructor, works as an insurance investigator across Europe, solving cases with his wits, knowledge and combat skills.

rs-paranoia-agent-2004.plot: Two detectives investigate a string of assaults in Tokyo by a boy on golden rollerblades wielding a bent bat, as each victim's story reveals a city full of people desperate to escape their pressures.

rs-rurouni-kenshin-1996.plot: In early Meiji-era Japan, a former legendary assassin wanders the land with a reverse-blade sword, vowing never to kill again while protecting the people of a Tokyo dojo from old enemies.

rs-mushi-shi-2005.plot: Ginko, a wandering 'Mushi master', travels through rural Japan of an imagined past helping people afflicted by mushi, primitive life forms whose strange powers can heal, haunt or harm.

rs-khichdi-2002.plot: The eccentric, bickering Gujarati Parekh family share a crumbling ancestral home in Mumbai, where dim-witted Praful, his wife Hansa and the rest of the clan stumble from one absurd misunderstanding to another.

rs-taarak-mehta-ka-ooltah-chashmah-2008.plot: The residents of Mumbai's Gokuldham Society, a housing complex of families from across India, get into everyday comic scrapes, with the bumbling businessman Jethalal Gada at the center and writer Taarak Mehta offering wisdom. A long-running family sitcom about community and harmony.
rs-taarak-mehta-ka-ooltah-chashmah-2008.source: Duniya Ne Undha Chashma (Taarak Mehta column)

rs-dekh-bhai-dekh-1993.plot: Three generations of the large, chaotic Diwan family share a Mumbai bungalow, with eccentric relatives, squabbles, romances and misunderstandings providing the comedy in this beloved Hindi family sitcom.

rs-the-legend-of-korra-2012.plot: Seventy years after Avatar Aang, the headstrong teenage Avatar Korra moves to the steampunk metropolis of Republic City to master airbending. She faces revolutionaries, spirits and political upheaval as she learns what the world needs from her.

rs-hilda-2018.plot: Fearless, blue-haired Hilda moves from the wilderness to the city of Trolberg, where she and her friends explore a world of trolls, elves, giants and spirits, solving magical problems with curiosity and kindness.
rs-hilda-2018.source: Hilda graphic novels by Luke Pearson

rs-the-dragon-prince-2018.plot: Two human princes and an elven assassin sent to kill them discover the egg of the Dragon Prince, thought destroyed, and set out to return it to its mother to end a long war between humans and magical beings.

rs-the-disastrous-life-of-saiki-k-2016.plot: High schooler Kusuo Saiki was born with every psychic power imaginable but just wants a quiet, normal life, which his eccentric classmates and family constantly make impossible.
rs-the-disastrous-life-of-saiki-k-2016.source: The Disastrous Life of Saiki K. by Shūichi Asō

rs-kaguya-sama-love-is-war-2019.plot: At an elite academy, student council president Miyuki Shirogane and vice president Kaguya Shinomiya are in love but too proud to confess, each scheming endlessly to make the other admit their feelings first.

rs-cromartie-high-school-2003.plot: A studious boy enrolls at a school for delinquents where the toughest students include a robot, a gorilla and a Freddie Mercury lookalike, and every tough-guy cliché is played for absurd deadpan comedy.
rs-cromartie-high-school-2003.source: Cromartie High School by Eiji Nonaka

rs-workaholics-2011.plot: Three slacker college dropouts share a house and a cubicle row at a suburban telemarketing company. Between shifts they chase parties, schemes and petty feuds, doing everything except actual work.

rs-the-league-2009.plot: A group of old friends in Chicago take their fantasy football league far too seriously, using trash talk, sabotage and elaborate pranks against one another while their personal lives and relationships suffer the fallout.

rs-mythic-quest-2020.plot: Ian Grimm, the egotistical creative director of the hugely popular online game Mythic Quest, clashes with his lead engineer Poppy and the rest of the dysfunctional studio team as they try to keep the game on top.

rs-black-dynamite-2012.plot: The kung-fu ex-CIA hero of the blaxploitation spoof continues his adventures in animated form. With his crew he battles absurd villains and 1970s pop-culture figures in outrageous, profane episodes.

rs-dear-white-people-2017.plot: Students of color at a predominantly white Ivy League college confront racism, identity politics and campus activism, sparked by a provocative radio show and a blackface party, with each episode often centering a different character.

rs-trial-error-2017.plot: A mockumentary about an idealistic young New York lawyer who takes on a murder case in a bizarre small Southern town, defending an eccentric local with the help of a hapless team.

rs-mobile-suit-gundam-iron-blooded-orpha.plot: On Mars, child soldiers led by Orga Itsuka and pilot Mikazuki Augus rebel against their employers and form the mercenary group Tekkadan, escorting a young political activist to Earth and fighting for a place in a harsh world.

rs-guilty-crown-2011.plot: In a near-future Tokyo under foreign control after a viral outbreak, shy student Shu Ouma gains the Power of Kings, the ability to draw weapons from people's hearts, and joins a resistance group led by the charismatic Gai and singer Inori.

rs-liar-game-2007.plot: Painfully honest college student Nao Kanzaki is dragged into a mysterious high-stakes tournament of deception and enlists a genius ex-con swindler to help her survive and expose the organizers.

rs-the-promised-neverland-2019.plot: Children at a seemingly idyllic orphanage discover that they are being raised as food for demons, and three gifted kids, Emma, Norman and Ray, plot a daring escape for themselves and their siblings.
rs-the-promised-neverland-2019.source: The Promised Neverland (Kaiu Shirai, Posuka Demizu)

rs-dexter-original-sin-2024.plot: In 1991 Miami, young Dexter Morgan finishes college and joins the police forensics department as an intern, while his father Harry teaches him the code that lets him channel his urge to kill into hunting other killers.

rs-planet-earth-iii-2023.plot: David Attenborough narrates the third Planet Earth series, showing animal behaviour across coasts, oceans, deserts, forests and cities, with a strong focus on how wildlife is adapting to a world changed by humans.

rs-dynasties-2018.plot: Nature documentary following individual animal families and leaders, such as a chimpanzee alpha, an emperor penguin colony, lions and tigers, over years as they fight to secure the future of their dynasties.

rs-red-dwarf-1988.plot: Slobbish technician Dave Lister wakes from stasis three million years after a radiation leak killed his crew, and drifts through deep space aboard the mining ship Red Dwarf with a hologram of his uptight bunkmate, a vain cat-humanoid and a neurotic android.

rs-wellington-paranormal-2018.plot: Two deadpan Wellington police officers, Minogue and O'Leary, are assigned to the force's secret paranormal unit, investigating ghosts, demons, aliens and other supernatural oddities around New Zealand's capital in mockumentary style.
rs-wellington-paranormal-2018.source: What We Do in the Shadows

rs-portlandia-2011.plot: Fred Armisen and Carrie Brownstein play a rotating cast of oddballs in a sketch comedy lampooning hipster culture in Portland, Oregon, from feminist bookstore owners to obsessive locavores and bike activists.

rs-halt-and-catch-fire-2014.plot: In early-1980s Texas, a visionary salesman, a brilliant engineer and a young coding prodigy reverse-engineer an IBM PC to build a rival. Over a decade they chase the personal-computer, online-gaming and internet revolutions.

rs-naruto-2002.plot: Naruto Uzumaki, a brash orphan ninja shunned for the demon fox sealed inside him, trains with his teammates Sasuke and Sakura to become Hokage, the strongest ninja and leader of his village.

rs-boruto-naruto-next-generations-2017.plot: Boruto, son of the Seventh Hokage Naruto Uzumaki, trains as a ninja in a modernizing Hidden Leaf Village, resenting his famous father while facing new threats tied to a mysterious mark on his hand.

rs-mayans-m-c-2018.plot: Ezekiel 'EZ' Reyes, a prospect in the Mayans motorcycle club charter on the US-Mexico border, gets caught between the club, a cartel, rebels and his own thirst for revenge, years after the events of Sons of Anarchy.

rs-animal-kingdom-2016.plot: After his mother's overdose, teenager Joshua 'J' Cody moves in with his grandmother Smurf and her sons, a Southern California crime family who live a hedonistic beach life funded by robberies.

rs-apocalypse-world-war-i-2014.plot: A five-part history of the First World War built from colorized and restored archival film. It covers the war's causes, its battles on several fronts and its toll on soldiers and civilians.

rs-apocalypse-hitler-2011.plot: Built from restored and colorized archive footage, this two-part documentary traces Adolf Hitler's life from childhood and the trenches of World War I to his rise to power and the outbreak of World War II.

rs-frisky-dingo-2006.plot: Supervillain Killface plots to hurl Earth into the sun but keeps getting sidetracked by mundane problems, while his nemesis, the vain billionaire Xander Crews alias Awesome X, is more interested in merchandising.

rs-revenge-2011.plot: Years after her father was framed for terrorism and died in prison, a young woman returns to the Hamptons under the name Emily Thorne to methodically destroy the wealthy Grayson family and everyone who betrayed him.
rs-revenge-2011.source: The Count of Monte Cristo (Alexandre Dumas, loosely)

rs-valley-of-the-wolves-2003.plot: A Turkish intelligence agent is given a new face and identity to infiltrate Istanbul's mafia from within, rising through its ranks while confronting betrayal and deep-state conspiracies.

rs-the-pit-2017.plot: Yamaç Koçovalı, the youngest son of a crime family that rules Istanbul's Çukur neighborhood, is forced back from his quiet new life to defend his family and district when rivals and drug dealers threaten it.

rs-fullmetal-alchemist-2003.plot: After a forbidden alchemy ritual to revive their mother costs Edward his limbs and his brother Alphonse his body, the Elric brothers search for the Philosopher's Stone to restore themselves.

rs-silver-spoon-2013.plot: A city boy escaping academic pressure enrolls at an agricultural high school in rural Hokkaido. Facing the realities of farm life and raising animals for food, he slowly finds friends and a sense of purpose.

rs-moribito-guardian-of-the-spirit-2007.plot: Wandering spear-wielding bodyguard Balsa is hired to protect a young prince whose father, the emperor, wants him dead because a mysterious water spirit has laid its egg inside the boy.
rs-moribito-guardian-of-the-spirit-2007.source: Moribito: Guardian of the Spirit by Nahoko Uehashi

rs-the-life-of-mammals-2002.plot: David Attenborough surveys the mammal world, from insect-eaters and gnawers to carnivores, sea mammals and primates, showing how each group has adapted to find food and survive.

rs-life-story-2014.plot: David Attenborough narrates the stages of animal life, from birth and growing up to courtship and parenthood. Close-up camerawork records how animals around the world survive each challenge.

rs-life-in-cold-blood-2008.plot: David Attenborough's survey of reptiles and amphibians, from frogs and salamanders to snakes, lizards, crocodiles and tortoises. Using new filming techniques, it reveals surprisingly complex courtship, parental care and hunting behavior in cold-blooded animals.

rs-steven-universe-2013.plot: A young boy who is half human, half alien Gem lives with three magical guardians, the Crystal Gems, in a seaside town. As he discovers his powers he learns his late mother's history and a galactic conflict around it.

rs-adventure-time-distant-lands-2020.plot: Four hour-long specials revisiting the world of Adventure Time, each focusing on different characters, including BMO in space, Bubblegum and Marceline's backstory, and Finn and Jake in the far future of Wizard City.

rs-the-midnight-gospel-2020.plot: Clancy, a spacecaster living in a trippy dimension called the Chromatic Ribbon, uses a malfunctioning universe simulator to visit dying worlds and interview their inhabitants; the conversations, drawn from real podcast interviews, explore death, meditation and meaning.

rs-bosch-2014.plot: LAPD homicide detective Harry Bosch pursues killers with stubborn integrity, often clashing with department politics. Each season mixes cases from Michael Connelly's novels with the detective's own past.
rs-bosch-2014.source: Harry Bosch novels by Michael Connelly

rs-spiral-2005.plot: Paris police captain Laure Berthaud and her team, alongside an ambitious lawyer, a principled prosecutor and an investigating judge, work grim murder cases through a gritty, compromised French justice system.

rs-ethos-2020.plot: Linked stories of people across Istanbul's social divides, centered on Meryem, a devout young housekeeper who sees a secular psychiatrist after fainting spells, reveal the tensions between Turkey's religious and secular, rich and poor.

rs-justified-city-primeval-2023.plot: Years after leaving Kentucky, U.S. Marshal Raylan Givens is pulled into a case in Detroit, where he hunts a violent, unpredictable career criminal known as the Oklahoma Wildman while clashing with a sharp defense attorney.

rs-maron-2013.plot: Comedian and podcaster Marc Maron plays a version of himself, a neurotic recovering addict working out of his garage. He wrestles with relationships, his career and his own self-sabotage.

rs-close-enough-2020.plot: Josh and Emily, a married couple in their thirties, share a Los Angeles duplex with their young daughter and two divorced roommates, where everyday struggles with adulthood spiral into surreal animated adventures.

rs-the-amazing-world-of-gumball-2011.plot: Twelve-year-old blue cat Gumball Watterson and his adopted goldfish brother Darwin cause chaos in the town of Elmore, with their genius sister Anais and their family. Mixing animation styles and live action, the show is known for its anarchic humor.

rs-chowder-2007.plot: Chowder, a hungry, scatterbrained young apprentice, trains under the eccentric chef Mung Daal in the food-obsessed Marzipan City, causing culinary chaos along the way.

rs-elementary-2012.plot: A recovering-addict Sherlock Holmes relocates to modern New York and consults for the NYPD. His sober companion, Dr. Joan Watson, gradually becomes his partner in solving cases.
rs-elementary-2012.source: Sherlock Holmes stories by Arthur Conan Doyle

rs-doctor-who-2005.plot: The Doctor, a time-travelling alien who regenerates into new forms, journeys through time and space in the TARDIS with human companions, battling Daleks, Cybermen and countless other threats.

rs-jekyll-2007.plot: Dr. Tom Jackman, a modern descendant of Dr. Jekyll, struggles to control his violent, charming alter ego Hyde while a shadowy corporation that has watched his family for generations closes in.
rs-jekyll-2007.source: Strange Case of Dr Jekyll and Mr Hyde by Robert Louis Stevenson

rs-the-great-pottery-throw-down-2015.plot: Amateur potters gather at a Stoke-on-Trent pottery to compete in weekly challenges, throwing, hand-building and decorating ceramics for expert judges, with one eliminated each week until a winner is crowned.

rs-the-great-british-sewing-bee-2013.plot: Talented amateur home sewers compete in pattern, alteration and made-to-measure challenges each week. Expert judges eliminate one sewer per episode until one is crowned Britain's best home sewer.

rs-salt-fat-acid-heat-2018.plot: Chef and writer Samin Nosrat travels to Italy, Japan, Mexico and her home kitchen in California to explore the four elements of good cooking, one per episode.
rs-salt-fat-acid-heat-2018.source: Salt, Fat, Acid, Heat by Samin Nosrat (cookbook)

rs-somebody-feed-phil-2018.plot: Everybody Loves Raymond creator Phil Rosenthal travels the world with boundless enthusiasm, sampling local food and culture in cities from Bangkok to Buenos Aires, often video-calling his family back home.

rs-the-elegant-universe-2003.plot: Physicist Brian Greene explains the quest for a theory of everything, from Newton and Einstein to quantum mechanics and string theory, using vivid animation and analogies.
rs-the-elegant-universe-2003.source: The Elegant Universe (book) by Brian Greene

rs-frozen-planet-ii-2022.plot: David Attenborough narrates a return to Earth's coldest regions, from the poles to high mountains and frozen forests, capturing the animals that live there and showing how rapid warming is transforming their habitats.

rs-life-in-the-freezer-1993.plot: David Attenborough guides viewers through a year in Antarctica and the surrounding Southern Ocean, showing how penguins, seals, whales and other wildlife survive the planet's harshest environment season by season.

rs-tribe-2005.plot: Explorer Bruce Parry lives for weeks with remote indigenous communities around the world, joining their rituals, work and daily life to show how they live and the pressures they face.

rs-jojo-s-bizarre-adventure-2012.plot: Across generations, members of the Joestar bloodline battle supernatural enemies, beginning with the vampire Dio Brando. Each part introduces a new JoJo hero and, later, psychic powers called Stands, in flamboyant, inventive fights.

rs-chainsaw-man-2022.plot: Denji, a destitute young man working off his late father's debt to the yakuza, merges with his devil-dog Pochita to become Chainsaw Man and is recruited into a government squad of devil hunters led by the enigmatic Makima.

rs-candid-camera-1948.plot: Hidden cameras capture ordinary people reacting to staged pranks and absurd situations, until the reveal: "Smile, you're on Candid Camera!" Allen Funt's pioneering hidden-camera show ran in many incarnations across several networks for decades.

rs-avrupa-yakas-2004.plot: Neighbours in a posh Istanbul apartment block, including a newly wealthy family from the provinces and their snobbish upper-class acquaintances, clash and bond in a satire of Turkish class pretensions.

rs-yalan-dunya-2012.plot: A comedy about a group of neighbors and friends in an upscale Istanbul apartment complex. Their vanity, gossip and absurd misunderstandings send up modern Turkish middle-class life.

rs-steins-gate-0-2018.plot: In an alternate timeline where he failed to save Kurisu, a traumatized Rintaro Okabe tries to move on, until an AI built from her memories draws him back into a war over time travel.

rs-erased-2016.plot: Struggling manga artist Satoru has an ability that sends him back moments before tragedies; when his mother is murdered, he is sent back 18 years to his childhood and must prevent a string of child abductions.
rs-erased-2016.source: Erased (Boku dake ga Inai Machi) by Kei Sanbe

rs-re-zero-starting-life-in-another-worl.plot: Subaru Natsuki is suddenly transported to a fantasy world, where he discovers he returns to an earlier point in time every time he dies, and uses this painful power to protect the people he comes to care about.
rs-re-zero-starting-life-in-another-worl.source: Re:Zero light novels by Tappei Nagatsuki

rs-the-killing-2007.plot: Copenhagen detective Sarah Lund, on her last day before moving to Sweden, is drawn into the murder of a teenage girl, a case that tears apart the victim's family and entangles a mayoral election.

rs-trapped-2015.plot: When a mutilated body is found in a remote Icelandic fishing town just as a blizzard cuts it off from the world, police chief Andri Ólafsson must find the killer among the townspeople and the passengers of a stranded ferry.

rs-inspector-george-gently-2007.plot: Principled veteran Inspector George Gently and his brash, ambitious sergeant John Bacchus investigate murders in the North East of England as the 1960s bring social upheaval and police corruption.
rs-inspector-george-gently-2007.source: Inspector Gently novels by Alan Hunter

rs-marco-polo-2014.plot: The young Venetian traveler Marco Polo is left at the court of Kublai Khan, ruler of the Mongol Empire. He becomes the Khan's emissary amid wars, palace intrigue and the Mongols' conquest of Song China.

rs-resurrection-ertugrul-2014.plot: In 13th-century Anatolia, Ertuğrul, a warrior of the nomadic Kayı tribe, fights Crusaders, Mongols and Byzantines while uniting Turkish tribes. His struggles lay the groundwork for the Ottoman Empire his son will found.

rs-kingdoms-of-fire-2019.plot: A historical drama about the conflict between the Mamluk Sultanate and the rising Ottoman Empire in the early 16th century, culminating in the struggle between Sultan Selim I and the last Mamluk sultan, Tuman Bay.

rs-establishment-osman-2019.plot: Osman, son of Ertuğrul, rises to lead the Kayı tribe in 13th-century Anatolia, battling Byzantine lords, Mongols and traitors as he lays the foundations of what becomes the Ottoman Empire.

rs-the-owl-house-2020.plot: Luz, an imaginative human teen, stumbles through a portal into the Boiling Isles, a demon realm, where she apprentices with the rebellious witch Eda and her roommate King, learning magic while uncovering a sinister conspiracy behind the isles' ruler.

rs-amphibia-2019.plot: Thai-American teen Anne Boonchuy is magically transported to Amphibia, a wild marshland of talking frogs, where she befriends the adventurous young frog Sprig and his family while searching for a way home and uncovering a darker mystery.

rs-tim-and-eric-awesome-show-great-job-2.plot: Tim Heidecker and Eric Wareheim present a surreal, deliberately low-fi sketch show built from fake commercials, public-access parodies and uncomfortable musical numbers. Its absurdist anti-comedy became a cult touchstone of late-2000s alternative humor.

rs-between-two-ferns-with-zach-galifiana.plot: Zach Galifianakis hosts a cheap-looking public-access talk show, seated between two potted ferns, where he asks celebrity guests awkward, insulting questions. The short web episodes turn deadpan hostility and painful silences into comedy, famously landing guests up to a sitting president.

rs-serengeti-2019.plot: A dramatized wildlife documentary following the lives of individual animals of Africa's Serengeti, including lions, elephants, baboons and hyenas, with storylines narrated as personal dramas.

rs-86-2021.plot: The Republic of San Magnolia claims its war against the autonomous drones of the Legion is bloodless, but its machines are secretly piloted by the persecuted 'Eighty-Six'. An idealistic young handler forms a bond with a squad of these doomed teenage pilots.

rs-kabaneri-of-the-iron-fortress-2016.plot: In a steampunk island nation overrun by undead creatures called Kabane, young engineer Ikoma becomes a half-human Kabaneri and joins survivors aboard an armored train fighting their way between fortress stations.

rs-radhakrishn-2018.plot: A mythological drama retelling the eternal love of Radha and Krishna, from their childhood in Vrindavan through Krishna's adventures, duties and the epic events of the Mahabharata.

rs-the-curse-2023.plot: A newlywed couple film an HGTV-style show about their eco-friendly homes in a New Mexico town, but after a small girl places a curse on the husband, their shaky marriage and hollow do-gooder image start to crack.

rs-review-2014.plot: A TV critic reviews life experiences suggested by viewers, such as getting divorced or eating 15 pancakes, rating each one with stars. His total commitment to the job gradually destroys his own life.

rs-taboo-2017.plot: Presumed dead, adventurer James Delaney returns to London from Africa in 1814 to claim his father's shipping legacy, including a strategic strip of land, and wages a ruthless war against the East India Company and the Crown.

rs-sas-rogue-heroes-2022.plot: A dramatized account of the founding of the Special Air Service in World War II North Africa, as maverick officer David Stirling and a band of unruly soldiers launch daring raids behind enemy lines; later series follow them into Europe.

rs-solar-opposites-2020.plot: A family of four aliens from a destroyed planet crash-lands in middle America and argues over whether Earth is awful or awesome, while their Replicants raise a society of shrunken humans inside a wall.
studios: Justin Roiland's Solo Vanity Card Productions

rs-tuca-bertie-2019.plot: Two thirty-something bird women, the brash toucan Tuca and the anxious song thrush Bertie, live in the same apartment building and support each other through careers, relationships and personal growth in a surreal animated city.

rs-long-story-short-2025.plot: Jumping back and forth across decades, this animated series follows the Schwooper siblings of a Jewish family as they grow up, fight, love and keep failing to escape their parents' influence.

rs-cosmos-possible-worlds-2020.plot: Astrophysicist Neil deGrasse Tyson continues the Cosmos saga, exploring stories of scientific discovery, lost worlds and possible futures for humanity, from the origins of life to journeys to distant planets.

rs-wonders-of-the-universe-2011.plot: Physicist Brian Cox explores the origins and nature of the cosmos, explaining time, light, gravity and the elements that make up stars and people, using striking locations on Earth as analogies for cosmic processes.

rs-the-planets-2019.plot: Physicist Brian Cox tells the history of the solar system as a dramatic story, exploring how each planet formed and changed, from Mercury and Venus to the gas giants and the worlds beyond.

rs-this-country-2017.plot: A mockumentary following two bored, mischievous cousins, Kerry and Kurtan Mucklowe, as they kill time in a sleepy Cotswolds village, feuding with neighbors and confiding in the patient local vicar.

rs-gavin-stacey-2007.plot: Essex boy Gavin and Welsh girl Stacey fall in love over the phone and marry, bringing together their very different families and their best friends, the brash Smithy and Nessa.

rs-the-royle-family-1998.plot: A working-class Manchester family spends its days slumped in front of the television, bickering, gossiping and smoking, in a naturalistic comedy with no laugh track and almost no plot.

rs-hap-and-leonard-2016.plot: In late-1980s East Texas, white working-class drifter Hap Collins and his best friend Leonard Pine, a gay Black Vietnam veteran, keep getting dragged into dangerous schemes and crimes that test their loyalty.
rs-hap-and-leonard-2016.source: Hap and Leonard novels by Joe R. Lansdale

rs-suburra-blood-on-rome-2017.plot: In Rome, a struggle over coastal land in Ostia pulls three young men from rival worlds, a gangster's son, a Sinti clan heir and a rich kid, into an alliance amid organized crime, corrupt politicians and the Vatican.

rs-romanzo-criminale-2008.plot: In late-1970s Rome, small-time crooks Libanese, Freddo and Dandi form a gang that seizes control of the city's drug and gambling rackets, entangling themselves with politics, terrorism and the secret services. A fictionalized saga of the real Magliana gang.

rs-kuroko-s-basketball-2012.plot: A nearly invisible high school player who was once the hidden sixth man of a legendary middle-school team joins forces with a powerful newcomer. Together they aim to beat the former teammates known as the Generation of Miracles.

rs-blue-lock-2022.plot: After Japan's World Cup failure, the football union gathers 300 young strikers in a ruthless training facility called Blue Lock, where only one will emerge as the world's most egotistical striker, and high-schooler Yoichi Isagi fights to survive.

rs-ping-pong-the-animation-2014.plot: Two childhood friends with very different personalities play on their high school table-tennis team. The quiet, robotic prodigy and his cheerful, cocky friend each face rivals and their own reasons for playing.

rs-last-tango-in-halifax-2012.plot: Two widowed septuagenarians who were sweethearts as teenagers reconnect online and quickly decide to marry. Their whirlwind romance collides with the troubled lives of their very different adult daughters.

rs-patriot-act-with-hasan-minhaj-2018.plot: Comedian Hasan Minhaj delivers deep-dive comedic monologues on politics, culture and global issues in front of a live audience, using graphics-heavy staging to unpack a single topic each week.

rs-full-frontal-with-samantha-bee-2016.plot: Former Daily Show correspondent Samantha Bee hosts a weekly late-night comedy show of fiery monologues and field pieces satirizing American politics, media and current events.

rs-the-colbert-report-2005.plot: Stephen Colbert plays a blustering, self-important conservative pundit, satirizing cable news punditry with segments like 'The Wørd' and interviews with politicians, authors and celebrities.

rs-infinity-train-2019.plot: People struggling with personal problems find themselves aboard a mysterious, seemingly endless train where each car holds a strange world; a number on their hand counts down as they work through their issues to earn a way off.

rs-violet-evergarden-2018.plot: After the war, former child soldier Violet Evergarden becomes an Auto Memory Doll, writing letters for others, hoping that by understanding their feelings she can learn the meaning of the last words her commanding officer told her.

rs-anohana-the-flower-we-saw-that-day-20.plot: Reclusive teenager Jinta Yadomi is visited by the ghost of Menma, a childhood friend who died years earlier, who asks him to grant a forgotten wish. Fulfilling it forces their scattered circle of friends to confront long-buried guilt and grief.

rs-nodame-cantabile-2007.plot: Perfectionist music student Shinichi Chiaki dreams of becoming a conductor abroad, while his slovenly but gifted pianist neighbor Nodame falls for him; together they grow as musicians from Tokyo to Paris.

rs-clannad-after-story-2008.plot: Continuing from Clannad, delinquent Tomoya Okazaki graduates high school and builds an adult life with Nagisa Furukawa, facing work, marriage and family hardship. The second season shifts from school comedy to a moving drama about parenthood, loss and reconciliation.

rs-sneaky-pete-2015.plot: Fresh out of prison and hunted by a vicious gangster he owes money, con man Marius assumes the identity of his cellmate Pete and moves in with Pete's estranged family, who run a bail bonds business in rural Connecticut.

rs-the-legend-of-vox-machina-2022.plot: A rowdy band of misfit mercenaries who mostly want drinks and gold keep getting pulled into saving the realm of Exandria, facing dark magic, chromatic dragons and threats to the gods themselves, while sorting out their own painful pasts.

rs-dimension-20-2018.plot: Game master Brennan Lee Mulligan leads comedians through tabletop role-playing campaigns, mostly Dungeons & Dragons, in genres from high fantasy to teen drama and noir, with elaborate miniature sets and improvised storytelling.

rs-harmonquest-2016.plot: Dan Harmon and friends play a fantasy tabletop role-playing game in front of a live audience with a celebrity guest each episode, and their improvised adventure is brought to life in animated segments.

rs-the-punisher-2017.plot: Former Marine Frank Castle, whose family was killed in a botched cover-up, wages a violent one-man war against criminals and uncovers a military conspiracy with help from a former NSA analyst.

rs-daredevil-born-again-2025.plot: Blind lawyer Matt Murdock, who fights crime as Daredevil, faces his old enemy Wilson Fisk again when the former crime lord is elected mayor of New York and turns the city against vigilantes.

rs-jessica-jones-2015.plot: Former superhero Jessica Jones runs a hard-drinking private investigation business in New York, haunted by the mind-controlling villain Kilgrave who once took over her life and now resurfaces.

rs-i-ll-be-gone-in-the-dark-2020.plot: A documentary about true-crime writer Michelle McNamara's obsessive search for the Golden State Killer, the serial rapist and murderer who terrorized California in the 1970s and 80s, and the toll the hunt took on her.
rs-i-ll-be-gone-in-the-dark-2020.source: I'll Be Gone in the Dark (Michelle McNamara)

rs-kaiju-no-8-2024.plot: In a Japan plagued by giant monsters, a 32-year-old kaiju cleanup worker who dreams of joining the Defense Force suddenly gains the power to transform into a kaiju himself, and must hide it while trying to join the force.

rs-reply-1997-2012.plot: In 1997 Busan, a teenage girl obsessed with the K-pop boy band H.O.T. grows up alongside her childhood friend and classmates. The story cuts between their high-school days and a 2012 reunion that hides who married whom.

rs-reply-1994-2013.plot: Out-of-town college students board at a family home in Seoul in 1994. Friendships and romances grow amid the era's pop culture, while a present-day framing story hides which of the boys becomes the heroine's husband.

rs-hometown-cha-cha-cha-2021.plot: A pragmatic big-city dentist moves to a seaside village and opens a clinic, clashing with and then falling for the charming local jack-of-all-trades Chief Hong, who helps everyone in town but hides a painful past.

rs-permanent-roommates-2014.plot: A young couple in a long-distance relationship face the question of marriage after the boyfriend returns from the US and proposes. They opt to live together first and find out what commitment really means.

rs-start-up-2020.plot: In Korea's tech hub Sandbox, an aspiring entrepreneur tries to launch her own start-up, torn between a struggling coder she believes was her childhood pen pal and the sharp investor who actually wrote those letters.
