rs-documental-2016.plot: Hitoshi Matsumoto locks ten comedians in a room for six hours, each staking their own money; anyone who laughs is eliminated, and the last one standing wins the pot in a game of nonstop attempts to crack each other up.

rs-richard-osman-s-house-of-games-2017.plot: Four celebrity contestants compete across a week of daily episodes in a series of playful trivia and word games devised by host Richard Osman, chasing points and cheap novelty prizes.

rs-don-t-f-k-with-cats-hunting-an-intern.plot: A group of amateur online sleuths sets out to track down a man who posted videos of himself killing kittens, a hunt that escalates when he commits a murder and leads them across continents.

rs-dave-2020.plot: Dave Burd, a neurotic suburban Jewish man in his late twenties, is convinced he is destined to be one of the greatest rappers of all time and chases fame as Lil Dicky with the help of his friends.

rs-random-acts-of-flyness-2018.plot: A surreal, genre-blending late-night sketch series from Terence Nance mixing animation, documentary, music and comedy to explore Black life, race and identity in contemporary America.

rs-crashing-2016.plot: A group of twentysomethings live as property guardians in a disused London hospital, paying cheap rent in exchange for protecting the building, while friendships and romances between them grow tangled.

rs-dandadan-2024.plot: A girl who believes in ghosts and a nerdy boy who believes in aliens make a bet over who is right, and both turn out to be correct; they team up to fight yōkai and extraterrestrials while their feelings for each other grow.

rs-paper-girls-2022.plot: While delivering newspapers on the morning after Halloween 1988, four 12-year-old girls are swept into a war between time-traveling factions and come face to face with their adult selves in the future.
rs-paper-girls-2022.source: Paper Girls (Brian K. Vaughan, Cliff Chiang)

rs-locke-key-2020.plot: After their father's murder, the three Locke siblings move with their mother to his ancestral home in Massachusetts, where they discover magical keys with strange powers and a demon who wants them.

rs-tales-from-the-loop-2020.plot: In a small Ohio town built above a mysterious research facility known as the Loop, residents encounter strange machines and artifacts that bend time, space and identity. Each quiet, melancholic episode centers on a different townsperson.
rs-tales-from-the-loop-2020.source: Tales from the Loop (Simon Stålenhag art book)

rs-wheeler-dealers-2003.plot: Car dealer Mike Brewer buys used and classic cars, a mechanic partner restores and upgrades them in the workshop, and Mike tries to sell each one for a profit.

rs-a-million-little-things-2018.plot: When a seemingly successful member of a tight-knit group of Boston friends dies by suicide, the others are shaken into confronting the secrets, regrets and struggles in their own lives.

rs-road-to-avonlea-1990.plot: Sent from Montreal to live with her aunts on Prince Edward Island, young Sara Stanley grows up amid the eccentric King family and the close-knit villagers of Avonlea in the early 1900s.
rs-road-to-avonlea-1990.source: The Story Girl and other works by L. M. Montgomery

rs-secrets-of-the-whales-2021.plot: Filmed over three years across two dozen locations, the series follows orcas, humpbacks, belugas, narwhals and sperm whales to reveal their complex cultures, communication and family bonds.

rs-1899-2022.plot: In 1899 a steamship carrying European emigrants to New York finds a missing sister ship adrift at sea, and its multinational passengers are pulled into a mind-bending mystery that blurs the line between reality and illusion.

rs-the-returned-2012.plot: In a small French mountain town, people long dead start walking back home, unaware they died and not having aged a day. Their return unsettles grieving families as strange events grow around the town and its dam.

rs-manhunt-unabomber-2017.plot: FBI profiler Jim Fitzgerald pioneers forensic linguistics to identify the Unabomber, a domestic terrorist who evaded capture for nearly two decades, intercut with tense conversations between the two men after the arrest.

setting.place: San Francisco, Montana and Washington D.C.

rs-vietnam-a-television-history-1983.plot: A landmark documentary tracing the Vietnam conflict from the end of World War II and French colonial rule through American escalation to the fall of Saigon, told through archival footage and interviews with participants on all sides.

rs-turning-point-9-11-and-the-war-on-ter.plot: A five-part documentary that recounts the September 11 attacks and traces their two-decade aftermath, from the wars in Afghanistan and Iraq to the rise of mass surveillance and the global war on terror.

rs-lodge-49-2018.plot: Dud, a laid-off, good-natured ex-surfer in Long Beach, stumbles into a fading fraternal lodge and becomes enchanted by its alchemical mysteries, finding new friends and purpose amid economic decline.

rs-peppa-pig-2004.plot: Cheeky little piglet Peppa, her younger brother George and their Mummy and Daddy Pig enjoy everyday adventures, from jumping in muddy puddles to visiting friends and grandparents.

rs-the-inbetweeners-2008.plot: Awkward Will McKenzie, transferred to a suburban comprehensive, falls in with three equally hapless friends, Simon, Jay and Neil. Together they bumble through sixth-form humiliations, parties, girls and driving lessons in a cringe comedy of teenage life.

rs-the-young-offenders-2018.plot: Lovable, dim-witted best friends Conor and Jock cause chaos in Cork, Ireland, dodging their school principal, Conor's tough-love mother and the consequences of their petty crimes.

rs-sex-education-2019.plot: Awkward teenager Otis, son of a sex therapist, sets up an underground sex-advice clinic at his school with rebellious classmate Maeve, as he and his friends navigate relationships, identity and growing up.

rs-underbelly-2008.plot: An Australian crime anthology dramatizing real underworld history. The first season charts Melbourne's gangland war of 1995-2004, as Carl Williams and rival families kill one another while a police taskforce closes in; later seasons move to other cities and eras.

rs-the-lying-life-of-adults-2023.plot: In 1990s Naples, a teenage girl from a refined middle-class family seeks out her estranged aunt Vittoria in the city's poorer quarters, and in doing so discovers the lies and hypocrisies of the adults around her.
rs-the-lying-life-of-adults-2023.source: The Lying Life of Adults by Elena Ferrante

rs-misaeng-incomplete-life-2014.plot: A young man who failed in his dream of becoming a professional Go player, with only a high-school equivalency diploma, lands an internship at a big trading company. He applies lessons from the board to office politics and survival.

rs-my-liberation-notes-2022.plot: Three weary siblings living with their parents in a village outside Seoul endure long commutes and joyless routines until the youngest asks a mysterious, hard-drinking drifter working for their father to 'worship' her, sparking quiet transformations.

rs-our-blues-2022.plot: An omnibus drama set on Jeju Island, where interlinked stories follow fishmongers, divers, a truck vendor and other locals facing love, estrangement, illness and the bittersweet joys of everyday life.

rs-mr-mercedes-2017.plot: Retired detective Bill Hodges is taunted by the psychopath who drove a stolen Mercedes into a crowd of job seekers, years after the case went cold, and is drawn into a deadly cat-and-mouse game.
rs-mr-mercedes-2017.source: Bill Hodges trilogy by Stephen King

rs-the-old-man-2022.plot: Former CIA operative Dan Chase has lived off the grid for decades, until an assassin shows up and forces him to run. His past in Afghanistan resurfaces as an FBI official who once knew him is ordered to bring him in.
rs-the-old-man-2022.source: The Old Man by Thomas Perry

rs-veneno-2020.plot: The life of Cristina Ortiz, 'La Veneno', the transgender Spanish TV icon of the 1990s, told through her friendship with a young journalist writing her biography, spanning her hard childhood, fame, prison term and mysterious death.

rs-the-righteous-gemstones-2019.plot: A wealthy, dysfunctional family of televangelists led by patriarch Eli Gemstone battles blackmailers, rivals and each other while running their megachurch empire.

rs-the-haunting-of-bly-manor-2020.plot: In 1987 a young American au pair takes a job caring for two orphaned children at an English country estate, where she discovers the manor is haunted by apparitions tied to its tragic past. The tale is framed as a ghost story told at a wedding.
rs-the-haunting-of-bly-manor-2020.source: The Turn of the Screw (Henry James)

rs-marianne-2019.plot: A successful horror novelist returns to her coastal hometown in France and discovers that Marianne, the witch from her books, is real and has been tormenting the people she knows.

rs-malgudi-days-1986.plot: Gentle, humane tales of ordinary people in the fictional South Indian town of Malgudi, from the schoolboy Swami and his friends to shopkeepers, clerks and astrologers, adapted from R. K. Narayan's stories.
rs-malgudi-days-1986.source: Malgudi Days and other works by R. K. Narayan

rs-hostel-daze-2019.plot: A comedy following a group of engineering students living in a college hostel in India, from ragging and first-year nerves through friendships, exams, romance and the chaos of campus life.

rs-home-shanti-2022.plot: The Joshis, a middle-class family in Dehradun, set out to build a home of their own, navigating tight budgets, bureaucracy, unreliable contractors and everyday family squabbles in this gentle slice-of-life comedy.

rs-1923-2022.plot: A Yellowstone prequel following the Dutton family in 1920s Montana, as Jacob and Cara Dutton fight drought, locusts and a ruthless mining baron, while their great-nephew Spencer hunts big game in Africa and falls in love.

rs-waco-2018.plot: The 1993 standoff between the FBI, the ATF and David Koresh's Branch Davidian sect near Waco, Texas, told from the perspectives of a sect member, an FBI negotiator and Koresh himself, leading to a deadly fire.
rs-waco-2018.source: A Place Called Waco by David Thibodeau; Stalling for Time by Gary Noesner

rs-my-love-from-the-star-2013.plot: An alien who landed in Joseon-era Korea 400 years ago has lived quietly ever since and plans to leave Earth within months. Then he falls for his neighbor, a vain, outspoken top actress.

rs-guardian-the-lonely-and-great-god-201.plot: Kim Shin, a Goryeo-era general cursed with immortality as a goblin, can only end his life with the help of a human bride; he meets a cheerful high school student who can see ghosts, while sharing his home with a forgetful grim reaper.

rs-descendants-of-the-sun-2016.plot: A South Korean special forces captain and a dedicated surgeon fall in love, and their relationship is tested when both are deployed to a war-torn fictional country where danger and duty keep pulling them apart.

rs-hell-s-paradise-2023.plot: In Edo-period Japan, a condemned ninja assassin is offered a pardon if he can find the elixir of life on a mysterious island, where convicts and their executioner escorts face monstrous creatures and strange immortal beings.
rs-hell-s-paradise-2023.source: Hell's Paradise: Jigokuraku by Yuji Kaku

rs-fate-zero-2011.plot: Ten years before Fate/stay night, seven mages summon legendary heroes as Servants to fight in Fuyuki City's Fourth Holy Grail War for a wish-granting cup. Mercenary Kiritsugu Emiya, fighting alongside Saber, pursues victory at any moral cost.

rs-wwii-in-hd-2009.plot: Using rare, restored color footage shot by servicemen and correspondents, this documentary traces World War II through the experiences of a dozen Americans who lived it, from Pearl Harbor and Europe to the Pacific, with their words read by actors.

rs-five-came-back-2017.plot: Five modern filmmakers examine how five Hollywood directors, including John Ford, Frank Capra and William Wyler, left their careers to make films for the war effort during World War II, and how the experience changed them.
rs-five-came-back-2017.source: Five Came Back by Mark Harris (nonfiction book)

rs-wagle-ki-duniya-1988.plot: Based on R. K. Laxman's Common Man cartoons, gentle satirical episodes follow Srinivas Wagle, a mild-mannered Mumbai office clerk, and his wife as they navigate everyday middle-class struggles, petty injustices and small joys.
rs-wagle-ki-duniya-1988.source: The Common Man cartoons by R. K. Laxman

rs-flames-2018.plot: A coming-of-age romance about Rajat, a teenager at a small coaching center, who falls for new student Ishita, following their first love, friendships and growing pains over the following years.

rs-laakhon-mein-ek-2017.plot: An anthology-like drama about ordinary Indians crushed by systems: the first season follows a teenager forced into a brutal engineering-entrance coaching institute, the second a young doctor fighting corruption in rural public health.

rs-a-perfect-planet-2021.plot: David Attenborough narrates a look at how the forces that shape Earth, from volcanoes and sunlight to weather and ocean currents, drive its wildlife, and how human-caused climate change is upsetting that balance.

rs-blood-of-zeus-2020.plot: Heron, a demigod son of Zeus raised as an outcast in ancient Greece, discovers his heritage and is drawn into a war between the Olympian gods and an army of demons, uncovering family betrayals along the way.

rs-unicorn-warriors-eternal-2023.plot: In a steampunk Victorian world, legendary heroes who have fought evil throughout history reawaken in new, younger bodies before their memories have fully returned, and must stop an ancient darkness from rising again.

rs-gen-v-2023.plot: Young superheroes at Godolkin University compete for fame and top rankings, but a group of students uncovers what the school is secretly doing to supes, setting them against Vought and its powerful allies.
rs-gen-v-2023.source: The Boys by Garth Ennis and Darick Robertson

rs-peacemaker-2022.plot: After The Suicide Squad, the violent, peace-obsessed vigilante Christopher Smith is drafted into a covert government team fighting an alien invasion, and later finds an alternate universe where his life seemingly turned out better.

rs-farzi-2023.plot: A struggling Mumbai artist starts printing near-perfect counterfeit banknotes to save his grandfather's printing press, drawing the attention of a ruthless crime lord and an obsessive task-force officer determined to stop fake currency.

rs-special-ops-2020.plot: RAW officer Himmat Singh spends nearly two decades convinced that one mastermind is behind a string of terror attacks in India, and assembles a team of field agents to hunt him down. A later season pits him against a new cyber-terror threat.

rs-sacred-games-2018.plot: Mumbai police officer Sartaj Singh receives a call from fugitive gangster Ganesh Gaitonde warning him to save the city in 25 days, launching a race against time through crime, politics and religious extremism.

rs-skeleton-crew-2024.plot: Four kids from a sheltered suburban planet accidentally launch an old starship and become lost in the galaxy, where a mysterious Force-wielding stranger joins them as they dodge pirates on their way home.

setting.period: Star Wars era after Return of the Jedi

rs-our-flag-means-death-2022.plot: In 1717, wealthy aristocrat Stede Bonnet abandons his comfortable life to become a 'gentleman pirate', leading an inept crew until he meets the feared Blackbeard and an unlikely romance blossoms.

rs-time-the-kalief-browder-story-2017.plot: The story of Kalief Browder, a Bronx teenager held for three years at Rikers Island, much of it in solitary confinement, without trial over an alleged backpack theft, and the tragic aftermath of his release.

setting.place: The Bronx and Rikers Island, New York

rs-rest-in-power-the-trayvon-martin-stor.plot: Examines the 2012 killing of unarmed Black teenager Trayvon Martin in Sanford, Florida, the acquittal of George Zimmerman, and how his parents' fight helped ignite the Black Lives Matter movement.

rs-heartbeat-1992.plot: A London police constable and his doctor wife move to the North Yorkshire village of Aidensfield in the 1960s, where gentle local crime, community life and an eccentric cast unfold to a soundtrack of period pop hits.

rs-joe-pera-talks-with-you-2018.plot: Gentle, soft-spoken choir teacher Joe Pera guides viewers through the small pleasures of life in Michigan's Upper Peninsula, from iron, beans and breakfast to falling in love.

rs-scam-2003-the-telgi-story-2023.plot: Fruit seller Abdul Karim Telgi climbs from small-time hustling to running India's huge fake stamp paper racket, corrupting officials across the country until the scheme unravels.
rs-scam-2003-the-telgi-story-2023.source: Reporter Ki Diary by Sanjay Singh

rs-yolo-crystal-fantasy-2020.plot: Party-obsessed best friends Sarah and Rachel stumble through a surreal, crudely animated Australian town chasing fun, romance and self-improvement, and their ill-advised adventures keep spiraling into the bizarre and supernatural.

rs-aqua-teen-hunger-force-2000.plot: Three anthropomorphic fast-food items, the self-proclaimed leader Master Shake, the brainy Frylock and the childlike Meatwad, share a house in New Jersey and stumble into surreal misadventures with their neighbor Carl.

rs-welcome-to-wrexham-2022.plot: Hollywood actors Ryan Reynolds and Rob McElhenney buy Wrexham AFC, a struggling Welsh football club, and the series follows the team, staff and town as the club fights its way up the English football pyramid.

rs-sunderland-til-i-die-2018.plot: Follows Sunderland AFC and its devoted fans in the industrial northeast of England through relegations, ownership changes and promotion battles, showing what a football club means to its city.

rs-trying-2020.plot: London couple Nikki and Jason can't conceive and decide to adopt, navigating the bureaucratic process, chaotic friends and family, and eventually the joys and trials of raising the children they are matched with.

rs-arnie-2023.plot: Arnold Schwarzenegger tells his own story, from a strict Austrian childhood to bodybuilding champion, Hollywood action star and governor of California, including the scandals along the way.

rs-formula-1-drive-to-survive-2019.plot: A behind-the-scenes look at each Formula One season, following drivers, team principals and their rivalries on and off the track as teams fight for championships and survival in the sport.

rs-beckham-2023.plot: David Beckham looks back on his career, from Manchester United youth player to global celebrity, including his World Cup villain moment, moves to Madrid and Los Angeles, and his marriage to Victoria under constant media scrutiny.

rs-march-comes-in-like-a-lion-2016.plot: Rei Kiriyama, a lonely 17-year-old professional shogi player in Tokyo, slowly heals from past trauma through his matches and the warmth of three sisters who welcome him into their family.
rs-march-comes-in-like-a-lion-2016.source: March Comes in Like a Lion by Chica Umino

rs-cyberpunk-edgerunners-2022.plot: In the corporate-ruled metropolis of Night City, a street kid who loses everything has a military-grade cyberware implant installed and joins a crew of outlaw mercenaries known as edgerunners, risking his humanity to survive.

rs-pantheon-2022.plot: A bullied teenager discovers that her late father's consciousness, digitally uploaded by a tech company, is contacting her online, drawing her into a global race to create 'Uploaded Intelligences' that could reshape humanity.

rs-the-trip-2010.plot: Steve Coogan and Rob Brydon play exaggerated versions of themselves on restaurant-reviewing road trips, first through northern England and later Italy, Spain and Greece, trading celebrity impressions, rivalries and melancholy reflections on middle age over fine meals.

rs-detroiters-2017.plot: Two lifelong best friends run a small, struggling advertising agency in Detroit, chasing big clients with cheap local commercials, absurd schemes and unshakable enthusiasm for their hometown.

rs-sandeep-bhaiya-2023.plot: A spin-off of Aspirants following Sandeep Ohlan, the mentor who repeatedly failed the civil services exam himself, as he keeps trying while guiding aspirants and wrestling with self-doubt, family pressure and a changing life.

rs-grand-designs-1999.plot: Architecture expert Kevin McCloud follows people across Britain as they attempt to build ambitious, unusual homes, charting the budgets, delays and triumphs of each project.

rs-painkiller-2023.plot: A dramatized look at the origins of the opioid crisis, following Purdue Pharma and the Sackler family's marketing of OxyContin, the sales reps who pushed it, an investigator fighting back, and the families it destroyed.
rs-painkiller-2023.source: Pain Killer by Barry Meier; The Family That Built an Empire of Pain by Patrick Radden Keefe

rs-the-crime-of-the-century-2021.plot: A two-part investigation into the opioid epidemic, showing how drugmakers such as Purdue Pharma aggressively marketed powerful painkillers while lobbyists and lax regulators enabled a crisis that killed hundreds of thousands.

rs-harley-quinn-2019.plot: After breaking up with the Joker, Harley Quinn sets out to become a supervillain in her own right, forming a crew with best friend Poison Ivy and an assortment of misfits in an irreverent, adult take on Gotham City.

rs-creature-commandos-2024.plot: Government official Amanda Waller assembles a black-ops team of imprisoned monsters, including the Bride of Frankenstein, a werewolf and a fish-man, sending them on a dangerous mission to protect a princess while their tragic pasts are revealed.

rs-song-exploder-2020.plot: Based on the podcast, musicians break down how they made one of their songs, revealing the creative process and personal stories behind tracks by artists such as Alicia Keys, R.E.M. and Lin-Manuel Miranda.

rs-merlin-2008.plot: In a Camelot where magic is outlawed on pain of death, young warlock Merlin becomes servant to the arrogant Prince Arthur. He must secretly use his powers to protect Arthur, the destined king, while hiding his gifts from King Uther.

rs-hotel-del-luna-2019.plot: Jang Man-wol, the cursed, ill-tempered owner of a hotel for ghosts in Seoul, hires an elite hotelier as her manager, and the two help lost souls move on while she confronts her own centuries-old past.

rs-a-korean-odyssey-2017.plot: In a modern-day reimagining of Journey to the West, the mischievous Monkey King Son Oh-gong is bound to protect a woman who can see spirits, the reincarnation of the monk Tang Sanzang, as demons hunt her.

rs-the-man-in-the-high-castle-2015.plot: In an alternate 1962 where the Axis won World War II and divided America between Nazi Germany and Imperial Japan, a young woman discovers mysterious films showing a world where the Allies won, drawing her into the resistance.
rs-the-man-in-the-high-castle-2015.source: The Man in the High Castle by Philip K. Dick

rs-jubilee-2023.plot: In the years after Indian independence, the ambitions of a film studio mogul, his actress wife, a young lab assistant who becomes a star, and others collide as they shape the golden age of Hindi cinema.

rs-winning-time-the-rise-of-the-lakers-d.plot: Brash new owner Jerry Buss buys the Los Angeles Lakers in 1979 and, with rookie Magic Johnson and Kareem Abdul-Jabbar, turns the team into the flashy 'Showtime' dynasty amid feuds, egos and business gambles.

rs-delicious-in-dungeon-2024.plot: After a dragon swallows his sister deep inside a dungeon, adventurer Laios and his small party race back down to rescue her, surviving on the way by cooking and eating the monsters they defeat.
rs-delicious-in-dungeon-2024.source: Delicious in Dungeon by Ryoko Kui

rs-common-side-effects-2025.plot: Two former high-school lab partners discover a mushroom that could cure almost any disease, and go on the run from pharmaceutical companies and government agents determined to keep it from the public.

rs-twenty-five-twenty-one-2022.plot: In 1998, as the Asian financial crisis upends Korean families, a determined teenage fencer chases her dream while forming a deep bond with a young man whose family lost everything, a story framed by her daughter in the present.

rs-lovely-runner-2024.plot: Devastated when her favourite pop star dies, a young fan is suddenly sent back to 2008, when they were both in high school, and sets out to save his life while a romance develops between them.
rs-lovely-runner-2024.source: Tomorrow's Best by Kim Bbang (web novel)

rs-tokyo-vice-2022.plot: An American journalist becomes the first foreign reporter at a major Tokyo newspaper and is drawn into the city's yakuza underworld, working alongside a veteran detective while hostess clubs, gang wars and corruption close in.

rs-gotham-2014.plot: Young detective James Gordon joins Gotham City's corrupt police force after the murder of Bruce Wayne's parents. As he fights crime, future villains such as the Penguin and the Riddler rise, and young Bruce begins the path to becoming Batman.

rs-gangs-of-london-2020.plot: After the assassination of London's most powerful crime boss, his volatile son Sean Wallace hunts for the killer, sparking a violent war among the city's international gangs, with an undercover cop caught in the middle.

rs-spider-man-the-animated-series-1994.plot: College student Peter Parker balances studies, romance with Mary Jane and his job at the Daily Bugle with his secret life as Spider-Man, facing a gallery of classic Marvel villains in multi-part story arcs.

rs-dexter-new-blood-2021.plot: Ten years after faking his death, Dexter Morgan lives quietly under an alias in a small upstate New York town, suppressing his urges, until a local predator and the arrival of his teenage son Harrison bring his Dark Passenger back out.

rs-shoresy-2022.plot: In this Letterkenny spin-off, foul-mouthed hockey player Shoresy joins a struggling senior AAA team in Sudbury, Ontario, vowing never to lose again and rallying the players, staff and town around the club.

rs-young-royals-2021.plot: Rebellious Swedish Prince Wilhelm is sent to an exclusive boarding school, where he falls for a scholarship student from a working-class background, a romance that collides with royal duty when he unexpectedly becomes heir to the throne.

rs-puella-magi-madoka-magica-2011.plot: Kind middle-schooler Madoka Kaname is offered a wish by the cute creature Kyubey in exchange for becoming a magical girl who fights witches. As she watches friends take the deal, the genre's bright surface gives way to dark truths about the contract.

rs-made-in-abyss-2017.plot: Orphan Riko, who dreams of following her legendary mother, descends into the Abyss, a vast and deadly chasm filled with relics and monsters, alongside Reg, a mysterious robot boy, learning that every layer exacts a terrible price.

rs-hospital-playlist-2020.plot: Five doctors who have been friends since medical school, and who play together in a band, work at the same Seoul hospital, balancing life-and-death cases with friendship, romance and everyday life.

rs-when-the-camellia-blooms-2019.plot: Dong-baek, a single mother who runs a bar in a small seaside town, faces prejudice from neighbors and a lingering serial-killer threat, until a straightforward local cop falls for her and refuses to give up.

rs-fight-for-my-way-2017.plot: Four childhood friends stuck in unglamorous jobs in Seoul decide to chase their abandoned dreams, including a former taekwondo star turned exterminator who returns to fighting and an aspiring announcer working at a department store information desk.
